# SUMMARY.md — running summary, one block per source file, in reading order (notes/_db/_file-order.tsv). Never revise an earlier block; add a "resolves" line in the later block instead.
Block format (METHOD.md §2) plus two extra lines for this project:
- narrator: who "I" is in this file (JP pronoun + name if known), and the tense feel
- time markers: any in-story date/time/era text at the top or inside (e.g. 五月六日, 祀耀784年)

- events:
  - [16] なつみ wakes past midnight on a sofa; the DVD has returned to its menu; 春花 is asleep on her shoulder; she wakes her (16:0-17)
  - [16] both note the flat now holds only the two of them and that neither set of parents is ever coming back (16:20-26)
  - [16] なつみ raises 「私は本物の魔女だって」; 春花 tells her to stop thinking about it and insists it was an accident; なつみ forces a smile, says goodnight, and the smile drops the moment her dark room's light is gone (16:27-54)

  - [51] なつみ returns with a syringe of pink liquid found taped behind the closet — the closet 春花's mother used; the label reads 『ドローガ』 (51:0-18)
  - [51] a huge grinding-metal noise, then the intercom after midnight; the peephole shows nobody; wind pushes a single cherry petal inside although the season is over; なつみ shouts not to open the door; a voice says 「やあ春花、久しぶりだね」; 春花 answers 「おとうさん？」 (51:19-47)

  - 16:34 「あの人は死んだ」, 16:43 / 16:62-64 「あの2人」「あの人」 — three separate withheld referents, all subjectless. -> Q002
  - 51:9-13 five untagged alternating lines; attribution is inferred from ～よね／～よな register only. -> Q033
  - 51:14-18 『ド／ロ／ー／ガ』 is split one character per cell for a reveal beat; English letter count will not match. -> Q004
  - 51:43-47 「お／と／う／さ／ん？」 same device. -> Q005

## 000001DB  (order 4)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. Three variants of one scene: row-blocks 15 (long), 21 (short), 30 (medium).
- time markers: 「今日は入学式だけの午前授業」 (15:2), 「四月になったばかり」 (15:11), 「四月上旬」 (15:60), 「おととい」 (15:56), evening then night
- events:
  - なつみ has declined 春花's invitation and is lying face-down on her bed after the entrance ceremony; she cannot go near the 桜祭り (15:0-16)

  - なつみ explains 四月病: every year in cherry-blossom season she collapses into nausea and depression; she calls it a physical intolerance of 桜 (15:57-60)
  - she dreams of someone thrashing and bleeding beside a cherry tree while she, very small, watches a balloon; the dying person says something beginning し…に…が… (15:64-78)

  - a single cherry petal has landed on the takoyaki; she eats it anyway and vomits in the toilet (15:119-133)
  - afterwards her mother sits fidgeting with an old flip phone, evasive when asked what is wrong; なつみ offers to clean the bath and is limited to three minutes (15:150-181)
  - the file closes on a second dream image: someone she knows lying under the cherry tree, unrecognisable (15:186-192)
  - [21] and [30] are shorter variants that stop after the takoyaki handover and the 四月病 explanation; [21] says she visited 去年 only, [30] and [15] say 去年も、一昨年も
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 新村春花, 古郡茜 (as お母さん); 五島 mentioned only
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 四月病, 五月病, 桜祭り, 中央公園, 入学式, たこ焼き, ガラケー, きんぴらごぼう, アジの干物, 桜恐怖症
- voice/relationship changes: RELATIONS rows created for なつみ↔her mother; 春花's fixed greeting 「よう！　調子はどうだ？」 established
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 15:64-78 the dying figure has no gender, age or name, and the broken word し…に…が… must stay broken and unresolved in EN.
  - 15:103 the Hokkaido business trip is reported speech from the mother; EN must not add certainty.
  - 15:131 「 苛 まれる」 carries stray spaces around 苛 — a stripped-ruby artifact, not spacing. -> Q010
  - 15:119 「あ……」⏎「あ……」 is two speakers saying the same thing at once; keep both cells.
- resolves from earlier files: 00000024:16:67 「1か月前のことを思い返した」 -> now known to mean this file and the ones after it are the flashback the prologue points at. ACTION: revisit n

## 000001E3  (order 8)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. Row-blocks 8, 12, 16, 20; 12 and 20 are isolated one-line reveal cells.
- time markers: 四月八日 (8:104), 祀耀790年四月八日 (8:121), 「10年前」 and 「3年おき」 (8:107), 午前5時10分 (8:65), 朝5時 (8:195)

  - table talk: 五島's university plans, and 春花's account that she lived in 元木町 until kindergarten, moved away for her father's work, and returned three years ago with her mother when her father was posted overseas (8:142-161)

  - after the meal 五島 argues that because the many ordinary witnesses could not even guess a sex, the damage must have been total, and yet the victim was alive, leading to one conclusion (8:192-221)

  - [16] 春花 recoils; 五島 says she ruled out burning and acid; [20] the second isolated cell: 真っ赤な死体だったって。 (16:0-11, 20:0)

## 000001E5  (order 9)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. Row-blocks 23, 29, 35, 41 include branch variants. Her self-assessment in 000001E3:24 (average at everything except an abnormal danger-sensing 直感 that works only while cherry trees are in bloom, and not always then) is the setup this file pays off.

  - [35] branch: 五島 agrees to skip cram school and goes off to gather more information instead; 春花 then shyly admits she wants to go to an Italian chef's pizza fair by the station, which is why she had pushed delivery pizza earlier (35:0-38)
  - [41] branch: なつみ's premonition fires mid-goodbye, 「ダメ！　五島行かないで！」; the text explains the 直感 arrives with no warning; 五島 studies her, then grins and puts both hands on her shoulders (41:0-15)

  - they leave 元木町 for 女ケ沢市 in 飯沢県: a hospital for the mother's illness, and 荒田集落 is nearer. The mother is admitted; 春花 goes into a 児童養護施設 (11:20-27)
  - to cheer her mother 春花 works charms out of picture books; that is where she learns charms also include 「呪い」 (11:28-35)
  - the mother is discharged; they move to a run-down apartment, 七海荘 (11:36-40)
  - at school she speaks up for a bullied classmate, 御子神, and becomes the target herself; the ringleader's parent is a PTA officer, so nothing improves (11:41-53)
  - she performs cheerfulness at home until her mother's one question breaks it; she tells her about the bullying and is told to use a charm, and is given a children's book, 『のろいのせかい』, that contains demon summoning and killing by curse (11:54-85)
  - the method: write the name on a paper figure, spit on it, pray to the dead ancestors. She lies to her mother about the paper and scissors (11:86-98)
  - at the 三回忌 at 新村本家 in 荒田集落 she prays for the two to be erased; the next day they are dead and she and her mother have the 法要 as an alibi. She shakes with joy (11:99-113)
  - refinement learned afterwards: the method summons a 死神, and works more surely with vomit instead of spit, cast when a 近親者の法要 is near (11:114-118)
  - at 11 she curses the PTA chairman and her homeroom teacher; on the 七回忌 they are killed in far worse ways than she expected, and she frightens herself (11:119-149)
  - middle school, new bullies, 邪教徒 taunts; she has stopped cursing anyone. なつみ's letters are her support and she has told なつみ nothing; when the bullies tear a letter up she makes one last paper figure ten days before the 十回忌, then panics and tries to undo it too late (11:150-179)
  - police never charge her; the town turns on her and the family is told to transfer out of 女ケ沢市; she names herself 「四月八日の魔女」 (11:180-191)
  - three years later: tomorrow is the 十三回忌; she has asked to skip it, because the killings happen when she attends. She vomited two days ago, which is the one thing that frightens her, because the curse needs vomit (11:192-210)
  - she looks at the memorial portrait: 新村栄一郎, dead at 30, plain-faced and heavy; she has never once blamed なつみ; the file ends 「そう、あれは……事故だったんだ……。」 (11:211-224)
- speakers present: 新村春花 (narrating and in flashback dialogue), 新村美冬, unnamed grade-school bullies (collective), unnamed middle-school bullies (collective); 御子神 is named but never speaks

  - 17:00. A light car is parked beside レボハイツ, the block where 古郡家 and 新村家 live. 新村美冬 sits in the driver's seat with earphones plugged into a brand-new smartphone, listening to the inside of the 新村 flat through a bug planted in 春花's phone (8:0-8:4)
  - a syringe of pink fluid lies on the passenger seat; she picks it up and is about to put the needle in her arm (8:5-8:11)
  - through the earphones come three shouts (「誰よこの人！」「逃げろ！　死神だ！」「先輩！　助けて！」), then death-cries and the sound of flesh and bone (8:12-8:16)
  - she throws the syringe down, puts on 赤装束 and 能面, takes the 鉈 and the メイス, uses the stairs to avoid being seen, and opens her own front door (8:17-8:22)
  - the flat is dark, the TV is playing a film with no sound, the curtains are drawn, and three girls' bodies lie on the floor (8:23-8:30)
  - a hoarse voice behind her: 「待ってましたよ、美冬さん……」. A SECOND figure in identical 赤装束 and 能面 — an old woman's mask, not 美冬's 小面. 美冬 recognises the voice, puts her weapons on the floor, kneels in the blood and says 「お久しぶりです。大魔女様」 (8:31-8:43)
  - the interrogation: 美冬 apologises for missing her husband's 法要; the 大魔女 recites 荒田集落's motto 「1人はみんなのために。みんなは1人のために」, asks why 古郡良治, and says she remembers his name from the 婚姻式 twenty years ago when 美冬 asked for the 古郡 couple to be allowed into 荒田 (8:44-8:60)
  - she orders 美冬 to lift her face and then to take the mask off; 美冬 is crying. The 大魔女 says she heard of brutalised bodies in this town and that the thirteenth-year memorial falling on 四月八日 made it obvious (8:61-8:71)
  - the 大魔女 names the three bodies — 古郡なつみ, 五島絵梨奈, 「そして孫の春花」 — and says she did it in 美冬's place; 美冬 says 五島絵梨奈 was not supposed to be killed, that she cannot let go of 春花 because 古郡良治 told her he could no longer entrust 春花 to her, that なつみ is a real witch who can see the future in cherry season and kill by cursing, that 栄一郎 died of it, and that 「春花は私の娘です！」 (8:72-8:97)
  - the 大魔女 takes off the old woman's mask. It is 春花. 「お母さんごめん……。ばあちゃんのモノマネ、前よりうまくなってたでしょ？」 Police rush in and arrest 新村美冬 for murder, abandonment of a corpse and incitement to murder; the bodies were policewomen impersonating the three girls (8:98-8:107)
  - narration switches to 春花. なつみ and 五島 come out of the other rooms, neither smiling. 美冬 is taken away. 春花 cannot stand, asks whether it is a prank; なつみ holds her and apologises, saying she is the witch and that none of it would have happened if she had not let the balloon go (8:108-8:123)
  - 伊勢 reports the transfer and thanks them; 五島 asks whether the two 先輩 will be driven out of 元木町 and calls him おじさん; he stammers a promise, refuses a kiss on the cheek, then asks 新村さん and 古郡さん to come in for statements (8:124-8:138)
  - なつみ pulls 春花 to her feet; 春花 asks where her strength comes from; なつみ answers with the same motto, attributing it to 新村家 this time. Closing narration: everyone lived, her mother is arrested, なつみ's mother's arrest is a matter of time, she owes なつみ's father an apology she cannot pay, and this is not the best ending but the most decent one available (8:139-8:154)

  - at work he is building a mobile-phone prototype; 栄一郎's desk beside him has been empty two years (11:43-11:54)

  - exposition: なつみ's ability appeared after the accident, works when she is in the wind, and is never explained to her, because more than fifteen minutes of wind makes her ill and they do not want her frightened of wind as well as cherry blossom.   - he finishes an improved, lighter prototype ahead of the client's request and hands the delivery to his junior to do alone on 四月八日 (11:117-11:139)

## 0000085D  (order 68)
- narrator: 古郡良治 (俺), past tense, the evening of なつみ's first school day

## 000008A2  (order 71)
- narrator: 古郡良治 (俺), past tense; continues [16] of 0000088B
- time markers: none beyond 「明日」 and 「明日早朝」 (16:35)
- events:
  - a fly circles the room. なつみ is laid down beside 春花. 美冬 is gaunt and her clothes have been worn for days, while 春花's hang clean on the wall; the poverty is worse than he imagined (8:0-8:14)
  - 茜 asks for the time, the place and the method, with no hesitation in her voice; 良治 sits down and decides to listen only (8:15-8:23)
  - the equipment: 赤装束 with short knives sewn inside it, a 鉈, a メイス, and two syringes of a drug that unlocks the muscles for about ten minutes (8:24-8:48)
  - it came from 荒田集落. The history: founded 800 years ago by people fleeing the wars, it absorbed vagrants and Westerners; closed to outsiders, absolute towards its own; raided for its land and food, it armed itself and has never disarmed; 美冬's year there was that training, and she demonstrates by splitting the fly in mid-air with the 鉈 (8:49-8:76)
  - the drug was extracted from a local plant by a Western doctor and used as burnt crystals in the past; the masks were adopted so fighters could not be identified and could still walk outside barefaced in peacetime; in 荒田's own vocabulary 魔女 means what would now be called a priest, 死神 means literally the dead, and mourners wear 能面 at a funeral so that the 死神 does not notice them (8:77-8:95)
  - the rules that make the parcel impossible: an outsider spouse cannot settle in the village until the child is sixteen; arming outside the village is forbidden; external aid is forbidden. So someone inside is breaking the rules — the 「信頼できる人」, whom 美冬 will not name (8:96-8:139)
  - 良治 offers to support both of them in 元木町; 美冬 refuses, because being near なつみ is unbearable and she might act on it (8:140-8:147)
  - [12] one cell: 「魔女……」
  - [16] 美冬 states it: なつみ is a witch in the real sense, not 荒田's, and cursed 栄一郎 to death. Her evidence is the twisting body, the noise, and the ability that appeared the same day. 良治 argues; she closes the argument by pointing out what they now know: if they betray her, the 「信頼できる人」 and the village can erase all three of them, the letter came with no postmark because it was hand-delivered, their address is known, and a sect that split from 荒田 long ago is still active in 女ケ沢 with believers among 春花's classmates (16:0-16:28)
  - he understands that they were beaten before they arrived, and that his family is the hostage. 美冬 says she and 春花 leave at dawn for the third-year memorial. He asks to take 春花 for a while and is answered with the fly (16:29-16:48)
- speakers present: 古郡良治, 新村美冬, 古郡茜
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 信頼できる人, 神官, 火事場の馬鹿力, リミッター, ドーピング薬, 浮浪者, 西洋人, 密通者
- voice/relationship changes: 美冬 speaks in her SECOND register for the whole file — level, plain, no elongation, no exclamation marks — twelve years before 00000564 makes it a reveal. It is the same voice; here it is simply what she sounds like now. Do not let the EN treat it as a mask.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 8:84-8:87 荒田's definitions of 魔女 and 死神. These retro-define two of the project's central terms. The rendering chosen for 魔女 and 死神 everywhere else must survive this passage without a footnote inside the line. -> Q119, Q001, Q043

  - 8:60 「荒田集落は800年前の昔」 against 祀耀800年 as the story present. The text does not connect them. Do not connect them.
  - 8:103 「子供が16歳にならないと集落に根を下ろすことは許されない」 — 春花 is 17 in the story present. The text does not draw the conclusion. Do not draw it.
  - 16:40 「なつみちゃんはそのハエみたくなるかもね」 — the threat is made by reference, not stated. Keep the indirection.

## 000009FE  (order 86)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. Most of the file is her telling a 怪談 aloud: sustained 丁寧 (です・ます) with NO 「」, opened and closed inside 「」
- time markers: 「10年ほど前に中学生だった女の子」 (11:18); 「A子が中学2年のゴールデンウィーク」 (11:23); 「――夜23時」 (11:26); 「――それから5分ほど走ると」 (11:47); 「事件が公になったのはゴールデンウィーク明け」 (43:0)
- events:
  - なつみ takes 『モトキザクラ様』, the story 美冬 was about to tell. Frame: an 元木町 urban legend with as many versions as tellers, because there is one モトキザクラ様 per cherry tree in the town. All identical in appearance — a beautiful woman in a cherry-patterned kimono. Most are guardians, which is why the town has little crime; a few are malign, and they cannot be told apart (11:0-11:17)
  - the story: a middle-school girl, called A子, from a family that worships them. Golden Week family trip, four people, leaving at night, 23:00, over the flat summit of 元木山 (11:18-11:29)
  - a woman in a cherry-patterned kimono on the road. The father identifies her, offers a lift and pushes her into the car by the back (11:30-11:44)
  - she asks to be set down five minutes later, bows, and climbs a rocky slope that turns out to have a narrow stone stair, vanishing into the dark. The family follow to pray at what they take to be her dwelling (11:48-11:63)
  - at the top, a small 祠. The mother leads the prayer, which ends in five invented syllable-words (11:70-11:77)
  - A子 then notices an old notice board beside it: never touch, never speak to, never pray to THIS モトキザクラ様. They have done all three (11:81-11:89)
  - going down, the stair never ends; looking back, the summit and the 祠 are a few steps above them. They turn back up, and the notice board now carries two different lines: never climb a stair you came down, never descend a stair you climbed (11:92-11:107)
  - the woman comes up past them and her kimono touches A子's hand. Three of the prohibitions are quoted back as bare cells against the family's pleading, and a fourth line answers them: 「あなたたちは私のお友達。」 (11:108-31:1)
  - her face fills with countless eyes and the cherry pattern turns to bloodstains. The family run down the stair they climbed, and the prohibition they are breaking is spelled one character per cell (35:0-39:16)
  - after Golden Week the car is found abandoned at the summit and the four are missing. Rumour: four unnaturally grown cherry trees and four sets of clothes beside the car (43:0-43:2)
  - the moral: do not touch, speak to or press your hands together for one, and do not go back the way you came; pray silently instead (43:3-43:7)
  - 春花 asks how it links to 美冬's story; なつみ improvises that a benign one was helping the dead schoolgirl deliver her message, and the narration calls her own answer 「適当な回答」 (43:10-43:13)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 新村春花; inside the story A子, her father, her mother, モトキザクラ様
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 祠, 立札, 都市伝説, 守護神, 悪霊, 妖怪, 石段, ご利益, 着物, A子, タレサロ・コニラク・サハン・イウユ・キンケ
- voice/relationship changes: なつみ gets a STORYTELLER register — the first time she performs rather than narrates. It is plainer and more formal than her own narration and it has no ellipses. Her ordinary narration cuts back in twice (11:6-11:7, 43:12) and must be audibly different.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:

  - 39:0-39:16 one character per cell, seventeen cells. -> Q157

The rite means releasing the dead from under the ground and returning them to the sky; something great is said to sleep down there. ## 00000A94  (order 92)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense, with 新村美冬's first-person account inset from 11:89

  - on 祀耀790年四月一七日 she made the report. The grandmother said breaking the 掟 is punishable, 美冬 offered to take all of it, and the grandmother waved it away cheerfully. Moments later サクラ had already run: she had overheard the confession and not the pardon (11:127-11:141)

  - エリカ turns back and points at one entry: 新村桔梗, born 祀耀六六三年一〇月二五日, died 祀耀七三五年二月一日, 病死. The only person in the book who did not die in April. She was the 大魔女 two before エリカ and also came in from outside (11:12-11:21)
  - 五島 keeps her because anything after 710 counts, and argues that the April curse did not take 桔梗, so there must have been a condition. Nobody alive knows. 春花 calls it a dead end (11:22-11:34)
  - エリカ closes the evening: the 十三回忌 goes ahead, be at the meeting hall by 10:00. 美冬 tells them not to feel obliged (11:37-11:40)
  - the four open questions are listed as bare bullet cells (11:41-11:44)
  - the three girls sit in the bath in silence. なつみ tells 春花 she will be watching over her at 75; 春花 laughs it off, says it means she gets to live that long, and tells なつみ not to die before then either (11:45-11:68)
  - 五島 shouts that she has it, drags everyone out of the bath, and lays out her reasoning: a culprit always has a purpose, so the nine killings are not habit. Killing is the means; the pattern is the means to something else; and the purpose lies beyond the pattern (11:69-11:114)
  - she then declares 「私は天才少女です」 in earnest, says the culprit is far cleverer than she is, and that nine years without a discernible purpose is beyond her understanding. なつみ has never heard her concede this (11:117-11:131)
  - 春花 tells her to sleep; 五島 snaps back that she will not let another person die or let エリカ grieve more. She sends them to bed (11:133-11:145)
  - 春花 leaves and comes back with 幸太郎, woken from sleep and still smelling of drink, as 「強力な助っ人」 (11:146-11:158)
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈, 新村エリカ, 古郡なつみ, 新村春花, 新村美冬, 新村幸太郎
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 新村桔梗, 年表, 集会場
- voice/relationship changes: 五島 concedes that someone is cleverer than she is, for the first time in the project, and says the 天才少女 label straight rather than as a gag. Her DETECTIVE mode reaches its longest sustained run and the 作戦 gag does not appear once.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 11:41-11:44 four bullet cells beginning 「・」, not speech and not narration prose.
  - 11:16 the 住民簿 entry again with kanji numerals and ⏎. -> Q163
  - 11:118 「私は天才少女です」 said with no joke attached, two cells after 春花 and なつみ both treat it as one. -> Q098
  - 11:56 「いや、逆に考えれば、75歳までは生きられるってことか？　ははは！」 — 春花 comforts herself with her own death date. Do not make it sound brave.
- resolves from earlier files: 000002F6:11:53 and 000006F9:11:3 (the 天才少女 label as a complex and as a gag) -> said seriously, to concede a limit. ACTION: revisit y. -> Q098

## 00000AC4  (order 94)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense, with 新村幸太郎's 俺 first-person account inset at 19:24-19:43
- time markers: none beyond 「あの時」 in the inset account; 「あの崖から下へ行くには5分はかかる」 (19:40)
- events:
  - 幸太郎 reads 五島's notes, lists the four dates back at her, and sits down. He offers to teach them how to think about it first (11:0-11:16)
  - the frame: 起承転結. He asks which of the four matters most. 春花 says 結 (the purpose), 五島 says 承 (the present, so it can be stopped), なつみ says 起. He says 起, for this case only (11:17-11:44)
  - why: without 起 there is no case, and if 起 is misidentified everything after it is wrong. Then: when did the case begin? Nobody can answer, and he says that is the point — it is not even settled that the killings are a case, because some of the settlement genuinely believe in the curse (11:46-11:64)
  - he invites them to treat him as the culprit, since he is the obvious suspect, and says he will not interrupt (11:68-11:74)
  - 五島 obliges: サクラ fell but was not fatally hurt; he could not forgive her breach and finished her; then invented the curse and killed one a year so her death would look like part of it. 春花 objects that 美冬 caused the breach and would have been killed too (11:77-11:106)
  - なつみ changes the angle and asks whether サクラ was actually dead when he found her (11:114-11:120)
  - his answer is one indented bare cell: 「　　生きていたよ。」 (15:0)
  - 春花 grabs him by the shoulder; 五島 points out that being alive does not prove he finished her; なつみ insists on continuing because 起 is not fixed yet (19:0-19:19)
  - his account, in 俺: he found サクラ standing on the cliff about to jump. He shouted that his mother is not that narrow and that she was not being blamed. サクラ asked twice whether it was true. As he came closer she suddenly went limp and slid over the edge, as if pulled by something invisible. It takes five minutes to get to the bottom; by the time he did, her head was already off her body (19:20-19:43)
  - 春花 calls it impossible; 五島 says it is probably not a lie, because a liar would simply have said she was dead when found (19:44-19:52)
  - 幸太郎 then asks なつみ a question of his own, and the file ends on a separate block: 「四月病って知ってるよね？」 (19:53-23:0)
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花, 古郡なつみ; inside the account 新村サクラ
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 起承転結, 序破急, 序論本論結論
- voice/relationship changes: 幸太郎's TEACHING register is new — he asks one question per turn, waits, and names the answer. It is his only extended scene and it replaces the 「はっはっは！」 entirely; he laughs once and it is a 苦笑い. New RELATIONS rows 幸太郎 -> 五島 / なつみ.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 15:0 「　　生きていたよ。」 — an indented bare cell, the fifth of this shape in two chunks. -> Q158
  - 11:17-11:67 and 00000ADE:11:47 use 起承転結, 序破急 and 序論本論結論 as reasoning terms, and 『起』『承』『転』『結』 recur singly in 『』 for about 100 cells. -> Q166
  - 19:36-19:38 「まるで、見えない何かに引き寄せられるように」 — the only description of the fall, and it is a simile. Do not upgrade it to a fact.
  - 19:18 「　くそ……！」 — a leading full-width space inside the 「」. -> Q010
  - 11:85 「その辺も考えてもらいんだ」 — a dropped character in the source.
- resolves from earlier files: 00000A62:19:6-19:8 (幸太郎 found the body, no blood at the top) -> he found her alive on the cliff first, which the earlier telling omitted. ACTION: revisit y.

## 00000ADE  (order 95)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. She is killed at 11:142 and narrates her own death through to 11:169
- time markers: none in the present; 「この10年で10人も死んだ」 (11:32)
- events:
  - 四月病: なつみ half-remembers always falling ill in blossom season. 幸太郎 says サクラ had the same thing, that it is what made her go limp on the cliff, and that she was standing there waiting for it rather than finding the nerve to jump (11:0-11:16)
  - 五島 draws a timeline. There are too many candidates for 起 and each could equally be 承 (11:17-11:29)
  - 荒田's population is under twenty. The ten 呪殺 dead got no memorial service, because there is a 掟 against touching a 死神 killed by the curse (11:32-11:36)
  - なつみ proposes that there is no 起承転結 at all — that the events are simply unconnected (11:41-11:47)
  - 五島 counters that 75-plus suicide was known about for decades, and なつみ then shouts the real hole: why did nobody in 荒田 ever stop them? 春花 backs her — the grandmother and 幸太郎 would have watched every 75-year-old each April (11:48-11:64)
  - 幸太郎 will not answer. 五島 asks the other unasked question: is サクラ really dead? He says 「サクラは死んでいるよ。／た、確かに死んでいる……」 and なつみ takes the phrasing apart: 確かに normally precedes an adversative, and 死んでいる is what you say with a body in front of you, not 死んだ (11:71-11:97)
  - 夏菜 walks in saying 「パパ……」 and collapses. A long cut from a 鉈-like blade across her back. She says 「お姉ちゃんが……／裏切った……」 (11:98-11:108)
  - 茅萱 comes in, injured and barely conscious, holding a bloodied 鉈, says 「みんな……ごめんね……／こうするしかないの……」, raises it, and is cut down from behind by someone else (11:118-11:132)
  - three untagged lines — 「――いたぞ」 「――殺せ」 「――呪いを持ち込む魔女だ」 — and masked figures in the same dress as the grave file file into the room and bring 鉈 and メイス down on なつみ (11:133-11:141)
  - her death narration: the first blow takes her senses; she registers being cut repeatedly without pain; she remembers that the 呪殺 victims had their heads crushed in one blow and cannot tell whether hers was; she wonders about the drug and about whether 春花 and 五島 are alive; the last thing in her mind is the grammar of 確かに死んでいる, and the last thing under it is 「せめて……／どうして私がこんな目に遭わないといけないのか……／教えて……。」 (11:142-11:169)
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 古郡なつみ, 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花, 新村夏菜, 新村茅萱, unnamed masked figures
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: (none new; 四月病, 鉈, メイス, 能面, 掟 already in GLOSSARY)
- voice/relationship changes: なつみ's death narration is a sixth mode for her — flat, curious, and grammatical to the last cell. No fear words, no grief words, and the closing three cells are the only plea she makes anywhere. Do not raise the temperature.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 11:85-11:97 and 11:161-11:164 the whole scene and the whole death turn on 「確かに死んでいる」 versus 「死んだ」, which is a Japanese aspect distinction English cannot carry with "is dead" / "died". It is the clue and it is repeated verbatim at the end. -> Q168
  - 11:133-11:135 three 「――」-prefixed lines from unseen speakers. -> Q169, Q047
  - 11:139 「魔女って……誰のこと？」 — the masked figures call someone a 魔女 and the text never says who they mean.
  - 11:107-11:108 「お姉ちゃんが……／裏切った……」 — a wounded child's two cells, and the file never tests them.
  - the file is a death end. Orders 90-95 are one branch; 00000AF7 restarts the same night. -> Q054, Q024
- resolves from earlier files: 000001DB:15:32 and the whole 四月病 thread -> a second person had it, and it is presented as a physical event that makes people collapse. ACTION: revisit y. -> Q009. 00000A62:19:4 (「十分な致命傷だった」) -> contradicted by 幸太郎 at 00000AC4:19:22-19:23 and by 四月病 here. ACTION: revisit y.

## 00000AF7  (order 96)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. The file reopens the night of 00000A62 with the same two lines
- time markers: 「明日、祀耀800年の四月八日は満月です」 (11:1); 「ここから1時間くらいかかる」 (11:37); 「夏菜ちゃんは今10歳」 / 「亡くなったのは10年前」 (11:101)
- events:
  - in this branch 夏菜 comes along and leads, calling out every root and puddle for 五島 (11:2-11:7)
  - she vanishes, ambushes them with 「ばああ！！！」, and then goes through the trees like a flying squirrel. 五島 analyses it as parkour and says it is trainable. 夏菜 says only she and her sister can do it, that everyone else is old, and that she walks an hour to school and knows a shortcut faster than a car (11:9-11:38)
  - she takes them off the path to her secret base: a cave mouth in a rock face, a room the size of four and a half tatami with a split in the roof letting moonlight in, sweet wrappers and drink cans in the corner and an old goza on the floor (11:39-11:84)
  - all four lie down in a circle with their heads together and look at the moon. The base was used by her mother as a child, passed to 茅萱, passed to her; her mother probably inherited it too (11:85-11:95)
  - 夏菜 says she feels safe there, that she does not remember her mother, and that it feels as if she is being watched over kindly from the sky (11:98-11:100)
  - 五島 asks what her mother was like; 春花 says サクラ, and that she still thinks of her as a goddess, that the goddess in the dream in her ghost story looked somewhat like her, and that her face is 茅萱's face now (11:104-11:110)
  - 夏菜 says she comes there to meet her mother, that it is her own place, and that her sister is in Tokyo and her father and grandmother are adults; she is glad they came and sorry they leave the day after tomorrow (11:111-11:127)
  - 五島 offers to be her older sister for the visit. 夏菜 throws herself on her and coins 「エリ姉」. 春花 puts チガ姉 and エリ姉 side by side (11:128-11:143)
  - なつみ closes on wondering what having an older sister would have been like (11:145-11:148)
- speakers present: 新村夏菜, 古郡なつみ, 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 秘密基地, ほら穴, ゴザ, エリ姉, ムカデ競争, 四畳半, くノ一, パルクール, ムササビ, ばああ, っしょっと, ぴょこぴょこ, がばっと
- voice/relationship changes: 夏菜's ONLY quiet register in the project, ten cells of it, with no echoing, no stacked questions and no adult vocabulary. 五島 takes the older-sister role deliberately and explains why at 00000A48:32:7. New RELATIONS rows 夏菜 -> 五島 (エリ姉).
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 11:22-11:23 「くノ一、くノ一！／あーれー！　おやめになってー！」 — a ten-year-old quoting a stock period-drama line. -> Q170
  - 11:137-11:139 「エリ姉」 coined on screen, the same kin-suffix shape as チガ姉. -> Q171, Q137
  - 11:101-11:102 「夏菜ちゃんは今10歳」 and 「亡くなったのは10年前」 — なつみ concludes サクラ died just after the birth, which 00000A7C shows is wrong by about eight months. Keep her wrong.
  - 11:125 「みんな明後日には帰っちゃんだよね」 — a dropped character in the source.

## 00000B0F  (order 97)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. The rite and the 住民簿 scene are summarised in narration rather than played
- time markers: 「――15分ほど経って」 (11:0); 「祀耀793年から795年の四月」 (11:32); 「私は71歳だけど」 (11:98)
- events:
  - the rite happens off the page in four cells. 夏菜 hugs 茅萱 straight afterwards, breaking the silence rule, and エリカ waives it and walks everybody home together (11:0-11:12)
  - the same information as orders 90-93 is delivered in summary: the 女ケ沢 attempted killing, サクラ's fall and decapitation, the annual 呪殺, the 住民簿, the old people's suicides, and why they were invited (11:13-11:19)
  - 茅萱 says the atmosphere in 荒田 gets worse every time she comes home, because the killer is one of them (11:21-11:28)
  - 祀耀793-795: 幸太郎 asked to be watched in the meeting hall through April to prove his innocence; three years of it, and the killings continued, which cleared him (11:30-11:36)
  - なつみ raises the possibility that the culprit is more than one person or all of them. エリカ excludes 茅萱, who was in Tokyo in years when it still happened; 五島 adds that a same-day round trip without being noticed is not workable and that 茅萱 has an alibi every night; 茅萱 adds that she cannot drive (11:42-11:56)
  - なつみ privately notes 茅萱 was 11 at the first killing and can do what 夏菜 can do, and refuses to make that a conclusion (11:57-11:62)
  - エリカ explains why nobody leaves: leaving means abandoning those who stay, and the 標語 holds even through the mistrust. She will consider the police after tomorrow's 法要; some of the settlement oppose it because calling the police would bring the curse on everyone (11:72-11:84)
  - なつみ lists the three conditions the killings need — believing it is a curse, staying in 荒田, not calling the police — and cannot find the purpose behind them (11:85-11:95)
  - she then asks the 00000ADE question in this branch: why was nobody stopped? エリカ answers that she gave the order that nobody was to be stopped, because the previous 大魔女 told her never to stop a person taking their own life, and swears 茅萱 and 美冬 to silence before saying the rest (11:96-11:122)
  - the rest is thin: there was never anyone who tried to stop them, because those who do it have reason enough. Pressed, she gives the one instance she was told — shortly after 桔梗 died there was a 呪殺 in the settlement, and the victims were 桔梗's family. That is all she was told (11:123-11:137)
  - 五島 completes it: 桔梗 did not die in April, so she was judged an outsider, and the settlement killed her family as outsiders too. エリカ confirms that those victims' register entries were all erased (11:138-11:143)
  - なつみ draws the rule: dying in April is the proof of being 荒田. 五島 then explains the suicides — the old killed themselves so that their families would not be judged outsiders, at an age where sudden death was plausible (11:144-11:161)
  - エリカ accepts it and says she had avoided thinking about it because thinking was itself a breach of her promise (11:162-11:165)
  - 五島's conclusion: the suicides and the nine 呪殺 are unrelated, and the killer simply matched an existing local pattern. A deliberate misdirection (11:169-11:172)
  - なつみ closes on not quite believing it: the register may not be complete and the suicide explanation was invented in the room (11:175-11:181)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 新村エリカ, 新村春花, 五島絵梨奈, 新村茅萱, 新村夏菜
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 部外者, すやすや, くう
- voice/relationship changes: エリカ admits she gave a standing order that cost fifty years of lives, in her own plain register with no softening. New RELATIONS rows 夏菜 <-> 茅萱 in this branch.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - 11:76 「1人はみんなのために、みんな1人のために。」 — the 標語 with a particle missing against 00000A30:11:103. -> Q174 (owner)
  - 11:119 「ん……分かったわ」⏎「分かりました」 — two speakers in one cell. -> Q044
  - 11:51-11:52 「毎日バイトかコン……／いえ、人と一緒にいる生活をしてますから」 — 五島 begins 合コン and corrects herself in front of 茅萱's family. Keep the self-censor.
  - 11:124-11:125 「自殺する者には、それだけの理由があるから、誰も止めない……」 — なつみ's reaction is that this is not enough to be worth a vow of silence, and the file never fully closes that.
  - 11:147 「桔梗さん以前の人たちは四月に殺されたのではなく、本当に四月に自然死した」 — a deduction, hedged with 「だろう」. Keep the hedge.

## 00000B27  (order 98)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense
- time markers: 「明日の十三回忌」 (11:2); 「20人もいないだろうな……。10年間で10人死んだ」 (11:5); 「こんな夜中」 (11:36)
- events:
  - after the bath they go over it again. Under twenty people left and ten dead in ten years, so 荒田 disappears inside twenty years. なつみ proposes that erasing the settlement is the purpose (11:0-11:12)
  - 五島 will not sign up to it: killing everyone at once would be quicker, and burning the crops, the hunting gear or the houses would empty the place without killing anyone. なつみ answers that the サクラ-curse framing only makes sense if people die (11:13-11:30)
  - 春花 suggests phoning なつみ's parents, since 女ケ沢 is why she was invited (11:32-11:38)
  - 古郡良治 answers at once, sober, and the sound of paper being got ready comes down the line. なつみ notes he seems to have been expecting the call and explains it to herself (11:43-11:53)
  - on speaker she reports what she knows, keeping the 呪殺 out of it. He asks very few questions (11:55-11:59)
  - he confirms 美冬 was ill and coerced them into killing two children, and that she supplied an instruction sheet and weapons. 五島 asks what else; he adds the 能面 and the red vestments (11:60-11:66)
  - 五島 objects that a 能面 is the opposite of a disguise and would identify 荒田 at once. 春花 reads it as サクラ sabotaging the plan; 五島 counters that sending the weapons contradicts that (11:69-11:78)
  - he then says there was also a drug, injected, said to release the brain's limiter and give full use of the muscles (11:79-11:84)
  - 五島 on the limiter: people use about 20% of their strength, emergencies loosen it, and that is 火事場の馬鹿力; a woman lifting a car, nowhere near what 夏菜 was doing. Running about unseen would destroy bone and muscle, and the limiter exists to protect the body (11:88-11:96)
  - 良治 adds that the drug came with written instructions — not full power, 80% at most, and only briefly. なつみ starts to work out that whoever wrote that is not サクラ (11:97-11:106)
  - screaming down the line: 「なんだお前ら！／茜、早く逃げろ！」 and 「良治君ダメ！　裏も囲まれてる！」, then 「なつみ！　早くそこから逃げろ！　すぐに荒田から逃げ出すんだ！」, then the sound of blades and blunt weapons on flesh (11:107-11:113)
  - two unfamiliar voices: 「知花の 仇 ……！」 and 「サクラちゃんをよくも……！」 (11:114-11:117)
  - the house wakes. エリカ takes the phone and demands to know who is there. A voice answers 「大魔女様。呪殺事件の犯人を始末できました」 and the line goes to a busy tone (11:127-11:145)
  - 幸太郎 identifies the voice as 城崎 (11:146-11:148)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花, 古郡良治, 古郡茜, 新村エリカ, 新村幸太郎, 新村夏菜, 新村美冬, 新村茅萱, unnamed attackers, 城崎
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 知花, ドンキ, ゆらゆら, ぞろぞろ, ばたり
- voice/relationship changes: 良治 and 茜 speak for the first and last time in this branch, and their address forms are unchanged from twelve and twenty years earlier (茜 -> 「良治君」, 良治 -> 「茜」 and 「なつみ」). New RELATIONS rows for all three, plus 城崎's group -> 大魔女様.

  - 11:113 「鉈やドンキで」 — ドンキ where the rest of the project has 鈍器. Apparent source typo; do not silently correct. -> Q172
  - 11:116 「知花の 仇 ……！」 — 知花 appears nowhere else in the project, reading unknown, referent unknown. -> Q173

## 00000B6F  (order 101)
- narrator: 五島絵梨奈 (私), past tense. Almost the whole file is interior reasoning with no dialogue
- time markers: none
- events:
  - 春花 has gone after her mother; 五島 puts 夏菜 into the futon beside the sleeping なつみ and holds her, copying what 春花 did (11:0-11:10)
  - her reading of the case: not a curse, a person; one who plans for every branch rather than one line, or is quick enough not to need to; who encircles people psychologically and has others act for him (11:11-11:16)
  - she names her hypothesis in a bare cell — 「――新村幸太郎」 — and says she hates this kind of criminal above all others (11:17-11:29)
  - 夏菜 clings to her in her sleep; 五島 thinks through what an arrest would do to her and concludes every outcome is sad (11:30-11:46)
  - the recursion: if she is reasoning inside the culprit's expectations then noticing that is also inside them; past suspects were equally played. She stops the loop by treating the awareness itself as progress (11:47-11:68)
  - method: a crime has a purpose, so work backwards from 『結』 rather than from 『起』; 起承転結 is a reader's order, not a criminal's; a criminal wants 起結 at most 起承結 and never 転 (11:69-11:95)
  - hypothesis 1, that killing なつみ's parents was the 『結』: possible but roundabout, and it requires 幸太郎 to have had precognition. She reaches this by remembering that なつみ's ability came from being covered in 新村栄一郎's blood, and asks what would follow if 幸太郎 had been covered in blood too (11:96-11:132)
  - hypothesis 2, the drug: it must work by releasing the brain's limiter via adrenaline and noradrenaline on the sympathetic nervous system — a doping agent. If サクラ sent it she was accelerating a murder, not preventing one, so the culprit slipped it into the parcel. That links 女ケ沢 to the 呪殺 (11:133-11:160)
  - the hole: why make 美冬 kill at all, and why did サクラ send the weapons? She invents a short two-line exchange between サクラ and 幸太郎 to test it, and gets no further (11:161-11:181)
  - she wakes なつみ and 夏菜 because she needs material (11:182-11:188)
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈, 新村夏菜 (four short lines)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: ミスリード, 未必の故意, 交感神経, よしよし
- voice/relationship changes: her DETECTIVE mode with no audience at all — 188 cells, no 作戦 gag, no pastiche, no 「」 except four lines from a half-asleep child. The 起承転結 framework she was taught by the man she is now accusing is the tool she uses to accuse him. -> Q166

  - 11:18 「――新村幸太郎」 set alone with a leading dash and no verb. Do not add one
  - 11:126 「『未必の故意』として」 — a legal term used in scare quotes by a 15-year-old, about a friend
  - 11:172-11:177 five cells of invented dialogue in 「」 between two people, one of them dead, presented as a hypothetical. The text says 「例えば、2人の間でこのような会話があったとすれば――」 once, at the top, and never marks the end. -> Q095

  - エリカ takes his arm off with a nata, says 「やっぱり、10年前のことは間違いだったんだよ」, and he says 「サクラ……」 twice and stops. Cherry blossom falls where there is none (11:322-11:340)

## 00000C21  (order 108)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense. The first thirteen cells are narration summarising what 茅萱 said rather than her speech

  - 茅萱 and 美冬 believe 幸太郎 is the culprit, because he pushed both daughters to fight with 鉈 and メイス. なつみ privately thinks that alone is thin. 茅萱 asked 美冬 for help and 美冬 brought in なつみ's parents (11:0-11:10)
  - なつみ's precognition has not worked since she entered the mountain, because there is only one cherry tree in 荒田. So it may not have been her ability she was called for (11:11-11:16)

  - 五島 sums up the failure of coordination: エリカ meant to tell them about the 呪殺 and told nobody she meant to; 美冬 meant to keep it from them (11:23-11:26)

  - 五島 turns to サクラ's precognition as the reason なつみ was called. サクラ's trigger was confirmed; there is no story about how she got it and no blood; the single cherry tree is dying of old age; the rest were dug up and taken about seventy years ago by outsiders, a variety found only around 荒田 (11:58-11:80)
  - 五島 says 「Que droga」 as an aside and 茅萱's voice jumps an octave: ドローガ is a special drug once made in 荒田, first made five hundred years ago, said to let a human use 100% of their strength (11:84-11:93)
  - 五島 asks them all to behave normally in front of 幸太郎, says she can see the outline but will not say it, and warns that 荒田 testimony will contradict itself very slightly (11:94-11:127)

## 00000E7B  (order 132)
- narrator: 五島桃子 (私), 24, four years after her sister's death — a narrator who has never held a file before. THREE narration states in one file: 11:1-11:20 has NO narrator at all (radio traffic, 「――」 for the ground side); 11:21-11:155 is です・ます addressed directly to 「あなた」, the reader, with two numbered questions put to them, and it drops into plain-form 私 narration at ~11:156 with no marker -> Q230; 215:0-227:20 switches to 五島絵梨奈 (私), four years earlier, with no frame and no return -> Q245
- time markers: 「祀耀804年四月八日、午前6:32――。」 (11:0); 「祀耀800年四月八日――。私の妹は、この日に死んだのだ。」 (11:184); 「今日は、祀耀804年四月七日。」 (11:187); 「時計を見ると、ちょうど正午。」 (28:202); 「13時、荒田駅に到着。」 (34:0); 「時刻は15時。四月初旬だというのに、25度はありそうだ。」 (34:289); 「――20時を過ぎた。」 (60:0); 「20時半――。」 (68:38); 「祀耀800年4月8日　23:50」 and 「祀耀800年4月9日　0:05」 (227:14-15)
- events:
  - [11] a search helicopter over 荒田 at dawn on 祀耀804年四月八日 reports the fire out by itself, the settlement burnt to the ground, no people, then one woman in her early twenties lying spread-eagled in a clearing. The crew's answer to 「生きているか？」 stops at 「どう見ても……」 (11:0-11:20)
  - [11] the direct address: question one, your oldest memory. Hers is a newborn girl at her mother's friend's house when she was one or two; she wanted a sister from that day, named a doll 『ルーシー人形』 えりな years before the sister existed, buried the doll in the garden, and the sister was born when she was four and given that name — 絵梨奈. The sister outgrew her, she took it as a threat, pushed her away in high school, and the sister died before they made it up (11:21-11:119)
  - [11] question two, revenge. She separates 復讐 from 仕返し by timescale, states that hers is to destroy 荒田集落, and lists what she bought with several million yen of runaway savings — detectives, informants, yakuza — and what is in her bag: a handgun and one gross (144) of 9mm rounds for a population of about thirty. Her conscience appears as a tumour she tracks as benign or malignant for the rest of the file. She is on the last train; she left her planning notebook on her desk and is embarrassed about it (11:120-11:212)
  - [28] 豊岳駅, twenty minutes between trains. She recaps her research: 古郡なつみ's spring illness, 新村栄一郎's blood, ドローガ made from the roots of the cherry native to 荒田, 第一世代 and 第二世代, the cult's human experiments, the danger sense. A woman collapses on the platform; she carries her to a bench. The woman and her daughter have brownish hair and blue eyes, the girl blue and green. They are going to 荒田駅 too; she gives her cover story, they invite her to stay, and she accepts because one house is more efficient. On the empty train she draws the ability's conditions out of them and sets a deadline of nightfall (28:0-28:232)
  - [34] 13:00, 荒田駅. 荒田地区 is 所属未定地 — state land in no prefecture and no municipality, said to be the only such place in the country. Two men meet them with buggies; one buggy is broken, so the girl runs the mountain road on foot at buggy speed. Asked her name she starts 「あ、五島……」 and substitutes 「藤野桃子です」 -> Q232. Riding pillion she twice puts a hand on the gun and twice does not draw it; the driver stops for a bear, shoots it, and the girl kills the cub with a 鉈 and hands it over. 桃子 loses her temper about the cub and is given the settlement's hunting rule (34:0-34:249)
  - [34] the 新村 house, one enormous cherry tree, the only cherry in the settlement. A fifteen-minute tour; she asks why there is only one tree and gets no answer. Fishing for her real target she uses the name 美冬 before anyone has said it, and the girl notices (34:250-34:353)
  - [40/44/48] the girl walks her into a cave — her 秘密基地 — and trades secrets: she will leave the settlement before she turns fifteen on 八月一日, because 「ママを殺すんです」 (44:0). Her sister's eyes went from odd to both blue right after the first 女ケ沢市事件, and her sister had wanted to kill their mother and was shut underground. She smells the gunpowder in the bag, names the gun, and offers help. 桃子 confesses everything, is told to shoot her in the back, cannot, and is read out loud: her eyes are the cub's eyes, not a killer's. The revenge goes and grief arrives in its place (40:0-48:314)
  - [54] dusk. The girl gets a stomach ache and runs; 桃子 works out what it is and says nothing. Sitting in the dark three-mat room for a reading, 桃子 constructs a 予知のループ hypothesis about two danger-sensers aimed at each other, dismisses it, and gives her real name. The mother answers that the 元凶 of the 元木町 killings is herself, that she knows who killed 絵梨奈, and that the killer and her daughter are up the mountain. The sun goes; the prediction fires; the girl comes through the door, strangles her mother, begs to be shot, and throws herself out of the window. The father runs past and out (54:0-54:324)
  - [60/64] 20:00, search parties out. The mother explains it: the elder daughter went the same way and was cured with ファルシフィカソ, a drug from the same cherry roots that she has never heard called ドローガ; the seizure only comes after 初潮 and only in resonance with her own danger sense; the cure only works after the seizure. 女ケ沢市事件 was the safety test for it, run on a woman who had asked her for help killing two children. A revived 掟 is quoted: 「緑の目の子供が生まれたら、速やかに殺せ」「さもなくば、その子はやがて集落を滅ぼすことになる」, and the killings such a child does are called — 「呪殺、と」 (64:0)
  - [68/72] 20:30. Boarded window, blanket, gun with the silencer on, two people breathing in a dark room. A call from the father; the mother predicts him killed by many people and the line dies. The animals have stopped calling across the whole area, which she reads as 殺気 spread out in every direction; 桃子 works out that the settlement is hunting the girl and the father is in the way. The girl appears in the doorway, the light goes on, and mother and daughter are holding each other: both eyes blue, the drug given. Then 「パパが……」 / 「殺された」 (72:0)
  - [82] the END of this line, dawn, and it is narrated backwards from the clearing: she is lying in the 墓地広場 with an empty gun and about thirty dead, eight TV-news sentences in straight double quotes cutting in one at a time -> Q238. After the mother was cut open in front of her she felt an unbearable urge to kill, shot the girl and 新村春花 through the head, felt pleasure, and concluded that a 第二世代's blood on you makes you need to kill anyone else who took the same blood. She killed everyone she could see, then walked into the burning settlement and shot 新村美冬. A bear cub runs past her. She cites 津山三十人殺し, shoots herself, and the last hundred cells are the bullet travelling: apologies to the girl, the mother, 春花 and last her sister, then hellfire, then 「絵梨奈……／大好きだよ。」 (82:0-82:296)
  - [88-104] the same night, continued rather than summarised: they find the father bleeding against a tree; he hands over two syringes — pink for ten minutes at the human limit, clear to escape 呪殺 — and dies mid-sentence into an empty 「」 cell (88:84) -> Q237. 死神たち surround them; 新村春花 arrives down the mountain and cuts every attacker's legs in one pass, then apologises to 桃子 for her mother in です・ます. A 死神 opens the mother's back while she is embracing her husband's body; the blood lands on 桃子's face, then on 春花's and the girl's (92:0). 桃子 turns first, works out what she is, and shoots the other two before they turn (96:0-104:15). The crowd shouts 「この女、翠眼だ！」 -> Q233
  - [180] a second version of the same night from the point the girl comes back: about fifteen cells word-identical to [54]/[68], then the outcome reversed — twenty 死神 in 赤装束 with 鉈 and メイス ring the house, one comes through the upstairs window, 桃子 empties the magazine into two sets of legs, the girl knocks one out with a メイス, and all three escape in stripped vestments and masks after the mother scatters the crowd with an impression of the woman she has just seen knocked out -> Q244
  - [215-227] four years earlier, in 元木町, narrated by 五島絵梨奈: the flayed body in 中央公園 is 古郡先輩's father; 伊勢 agrees to help her find the killer; she runs for the police station, stops, and thinks 「先輩、早くこの町から逃げて……。」 Two board posts date it and name her: 五島絵梨奈（15）, 脳挫滅. Story order: [62] [66] [70] [74] (祀耀800, the massacre) -> [52] (four years later) -> [46] -> [40] -> [34] -> [91] -> [28] -> [22] -> [97] (祀耀804年5月) -> [16] (祀耀805 and then roughly ten years after that). The FIRST block printed is the LAST event in the file. -> Q253, Q096
- events:
  - [62]/[66]/[70]/[74] four short blocks recapping 祀耀800: a body in 中央公園 with the whole skin removed, named as 古郡先輩's father; the 祀耀788 newspaper item about a 花見客 falling from a cherry tree (新村栄一郎, 30); a 紙人形 conversation; then the room with three bodies in it — 新村先輩's mother bleeding from the head, 古郡先輩's mother with knives in the abdomen, 古郡先輩's head apart from her body. 新村春花's last lines to 五島 are reproduced (「私はお前も好きだ……だからきっと、お前も今日死ぬ」, 「さよなら、五島。お前だけでも、生き延びてくれ……」). 74:35-74:37 closes in the third person and jumps forward (74:0-74:37)
  - [52] 唖者 is defined, and how she became one: after the deaths she bit her tongue to kill herself, in a hospital, and was saved; she lost her voice and then the will to die. Three months in hospital, high school finished, no university and no job, a room and an online piecework contract. At 20 her employer offers a permanent post by email twice and she declines twice. In the neighbourhood 食堂 a couple call her 「あの口、食うためだけにあるんだな」; the owner defends her; she goes home and cries for the first time in years. Next morning she messages her mother 「私、家を出ます。」, leaves half her savings on the table and goes to Tokyo with a laptop (52:0-52:163)
  - [46] Tokyo. カレーハウス『Challenger』 and its 10kg curry: a TV crew is filming a champion who has just failed it with 2kg left. 五島 eats the 10kg in 28 minutes without difficulty, is interviewed on a notepad, and is scouted for a national contest by ディレクター鵜飼 of ジャポニカテレビ. The champion, 南崎しのり, says they have met before and cannot place her. On the train home 五島 identifies the feeling she has not had in years: 『勝ちたい』 (46:0-46:197)
  - [40] home, police at the door because her phone was off; her parents are angry and then delighted that she wants to do something. She enters. The 元木高校 board and then the whole town take it up; the 町長 sees her off at 元木駅. In Tokyo she is put on a bus with the other entrants and sits beside a pale woman with blue eyes who greets her in sign language — 新村茅萱. A TV trailer names the three favourites and gives 五島 a ring name, サイレントエンジェル. She searches 「新村茅萱」 and finds nothing (40:0-40:150)
  - [34] the night before, 渋谷: a steak house called 『謝肉館』 and its 5-pound challenge. She orders two, is given a 10-pound (4.6kg) steak plus 1kg of rice and 1kg of soup with a 60-minute limit, and finishes in 38 minutes against her own 30-minute target. She bows and cannot lift her head because she is crying. 茅萱 has been in the room the whole time; she points at a record card on the wall — 「新村茅萱　10ポンドステーキ　記録36分」 — says she followed her to measure her, and advises her not to spend herself in the heats (34:0-34:291)
  - [91] contest morning. On the bus 茅萱 shares an おにぎり and explains why. 五島 shuts her eyes and, for the first time in four years, reasons about 祀耀800 — and reaches a conclusion (see the ambiguity section). She then asks 茅萱 whether she knows a 新村春花; 茅萱's eyes open wide and she answers 「私の従妹。4年前に亡くなったけど……」, and the conversation is postponed. The heats: 100 entrants, a Chinese-restaurant set, and 豚まん from 点心の名店『太郎』, 200g each, thin-skinned and full of scalding soup (91:0-91:230)
  - [28] the heats themselves. She works out a knife-and-fork method, is copied by the whole table, and finishes 5th on 25 pieces when three go through. She goes home, and is messaged that the 3rd-placed 高野 has been stopped by a doctor and the final place is hers — 19:00 in 渋谷, unreachable by train. Her mother drags her to the television, where the town is on screen; the 町長 sends a helicopter and 伊勢大二郎 arrives with a patrol car to take her to the pad. She spends the flight calculating how much public money is being wasted on her and deciding she likes it (28:0-28:316)
  - [22] the final, on the closed 渋谷 crossing, broadcast live with the Metropolitan Police cooperating. She arrives by parachute. 南崎しのり tells her she has defended the title for four years for the sole purpose of a rematch. The event: 5升 (16.5kg) of plain rice in 60 minutes, weighed live, with 29 side dishes that do not count. Opening play: 南崎 drinks two non-alcoholic beers for the hops; 五島 copies her and cannot drink it (22:0-22:318)
  - [97] the final's second half. 南崎 overtakes; 五島 works out that the champion threw the curry challenge a week earlier to make her complacent. At around 9kg her stomach gives out and she puts her head down. The town's placard-holders and the steak-house waiter shout for her, both rivals glare at her, and she says 「勝……ち……たい……！」 under her breath — her first sound in four years — then snaps a chopstick and shouts 「か……わり……箸……下さ……い」 at the hall. Renamed エンジェルボイス on air. Final weights are read as rice removed from the cookers (南崎 9821, 茅萱 10221, 五島 10210 — an 11g loss), then re-read after the bowls are weighed (9801 / 10098 / 10150) and she wins. She thanks the crowd aloud and cannot stop crying (97:0-97:342)
  - [16] one year later she turns the permanent job down because 「夢ができたんです」, and flies to the United States with 茅萱. Years of team wins, prize money donated, then agricultural development work in many countries. Then Oslo: the Nobel Peace Prize, fourteen years after 四月八日, 茅萱 absent. Her acceptance speech tells the hall the whole of [52] and then refuses the compliment: she calls her charity 偽善, says she does it so that she will not lose her voice again, asks them not to be like her, and asks them to help whoever is in front of them. She reads out 茅萱's letter, which says 茅萱 is the person who caused her suffering and that had she reported her father in childhood the dead would have lived. Thin applause. Her closing private thought is that for all of it she can only see two people, and the block ends on three broken apologies (16:0-16:181)

## 00000EC7  (order 135)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), past tense, for the whole file. It continues 00000E95 in the same branch with no narrator change at the file boundary — the second clean continuation in the project. 283 lines, one row-block
- time markers: 「――時刻は21時を回った。」 (11:0); 「――部屋に戻ると、既に22時半になっていた。」 (11:261)
- events:
  - night at the inn: her father is drunk and asleep, her mother and 春花 are talking about 春花's other mother, so she goes to the baths alone and swims in the empty 大浴場, then moves to the 露天風呂 — sea sound, few lights, a full sky and a fattening half moon. She thinks about 五島, エリカ, 夏菜 and 城崎 under the same stars and wonders how the case ended (11:0-11:34)
  - a woman of about fifty gets in, smelling of drink, and talks to her. She comes every Golden Week, alone, and makes her living by fortune-telling. She notices the scar running from shoulder to chest and offers a reading, done by looking at the face only (11:35-11:66)
  - the reading, part one: なつみ has been fortunate, surrounded by people who love her, and it is not a miracle but something they won for themselves (11:67-11:79)
  - before the future, the woman talks about her own trade: people come to her already past saving, and all she can tell them is that everyone is under sentence and only the manner of the end is theirs to choose — 「悪くない人生だった。そう思えるよう、今できることを精一杯やってください」 (11:80-11:105)
  - prediction one: なつみ will lose one of the people she loves, possibly within a day or two. Asked whether it can be prevented, the woman asks whether it should be, if that is the end the person wants (11:106-11:131)
  - なつみ mentions 春花's father, and realises she feels she met him recently although he died twelve years ago. She asks the woman to look at what she has forgotten. The woman studies her, says she has seen an aura like hers once before in Tokyo on a young person who did not look Japanese, and that she told that person 「身近に騙す人がいるから気をつけなさい」. なつみ asks whether the person had blue-and-green odd eyes; the woman thinks so (11:132-11:162)
  - the woman's verdict: what なつみ has forgotten is tied to that odd-eyed woman; the two are very alike and yet of 「相容れない体質」; the forgetting is a defence instinct; she may remember, but what she then decides will change her own fate and everyone's. Specifically, what she has forgotten is that she must not learn the truth about a certain thing. なつみ recognises it, remembers the dream conversation and the promise she made there, and agrees out loud not to pursue the 呪殺事件 (11:163-11:197)
  - prediction two: one of the people she loves will lose something so large that they will lose themselves and shut into their own world for good, and なつみ will not be able to help them — only someone from 「私たちの世界とは違う世界の住人」 could give that person the courage to come out. The woman does not know what will be lost or why. She closes with 「当たるも八卦、当たらぬも八卦」 and 「いい人生を」 (11:198-11:260)
  - back in the room at 22:30: her father asleep, her mother asleep in front of the television, 春花 lying down watching it. 春花 reports that she and なつみ's mother have agreed to leave things as they are, looks at the sleeping woman and says 「この人が私を産んでくれたんだよな……」 and that having two mothers is somehow nice. Her phone rings; it is her other mother; three cells of listening and the file ends on 「は！？」 (11:261-11:282)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 新村春花, the unnamed 露天風呂の占い師
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 大浴場, 露天風呂, 当たるも八卦, 防衛本能, 相容れない体質, オーラ, 人生相談, アルマジロ, おや, どれ, えへ, ふーむ, ざぶん
- voice/relationship changes: なつみ uses 「お姉ちゃん」 for 春花 to a stranger, in the third person, one file after being forbidden the word (11:47). 春花 still calls 古郡茜 「おばさん」 (11:271), so the 00000E95 attempt at 「お母さん」 did not stick. New RELATIONS rows for 占い師↔なつみ, なつみ→春花 (3p お姉ちゃん), 春花→古郡茜.
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open:
  - the fortune-teller is very probably the 街角の占い師 of 00000A18 — near-identical opening move (「どれ、お嬢ちゃんを診てあげようかね」 against 「どれ、お姉さんを見てあげようか」), the same ～かね, the same refusal to charge, the same Tokyo odd-eyed client. Never stated, and 00000A18 is a story told inside a different branch -> Q274
  - 11:58-11:59 「どれ、お嬢ちゃんを診てあげようかね」 / 「見る……？」 — 診る and 見る are the same sound and なつみ hears the wrong one -> Q275
  - 11:150 「日本人だけど、日本人ぽくないような若い人」 — the person is never named and the gender is never stated
  - 11:236-11:244 the second prediction fits 五島絵梨奈's arc in 00000EAF exactly, in a different branch that this file cannot know about. Do not let EN hint -> Q276
  - 11:98 「人間と言うのは、神様から全員死刑を宣告されているんだ」 — 死刑 in a sense the glossary's "the death penalty" does not carry -> Q277
  - 11:279-11:282 the file ends inside a phone call, on 「は！？」, with nothing described. Second undescribed cliffhanger in the project -> Q278, Q222

ACTION: revisit n -> Q219. 00000E95:11:134-11:136 (春花's 「お父さん、お母さん」 attempt) -> now known not to have stuck; 春花 is back to おばさん at 11:271. ACTION: revisit n
## 00000EDF  (order 136)
- narrator: 五島絵梨奈, 私 (watashi). One narrator for all 3,080 lines, no switch anywhere. Plain past with long stretches of present-tense interior reasoning; two temperatures inside the one voice (see "ambiguity").
- time markers: 祀耀800年四月一一日 (65:122, the day of the funerals in the cold thread); 祀耀800年四月八日 (117:228, the day everything actually happens); 祀耀800年八月一日 (117:245, the epilogue); 祀耀342年 = 「460年くらい前」 (83:1, the date of the drug manual); 祀耀735年加筆 (83:57); 祀耀788年 = 「今からちょうど12年前の今日」 (111:0); 「4日前の四月八日」 (59:94); 「朝が来るまで、あと8時間」 (53:319); 「まだ朝の5時」 (89:63); 22:30 is not used here.
- events (printed block order; the story order is NOT this order, see Q286):
  - [33] Night, heavy rain at 荒田集落. The narrator phones her elder sister and cannot be sure the voice is really hers. The sister offers to drive out in a rental car and is told to just keep talking. (33:0-33:24)
  - [37] The call itself: 370 cells of pure two-voice dialogue with no narration and no speaker tags. Small talk about the rain and the dark; the narrator reports a dream of an eyeless woman who looks exactly like her and tries to gouge her eyes out; a torture-story game the sister begs her to stop; a request that, if she ever loses her eyes, the sister talk to her a lot; talk of the ten-year-old cousin; both sisters ask the other whether she is glad to be her sibling; the narrator uses her sister's given name for the first time and the sister says nobody has ever used it; boyfriend talk and a "catch and release" joke; a long invented-onomatopoeia routine about the sister's chest; the narrator names her dead 先輩 as the other person she was close to, says she was able to cry for her for the first time today, and admits her eye colour has changed and that she stole her sister's coloured lenses; grave-visit plans; then 「私……／お姉ちゃんが好き」, no answer, and goodnight. (37:0-37:370)
  - [41] The rain stops. The eyeless woman is there; the narrator says she is not afraid any more and refuses to be told why the woman has no eyes. (41:0-41:14)
  - [47] In the bath she works out the generations and who in the house belongs to which; overhears her friend's uncle being patched up by his wife after being beaten for an accidental peeping incident; the grandmother bursts in dressed and speaking as the narrator herself. (47:0-47:102)
  - [53] Evening. She leaves the sitting room with the case explained; a heavy, then suddenly funny, family dinner; alone in her room she watches rain on cherry petals, finds blood on a petal, and the eyeless woman returns: an argument about hallucination and reality, a knife pressed into her hand, and she stabs her 先輩 and then the ten-year-old; the woman tells her to cut her own eyes out and she begins; it snaps back to the room with her 先輩 beside her and no wound anywhere. Text messages with her sister about dinner tomorrow; a second exchange at night; her sister offers to phone. (53:0-53:338)
  - [59] The exposition scene, five people round a table: the grandmother names herself, gives the ten-year-old history of the elder cousin's attack on her mother and the underground confinement, and the three generations, their symptoms and their triggers are set out in full, with the chemistry; the uncle confesses that he sent the drug to the neighbour ten years ago as a safety test; the grandmother says she would have been the test subject; the wife argues that all life is equal and that he should have asked somebody; the elder cousin comes in, kneels, and dedicates her life abroad to strangers as restitution. (59:0-59:234)
  - [65] The COLD thread: the narrator, with a perfect and permanent version of the danger sense, evades the masked attacker, names her, tells her her dead husband is weeping, offers her flight, a fight or a confession, and lets her run away to burn herself; she wipes her friend's blood off her face and finds she feels nothing; she addresses the dead girl and thanks her for the power, ending 「あなたが死んでくれて……／私は最高に幸せです」; a long essay on money and on why people who get something large lose something large; the funerals, and her eyes itching. (65:0-65:132)
  - [71] Arrival at 荒田駅 for the wake, narrated cold: she performs grief, meets the cousins, changes into the mask and vestments, and hides her green eye with her sister's disposable coloured lens; the ten-year-old appears in the mirror with one green eye and one blue and is told a lie about an eye disease; the wake is a file of visitors past a covered body. (71:0-71:115)
  - [77] In the bath with the ten-year-old she is told her own face is that of an animal that has lost its mother; she reasons out that the odd eyes come from contact with the mother's blood at birth, and asks where the old books are. (77:0-77:153)
  - [83] In the storehouse basement she reads the drug manual (materials, three days of boiling, the four layers, the crystal, the smoke), learns that the ritual substance is the discarded by-product and that its name means "counterfeit", and finds a later hand's addendum signed 新村桔梗; a comic detour over an old sex-education book the child has found; inside it she finds the curse: green-eyed boys raised, green-eyed girls killed at birth, the killing urge at menarche, the targets being other green-eyed girls and anyone with the danger sense. The child's mother comes down the stairs and the narrator attacks her; the child knocks her out. (83:0-83:243)
  - [89] Morning, five a.m.: her eyes are back, her friend holds her, and she cries for the first time; the uncle promises to explain everything. Then the house is dark and empty, a bloodied petal is in her hand, and in the sitting room stands an eyeless woman shaped exactly like her who calls her by the English name; the mother is brought in, the knife is put in her hand, and she kills the mother, then the child and the elder cousin, with pleasure; her friend finds her, calls her a murderer and runs; the woman sits astride her to take her eyes. (89:0-89:323)
  - [99][103][107] Three short blocks, one and four and one cell: the body in the park had its skin removed, and it is her friend's father. (99:0-107:0)

  - [20] 祀耀802年四月六日: 五島 brings 新村栄一郎's fourteen-year-old autopsy report — an ephedrine-like substance in his blood — and the fact that the 警察庁 refused to analyse it and ordered the prefectural police to stop investigating. The narrator asks whether she has the right to decide; 五島 produces two 戸籍謄本 showing 春花 and herself as the first and second daughters of 古郡良治 and 古郡茜, 春花 adopted by the 新村. 24 hours of anaesthesia, a 48-hour limit. The doctor says the brain is still comatose and all of it is reflex, and that both their bloods show an alkaloid. 五島 reads the results and builds the whole hypothesis: an ephedrine-like substance has been in the narrator since she was splashed with 新村栄一郎's blood; it passed to 春花 at the moment she vomited blood; removing it may stop the fits. - events:
  - [8] the narrator runs away from 荒田集落 with 100,394 yen, two knives and no destination, because of an impulse she refuses to face; she takes trains to さわ皆上駅 in 皆上市, chases patrol cars for an hour, misses the Emperor's visit, and is picked up outside a garden by a man of about 50 who offers her a bed. She plays along for amusement, gives the false name 古村秋菜 and a false prefecture, and is driven to 佐波県警本部: he is a plainclothes officer and she is being taken into protective custody (8:0-8:201)
  - [14] in an interview room she meets 警部補伊勢大二郎, 理事 of the prefectural youth committee, who stammers at her and repeats her false details; she claims 元木町 as her home town to avoid being sent back, and he undertakes to drive her there. On the road he misses the expressway entrance, tells her why he became a police officer, and she gives him her real name. He explains the 元木町 case: four years ago a suspect surnamed 新村 vanished with a child; 飯沢県警 searched 荒田地区 and found nothing. She works out that the suspect is her 叔母さん, that her parents are hiding her, and says nothing (14:0-14:210)

  - [32] at 元木警察署 he lends her an old phone, releases her as a traveller rather than a runaway, and she calls her father again: she asks outright whether her 叔母さん killed someone, threatens to tell the police, and is told the truth will be given to her only when she comes home.   - [50] back in the real second, the narrator reasons her way from the vision to a plan to kill 五島絵梨奈, states that she is doing it in order to be forbidden to do it, and touching the borrowed phone tells her there is a listening device in it.   - [76] (1st) the night before.   - [100] (11th) the narrator steps outside; 白般若 leaves an old book at her feet and vanishes. 五島 reads it aloud: a girl born with one green eye, called トミ, kept as a marvel; a grown woman's eye turned green and she tried to kill everyone; the settlement blamed the Westerners, fought a civil war, and found that anyone splashed with a dead fighter's blood turned too. Half the settlement died. At fourteen トミ ran out screaming, tore out her own green eye, said she still wanted to kill, and pushed her hand through the socket into her brain. She was mummified and named ヴェルジ, Portuguese for green, and two 掟 were made: no more ドローガ, and worship ヴェルジ for ever. 五島 then proposes a fourth generation and a hive model, and names the two tasks: destroy the mummy and destroy the tree (100:0-100:248)

  - 春花 offers to help with tomorrow's rite; 美冬 refuses — 「春花が魔女になれるのは20歳になって、私が死んでからよー！」 (11:14). 茅萱 says she will stay in 荒田 rather than go abroad, because 夏菜 cannot be left and 城崎 cannot be left alone (11:17-11:21)
  - 美冬 takes 春花 to the 墓地広場, where the hole for tomorrow is already dug, and tells her 「ここにはね、あなたのお姉さんが眠っているの」 — a child by her and 栄一郎 who was never born alive, five months in the womb, who would have been born at almost the same time as 春花 (11:49-11:66)
  - 美冬 removes no 能面 for this and prays bare-faced, which 荒田 practice does not allow (11:54)
  - 春花's reaction is 「複雑な気分」 and she cannot tell whether it is jealousy, anger at her mother, or disappointment in herself (11:68-11:72)
  - the dead girl's name is given, once: あやか (11:84-11:86). 美冬 says today may be the last chance to bring 春花 to her, because the settlement may be gone in a few years
  - 春花 cuts her off before she can finish 「春花だって私にとっては――」 and laughs it away. The narration says flatly 「私は嘘をついた」 (11:98)
  - 11:105-11:125 is an UNFRAMED FLASHBACK to her primary-school years, keyed only by 「お母さんの目――／それは、ずっと昔に見た目」: the same look, the same 「本当に……本当に楽しいの？」, and the childhood confession of the bullying. It cuts back at 11:126 with 「変わってないな」
  - she tells her mother she is the best in the world, shouts it at the sky to her sister, and takes her hand home (11:132-11:144)
  - alone in the bath she decides her 夢 is to rebuild 荒田集落, works out that she is the only one whose leaving costs nothing, and resolves to enrol out of school in 元木町 first and tell her mother afterwards — 「無理やりでも既成事実を作って」 (11:148-11:177)
  - she passes なつみ in the corridor, tells her there is something important to say after her bath, and refuses to discuss 夏菜 and 城崎 first (11:184-11:198)
  - the file ends looking out at the dead cherry tree in the garden — 「この荒田集落は、枯れてしまったのだ」 — and on 「みんな……／さよなら。」 (11:215-11:223)
- speakers present: 新村春花 (narrator), 新村美冬, 新村茅萱, 古郡なつみ, 五島絵梨奈 (asleep, no lines)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: あやか, 冥福, 子宮, 天秤, 番人, 既成事実, 引け目, 見透かす, 素顔, 枯れ木
- voice/relationship changes: 新村美冬 → 新村春花, a SIXTH state — REGISTER 1 for the comedy beat at 11:10 and 11:14 and then level, quiet and unhurried for the whole grave scene, with the ー and the exclamation marks gone and no reveal attached; 新村春花 → 新村美冬 unchanged (お母さん); 新村茅萱 → 新村美冬 (叔母さん); 新村美冬 → 新村茅萱 (茅萱ちゃん)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:94 「春花だって私にとっては――」 is cut off by the daughter and never completed. 11:84 あやか is written in hiragana only — no kanji anywhere -> Q430. 11:92 「春花は茜との 絆 で授かった子供」 carries ruby-residue spacing on 絆, the second in this chunk -> Q010, Q431. 11:105-11:125 has no frame at either end; the only marker is a repeated look. 11:223 「みんな……／さよなら。」 reads as a goodbye to her friends and is not one; the next file cancels it -> Q428.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q010, Q216 (血のつながり is argued from the opposite side, by the mother), Q109 (魔女 succession is stated as a rule: 20 years old and the incumbent dead).

## 00000FCF  (order 146)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), switch at the boundary with no marker. The file has SIX row-blocks and five of them are one to five cells long. -> Q428
- time markers: none
- events:
  - [11] なつみ comes back to the room; 春花 is at the window and will not turn round. She announces she is going to live in 荒田 so that 茅萱 can study abroad and the settlement keeps a person (11:18-11:25)
  - 五島 refuses outright — 「新村先輩と離れるなんて嫌です！」 — and the argument escalates until 春花 tells her 「無関係のやつは黙ってろよ！」 and 五島 punches her in the face (11:36-11:59)

  - a strong wind comes into the room (11:104)
  - [15] one cell, indented, no speaker and no quote marks: 「全く、世話の焼ける孫だね。」
  - [19] all three hear it; 春花 identifies it as her grandmother's. A single cherry petal blows in, and on the dead tree a new branch has grown with a few out-of-season flowers shining in the moonlight
  - [23] four cells in the same unattributed voice: 荒田 is being reborn, the age of being guarded only by its own people is over, it can be protected from outside, and 「春花が思っていてくれる限り、荒田はなくならない」
  - [27] one cell: 「ばあちゃん！　でも、私……！」
  - [31] five cells: 「最後くらい黙って言うこと聞きな！」, visit now and then, outsiders coming is a pleasure, 「お前は元木町で、荒田のことを守っていておくれ」
  - [35] the voice stops; nobody can speak
  - [39] one cell, the punchline of the whole device: 「黙れこのコスプレババアーー！！！」
  - [43] 春花 retracts the entire decision as a joke, says 夏菜 can live with her family because she is a cousin, promises to spend every school holiday in 荒田, and the three of them end up in one futon accusing each other of crying. 五島 notes that if 春花 takes a job next year her holidays will be short
  - [47] three cells, two unattributed voices closing the file: 「さあ栄一郎、行こうか。もう心配いらないね。」 / 「そうだね母さん。後はみんなに任せよう。／もう、僕たちがでしゃばる必要はない。」
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 新村春花, 五島絵梨奈, 新村エリカ (voice on the wind, [15][23][31]), 新村栄一郎 and 新村エリカ ([47], unattributed)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 幽霊, 花びら, 季節外れ, 従妹, ノーブラ, 号泣, 取っ組み合い, さよなら, ほれほれほれ
- voice/relationship changes: 新村エリカ → 新村春花, a new row — her own unhurried voice with 「お前」 and 「～ておくれ」, delivered posthumously with no body; 新村春花 → 新村エリカ (ばあちゃん, then コスプレババア as the second use of the 0000095B insult); 新村春花 → 五島絵梨奈, a change row (「無関係のやつは黙ってろよ！」 is the coldest thing she says to her anywhere); 五島絵梨奈 → 新村春花, a change row (she hits a 先輩 and keeps the です・ます on either side of it)
