## 0000104E  (order 148)
- narrator: 五島絵梨奈 (私), and nothing in the file names her; she is identifiable only from 新村先輩／古郡先輩 and from チガ姉
- time markers: none
- events: she is watching 新村春花 stab 古郡なつみ to death and cannot move. She refuses to accept it, saying that panicking about a dream is pointless and that this cannot be real; she says that if she does not deny what is in front of her 「きっと私の自我は崩壊する」 (11:10). One thing she has learnt: 春花's eyes were green, which 茅萱 called 呪いの目 — so this may be 呪殺 (11:11-11:14). The last sound she heard from なつみ was 「ごく普通の――／断末魔だった」. 春花 was smiling happily while doing it; when she turned and smiled at 五島, 五島 smiled back, 「だって……／笑うしかないもん」. The file then degenerates into laughter: thirteen cells of a single 「は」, then three cells of roughly 200 「は」 each, and ends. -> Q412
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈 (narrator, no dialogue). 新村春花 and 古郡なつみ appear and neither speaks.
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 断末魔, メッタ刺し, 呪いの目, 自我
- voice/relationship changes: none — she has no dialogue in the file
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the file has NO frame at either end; the narration itself asks 「これは現実かもしれない？」 and never answers -> Q433, Q285, Q355. 11:29 「幸せそうに微笑んでいた」 is the narrator's reading of a face, not a fact. The 「は」 wall is a layout object, not speech: thirteen one-character cells and then three long ones, and the EN 「ha」 doubles every character -> Q412. 11:13 「新村先輩の目が、緑色だった」 is the only unhedged statement in the file.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q233 (the green eye is named as 呪いの目 by a third party for the first time), Q285.

## 00001073  (order 149)
- narrator: none. A radio (or breakfast-television) broadcast, 43 lines, block [8]. Two typographic systems in one block: 「」 for the field reporter and the studio guest, and the 「――」 prefix for the studio host. -> Q414, Q047
- time markers: 「それでは7時になりました」 (8:6); 「水曜のこの時間」 (8:7); 「今日本は桜満開の季節です」 (8:10)
- events: a field reporter closes an outside broadcast about a park where a special live concert is to be held tonight, with people queueing since yesterday and 整理券 now being issued; the host thanks 「ゆきちゃーん！」. At 7:00 the segment 『ゴマコメマメ知識』 begins, today's theme is cherry blossom, and the guest is 秋野冬夫, 日本園芸大学名誉教授. He explains, in a rambling comic register, that spring brings out 変質者 because cherry blossom contains エフェドリン, a precursor of the stimulant メタンフェタミン, which makes everyone cheerful, take their clothes off at 花見 and pair off; the host tries twice to stop him because it is a morning programme. He then says all ソメイヨシノ are one clone propagated by 挿し木 and 接ぎ木, that ソメイヨシノ cannot set seed with itself (自家不和合性), that it must use another species to reproduce and that what results is no longer ソメイヨシノ — 「こう言うと寄生生物みたいだけどね」, 「ほんと、浮気者だよね」 — and concludes that anyone who admires such a plant is probably strange too. The host cuts to a commercial break.
- speakers present: an unnamed studio host (「――」 voice, own CAST block), an unnamed field reporter called ゆきちゃん, 秋野冬夫 (own CAST block)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 秋野冬夫, 日本園芸大学, 名誉教授, ゴマコメマメ知識, 場所取り, スペシャルライブ, 変質者, クローン, 品種, 寄生生物, 浮気者, 桜満開, CM
- voice/relationship changes: none — no named character appears
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 「ゆきちゃん」 is the same nickname 新橋ゆき乃 carries at 00000EAF (「ゆきぴん」 there, and she is a ジャポニカテレビ announcer); the two are never linked and EN must not link them -> Q414. 8:19 names メタンフェタミン as the drug and エフェドリン as 「その物質」 in one breath, which inverts the relationship the rest of the project uses -> Q415, Q196. The professor's whole botany lecture is the 00000F24 荒田桜 exposition delivered as a joke by a stranger, four files before the story reaches it, and nothing in the file marks the connection.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q415, Q416, Q123 (秋野冬夫's given and family names are 秋 and 冬 against the 春花/なつみ season-name joke).

## 0000107B  (order 150)
- narrator: 皇子 (the Prince), 私, a first-person historical narration roughly 800 years before the story present. Fifth new narrator in eleven files and the first pre-modern one anywhere in the project.
- time markers: 「祀耀の元号が始まる1年前の五月二六日」 (11:0, 11:12); 「祀耀元年四月八日――」 (11:259)
- events:
  - a two-paragraph third-person preamble: 太良聖守 holds power, the Emperor's third son issues a 令旨 calling on the 湊 clan to destroy the 太良 for imprisoning his father, the coup fails, and on 五月二六日 the year before 祀耀 begins the 皇子 and the anti-太良 forces are supposedly executed or killed (11:0-11:12)
  - the narration turns first-person: he and 湊綱宗 are fleeing east with a handful of retainers, months later, in useless armour
  - the party has been reduced from nearly twenty to eight. They have wintered in a cave, hunted deer and bear, and are eating their own dead — every survivor has eaten human flesh, and those who refused became the food (11:87-11:95)
  - 糸姫, a servant girl of about ten, collapses with a fever. Her parents died beside her during the escape and the Prince took her in because she picked up his dropped short sword; 綱宗 proposed adding 姫 to her name to lift her spirits (11:49-11:75). A retainer swallows at the sight of her; she offers herself as food and asks whether she would be enough; the Prince tells her she is too small to be worth eating and must not die (11:85-11:105)
  - a monstrous deer appears and is killed instantly by a second, twice as large, which ignores the party and leaves. They take the meat (11:107-11:131)
  - the last retainer leads them to a hot spring. 糸姫's fever breaks in one night instead of the week expected (11:132-11:186)
  - from a rock upstream the Prince sees the valley floor below covered in cherry blossom reflecting the moon. 糸姫 says she loves the place; he catches her eyes shining when he suggests staying (11:173-11:202)
  - he decides to be dead, so that 湊朝寄 in the eastern capital is not burdened and the retainers get rest. 綱宗 proposes naming the land 天田 (heavenly field); the Prince inverts it to 荒田 (wasted field) so that nothing attractive draws attention, and the mountain is named 糸姫山 after the girl (11:214-11:244)
  - he gives up the title, will take another name, and states the motto: 「1人はみんなのために、みんなは1人のために」 (11:258)
  - closing narration: 祀耀元年四月八日, the settlement is founded; the man who abandons his rank calls himself 新村; more than 300 years of peace follow (11:259-11:262)
- speakers present: 皇子 (narrator, own CAST block), 湊綱宗 (own CAST block), 糸姫 (own CAST block), unnamed 従者たち (collective, own CAST block)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 太良聖守, 太良氏, 令旨, 幽閉, 追討, 湊氏, 湊朝寄, 糸姫, 甲冑, 従者, 西の都, 東の都, 獣道, 洞穴, 冬眠, 化け物鹿, 縄張り, 内臓, 湯気, 高台, 天田, 楽園, 人肉, 天涯孤独, 短刀, 盛者必衰, 賤しい身分, 勅旨, クーデター, 桜色
- voice/relationship changes: four new RELATIONS rows — 皇子 → 糸姫 (糸姫, plain and level, orders softened into instructions); 糸姫 → 皇子 (皇子様, 最上級敬語, 私, never once dropping it); 皇子 → 湊綱宗 (綱宗, bare, タメ口); 湊綱宗 → 皇子 (no address form at all, plain タメ口 to the Emperor's son — the rank collapse is stated in narration at 11:29-11:30)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:0 dates the coup's failure to the year BEFORE 祀耀, and 11:259 dates the founding to 祀耀元年四月八日 — the project's title date is the founding date, and nothing in the file says so. 11:68 uses 糸 where the rest of the file uses 糸姫, three cells before the 姫 is granted at 11:73 -> Q445. 11:83 writes the companion's name as 宗綱, reversed -> Q436. 11:261 「身分を捨て、新村と名乗る者」 does not say the new surname is his; it is never stated outright that 皇子 IS the first 新村. 11:129 the giant deer 「我々に興味を示さず去っていった」 — no explanation is offered for the size of the animals here, and 五島's chunk-17 exposition is not invoked.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q174 (the settlement motto is coined here, by the founder, in its origin scene -> Q420), Q014 (the 祀耀 era begins in the year after this file opens), Q052, Q109.

## 00001092  (order 151)
- narrator: 藤吉郎 (オレ), a 台所奉行 in the 麻生田 house, 祀耀309-310 — roughly 310 years after 0000107B and 490 before the story present. First オレ narrator in the project.
- time markers: 「祀耀309年の一二月」 (11:22); 「――祀耀310年初春」 (11:82); 「間川基義が攻めてくるまで、あと三月」 (11:149)
- events:
  - self-introduction: a farmer's son whose father was an 足軽, promoted on merit by a lord who ignores birth. He previously served 間川基義, 「日本一の弓取り」, where only pedigree counted, and left at 18 (11:0-11:19)
  - his old friend 豊吉 crosses into 麻生田 territory to warn him: 間川 will pass through on the way to the western capital in early summer with an army, 麻生田 must either attack or effectively surrender, and 麻生田 cannot win. He tells him to come back to 間川. 藤吉郎 refuses — 「間川に戻るくらいなら、麻生田家と一緒に滅びる方がマシだ！」 (11:27-11:75)
  - he petitions his lord for a month's leave to find a foodstuff that makes soldiers strong, admitting privately that a 台所奉行 manages the kitchen and does not source ingredients (11:84-11:92)
  - riding out, he finds a basin ringed by high ground at 樽狭間 and works out that if merchants were hired to feed 間川 there, the army would stop (11:110-11:119)
  - he tours poor villages, finds only common fish and mountain vegetables, and reasons that anything inside a daimyo's domain is already taxed, so he must search the borders (11:137-11:159)
  - north of the range he pulls what he takes for a white branch out of the snow and finds it is a rib bone the size of his own leg (11:165-11:174)
  - an impossibly large boar bursts out of the bamboo grass. The file ends 「オレの記憶は、ここで終わっている」 (11:186)
- speakers present: 藤吉郎 (narrator, own CAST block), 豊吉 (own CAST block), お館様 (referred to throughout, never on screen)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 藤吉郎, 豊吉, 台所奉行, お館様, 麻生田家, 間川基義, 間川家, 弓取り, 家臣, 奉公人, 密偵, 分国法, 一円知行, 年貢, 樽狭間, 奇襲, 小太刀, わらじ, マムシ, 白樺, イノシシ, 里, 鬼神, ガハハ
- voice/relationship changes: three new RELATIONS rows — 藤吉郎 → 豊吉 (豊吉, bare, loud タメ口, mirrored greeting); 豊吉 → 藤吉郎 (吉郎, bare — NOT 藤吉郎); 藤吉郎 → お館様 (お館様 in third person, 敬語-adjacent reverence, 「下さった」 forms throughout his narration)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: his name has three forms in two files — 吉郎 from 豊吉 (11:27), 藤吉郎 as he introduces himself (000010AA:11:25), and 藤殿 from 儀之助 -> Q443. 11:116 writes 今川 where the file uses 間川 everywhere else -> Q438. 11:101-11:104 「こんなことをしても無駄だと言うオレ。／こうしなければ生き延びられないと言うオレ」 — two internal voices, the same device as 00000F6F:11:8-11:14, and neither file mentions the other. 11:186 「オレの記憶は、ここで終わっている」 is narrated in the present perfect by a survivor and does not say when he is telling it.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q421 (this is the first of three files whose people and places are one-kanji shifts of real Japanese history).

## 000010AA  (order 152)
- narrator: 藤吉郎 (オレ), continuous with 00001092
- time markers: 「祀耀310年六月一二日」 (11:252); 「――午前10時」 (11:260); 「――13時、樽狭間の地」 (11:270)
- events:
  - he wakes in a house in 荒田. His host is 新村儀之助, the village doctor, a Westerner with a Japanese name who speaks Japanese with an odd intonation and gives orders to a Japanese woman in a language 藤吉郎 cannot follow — "Clientes para trazer uma refeicao." (11:29) -> Q422
  - 儀之助 explains 荒田: founded centuries ago by a noble fleeing the 帝/太良 war who was drawn to the place on his way east; huge animals and plentiful food; no allegiance to any domain; anyone who attacks is driven off together. He himself was taken in ten years ago after collapsing here, having fled a disaster in the colony his people administered and been rejected in the eastern capital as an 異邦人; about twenty Westerners now live here with Japanese names (11:41-11:72)
  - he is fed boar so good it makes his lord's best meat contemptible, and it visibly strengthens him — but it is not what he needs (11:74-11:97)
  - he kneels and asks outright for help saving the 麻生田. 儀之助 sends the woman out with "Traga as drogas." (11:131), goes flat and tells him he is under suspicion, and asks what he would do if refused. 藤吉郎 works out for himself that the only alternatives are to give up the secret, to be attacked, or to be killed here (11:110-11:162)
  - the woman returns with a glass vessel of pink crystals; 儀之助 says that had he lied or probed he would already be dead, and 藤吉郎 realises the house was surrounded (11:168-11:182)
  - 儀之助 gives him the jar because he answered honestly, because 麻生田's lord is said to be an 「うつけ」 who is nonetheless innovative and interested in the West, and because getting on requires people, not force — 「1人はみんなのために、みんなは1人のために」 quoted as the founder's saying and extended to insects and animals (11:183-11:222)
  - the drug is named: 「この中にはドローガという、この地の桜から作られる薬の結晶が10ほど入っています」 — burn it before battle, no smell, one crystal serves 1,000 men, the effect lasts about an hour, finish the battle inside it, and the soldiers gain 「鬼神のごとき力」. It is entrusted to 藤吉郎 personally, not to his house (11:223-11:232)
  - condition: never tell anyone about this place, not even his lord (11:236-11:244)
  - 祀耀310年六月一二日, 間川 moves with more than 20,000 men and calls in 平松泰基 (later 戸川保家); 藤吉郎 realises it is an invasion. The 砦 garrisons are wiped out but buy time. 2,000 men reach 樽狭間. He does not tell his lord about the drug — 「これは、オレのためだけに使うことにする」 (11:269)
  - hidden in the grass upwind he burns two crystals and sends the smoke into his own army, then watches. Soldiers jump eight shaku, outrun horses, 2,000 rout 20,000, and by the time the downpour eases 間川 is finished. His closing thought is who will inherit after his lord, and the answer he gives himself is 「オレが天下を治めるのだ」 (11:270-11:309)
- speakers present: 藤吉郎 (narrator), 新村儀之助 (own CAST block), an unnamed 荒田 woman (own CAST block), お館様 (offscreen)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 新村儀之助, 植民地, 改名, 尾張, 平松泰基, 戸川保家, 砦, 先備, 一騎当千, 8尺, 高みの見物, 医者, 芳醇, 滋味
- voice/relationship changes: three new RELATIONS rows — 藤吉郎 → 新村儀之助 (儀之助殿, 敬語 with self-lowering 「ありがたきことで」, and 膝を折り両手を床に着き); 新村儀之助 → 藤吉郎 (藤殿, level 丁寧 です・ます that does not change temperature when he is threatening to have him killed); 新村儀之助 → the 荒田 woman (Portuguese, no address form)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: both Portuguese lines are ungrammatical Latin script and neither is glossed on screen -> Q422, Q162, Q195. 11:69 says he must get back to 尾張, which is a real province name in a file whose other place names are invented -> Q423. 11:245 「何とかと言う薬の結晶」 — he forgets the name ドローガ eleven cells after being told it and eleven after using it -> Q444. 11:163 「この部屋は沈黙だけが森と鳴り響く」 -> Q442. 11:222 repeats the 0000107B motto verbatim and must be identical in EN -> Q420, Q174. Nothing in the file says what the drug does to the men afterwards.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q178 (ドローガ is named on screen 490 years early, by its maker, with dose, method and duration), Q052, Q421.

## 000010C3  (order 153)
- narrator: 内府 (the Daifu), 私, 祀耀340 — thirty years after 000010AA. A third pre-modern narrator, again at a file boundary with no marker.
- time markers: 「祀耀332年に起こった理性寺の変」 (11:8); 「四月二〇日」 花見 (11:46, 11:229); 「祀耀340年四月五日――」 (11:75); 「祀耀340年四月一一日――」 (11:206); 「――花見から5か月後」 (11:266)
- events:
  - his lord, 殿下, once told him how he took the realm: lost alone in the mountains north-east of the eastern capital, saved by the people there, and marked with 『桜の呪い』; 麻生田延永's rise to the edge of supremacy was engineered from behind by a 鬼神の王, and 殿下 says he induced 蛙吉 to raise the 理性寺の変 (11:0-11:13)
  - the narrator once fought 殿下, was reconciled, and now serves him; he has resolved never to defy him and to wait for his own moment (11:14-11:23)
  - 殿下 is in a foul temper over his heir, who is still a child. He orders a 花見 at 吾大寺 on 四月二〇日 and then demands five more cherry trees from a place he specifies on a slip of paper, with the carriers to be disposed of afterwards (11:24-11:73)
  - 四月五日: the narrator sets out with ten expendable men and five carts for 荒田. Smoke from many separate fires tells him there is a battle; he rides ahead alone
  - what he finds is beyond any battle he has seen: bodies split lengthwise, armour and all. 「これは……これは戦ではなく……／ただの虐殺だ……！」 (11:102-11:118)
  - two men fight in front of him — one missing both arms and a leg, hopping and feeling no pain; one with no lower half at all, walking on his hands. The legless man crushes the other into the ground and lands softly on his palms, his heart hanging out of him on its vessels (11:119-11:158)
  - the surviving half-man turns and warns him: 「お侍さんよお……／ドローガにゃ手ぇ出すんじゃねえぞ……／俺みたくなるぞ……」 and then dies (11:159-11:168)
  - cherry blossom is in full bloom all around, scattering 「血しぶきのように」. The men dig up five trees while singing; the blood-covered residents watch without the strength to stop them (11:173-11:192)
  - 四月一一日, delivery at 吾大寺; the ten men are given poisoned and drugged wine and sweets and die in their sleep, are burned, and are used as fertiliser for the trees; the others are told it was an epidemic (11:206-11:228)
  - 四月二〇日, 1,300 guests, two costume changes for the women, a sum the narration prices at 39億円 in modern money. The narrator alone knows the whole event is cover for placing 荒田 cherry trees near his lord (11:229-11:242)
  - he reconstructs it all: ドローガ is a Western word for drug; he saw the 鬼神 at 樽狭間 himself from the 間川 side; 殿下 used the drug there and means to leave it to his son; and he predicts the plan will fail because ドローガ exists only in 荒田 (11:243-11:265)
  - five months later 殿下 dies. The five trees had all shrivelled within a month — not shedding leaves but the whole tree contracting, 「さながら、干からびたキノコのように」. 殿下 went mad at the sight and never left his bedroom again (11:266-11:281)
  - the narrator declares the 戸川 will rule by politics and economy and not by drugs, that he will never go near 荒田 again, that 妖魔 live there and 「桜の木にそっくりな妖花が生い茂っている」, and closes on the instruction to posterity: 「ドローガには――／決して手を出すな。」 (11:282-11:292)
- speakers present: 内府 (narrator, own CAST block), 殿下 (own CAST block), the 上半身男 and 片足男 (own CAST block), unnamed 従者 (collective)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 殿下, 麻生田延永, 理性寺の変, 蛙吉, 謀反, 講和, 薨去, 吾大寺, 天下人, 傾奇者, 鼻つまみ者, 藤家, 戸川, 桜の呪い, 鬼神の王, 妖花, 妖魔, 眠り薬, 遅効性, 肥やし, 流行り病, 植樹, 茶会, 歌会, 女房, 心の臓, 京, 虐殺, 一世一代, だーっはっはっは, よっほおおお, ペタペタ, ドクドク, パクパク, ズルリ, カチャカチャ
- voice/relationship changes: two new RELATIONS rows — 内府 → 殿下 (殿下, 最上級敬語, 「有り難き幸せ」, and his private narration keeps the honorific verbs even while planning to outlive him); 殿下 → 内府 (内府 used as a vocative, imperative plain form, 「ほう、わしに意見するか？」)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the file never names 殿下 and never gives the narrator a personal name — both are titles throughout -> Q421. 11:9 「引き起こったものであるらしい」 -> Q440. 11:235 「（現代の金額換算で39億円）」 is a modern parenthetical inside a 450-year-old first-person narration with no frame -> Q424. 11:287 「桜の木にそっくりな妖花」 is the project's title word used in-world for the first time and it is not explained -> Q425, Q426. 11:161 「ドローガにゃ手ぇ出すんじゃねえぞ」 is repeated as the file's and the chunk's last words in the narrator's formal register (11:291-11:292) — the same sentence in two registers, and both must land.
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q178 (ドローガ's meaning is glossed on screen 460 years before 五島 glosses ファルシフィカソ), Q421, Q426, Q014.

## 000010DD  (order 154)
- narrator: 新村栄一郎 (僕), first-person past, his FIRST narration anywhere in 154 files. Nothing names him until 11:45, where サクラ says 「ごめんね、栄一郎……」 -> Q448. A pronoun switch 僕 -> 俺 at 11:268-11:269 while the drug is active, back to 僕 at 11:283 -> Q447
- time markers: 「中学二年生の頃」 (11:12); 「僕が中三になった春」 (11:105); 「今から500年ほど前」 (11:120); 「祀耀310年」 (11:130)
- events:
  - frame: he, his twin brother (兄貴) and サクラ grew up as one three, all the same age; he has felt inferior to both since childhood and asks repeatedly what he himself can do (11:0-11:11)
  - from the second year of middle school サクラ is bullied for her Western looks: industrial oil on her skin, cigarettes on her legs, and once taken away by motorbike, tied up on the summer mountain and smeared with honey so insects covered her for a day (11:13-11:24)
  - he was made to WATCH. The bullies bring him along on purpose, because a childhood friend saying 「いじめなんてなかった」 is the testimony adults believe; being the witness is what silences him (11:25-11:36)
  - his brother infiltrates the group instead and destroys it from inside; most of them end up in 少年院 (11:37-11:67)
  - on the 縁側 the brother warns him that the head of 雷怨猫達, a bigger gang in the next city, threw over his girlfriend for サクラ and that the girl may send ladies after her. He says 「俺は、俺にしかできないことをやる。／栄一郎は、栄一郎にしかできないことをやってくれ」 and hints that simply being near サクラ is enough, then refuses to say more (11:68-11:94)
  - he goes to the family's old books for 「知恵」 and finds the history: about 500 years ago ~20 Westerners led by a man called セレ reached 荒田; セレ, renamed 新村儀之助, made a drug from the roots of the local cherry and used a minor daimyo to test it at scale; 祀耀310, 間川基義 was killed, which delighted the settlement because the drug was proven; the drug then vanished from history through the 麻生田 / 藤 / 戸川 successions; centuries later セレジェイラ聖教, a sect near 女ケ沢市 that split off from 荒田, negotiated for cherry material to study ドローガ scientifically (11:106-11:139) -> Q450, Q451
  - the recipe is printed in full: boil the roots in water three days, four layers settle in the pot, the pink layer is the 原液, evaporate it on an iron plate, burn the crystals and inhale (11:143-11:145, 11:239-11:257) -> Q452
  - he shows サクラ. She tries five times to stop him, asks 「もし……／もしだよ？／　私が……／明日いなくなったら……／どうする？」 and 「もし私がここから逃げ出したら……／一緒に来てくれる？」, takes his hand, and he shakes her off (11:154-11:197). His own narration says the aim has drifted from saving her to feeding his self-regard (11:200-11:210)
  - he sends her outside, inhales, goes manic (heart rate, sweat, pupils), crushes a stone barehanded, kicks the cave wall and cracks it — and his leg folds. Compound fracture, bone through skin; the drug's analgesia hid it. サクラ is covered in his blood while raising the leg (11:260-11:310)
  - months in hospital, the leg never works properly again. サクラ tells everyone he fell from a tree, tells him she will believe it herself, and says she hid all his equipment so nobody knows (11:317-11:338). 雷怨猫達 dissolved on their own; nothing he did mattered
  - he tells his mother he wants a high school outside the prefecture, names 元木町 in 佐波県 because the town is famous for cherry blossom, and asks her not to tell サクラ. She agrees twice with 「まあ、いいんじゃないかね」 and asks nothing. Closing lines: he will look for a flower prettier than the cherry (11:342-11:370)
- speakers present: 新村栄一郎 (narrator), 新村サクラ, 新村幸太郎 (as 兄貴), 新村エリカ (as 母さん)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 不良, レディース, 雷怨猫達, 少年院, 工業用オイル, はちみつ, 隔世遺伝, 古語辞典, セレ, 神具, 原液, 躁状態, 鬱状態, 鎮痛作用, 縫合手術, スーパーマン, 甕, 自尊心, 自己愛, 一石二鳥, 出来そこない, 粗悪品
- voice/relationship changes: six new RELATIONS rows — 栄一郎 -> サクラ (サクラ bare); サクラ -> 栄一郎 (栄一郎 bare); 栄一郎 -> 幸太郎 (兄貴, already fixed at fourteen); 幸太郎 -> 栄一郎 (栄一郎 bare / お前); 栄一郎 -> エリカ (母さん); エリカ -> 栄一郎 (no address form)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:89-11:93 the brother's 「お前、気づいてないのか？」 is never completed and the narrator refuses his own inference at 11:99. 11:120 セレ is given no other name and no nationality beyond 西洋人. 11:126 「その桜の根からある薬を作り上げる」 is present tense inside a past narration. 11:194 and 11:202 hold source typos -> Q482, Q483. The 僕/俺 switch at 11:268-11:283 has no marker and no comment -> Q447. 11:305 does not say which leg. Nothing in the file says the drug caused the fracture; the narrator only asks whether it hid the pain
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q178 (the recipe and the origin of the modern supply), Q421, Q443 (セレ = 新村儀之助), Q009, Q052, Q110

## 000010F5  (order 155)
- narrator: 新村サクラ (私), her FIRST narration anywhere. The first 88 cells are a dream of her high-school years; the wake-up at 8:88-8:91 is the only marker, and it is retroactive -> Q453
- time markers: 「高校に上がった私たち」 (8:10); 「去年の夏に生まれた夏菜」 (8:97); 「しかし、2年前――」 (8:111); 「四月八日を過ぎる頃」 (8:348)
- events:
  - DREAM: spring rice-planting. 幸太郎 tells her 栄一郎 is well and in high school, then asks outright whether she still loves him. She admits it aloud for the first time (8:0-8:37). Over rice balls on the 縁側 he says 「俺たちさ……／結婚しようか」, then 「俺はお前を幸せにできる」, then corrects it to 「いや……／俺が幸せになりたいから……」 and walks off (8:67-8:83) -> Q454
  - she wakes on the 縁側 with the infant 夏菜 in her arms and 茅萱 (nearly 11) looking into her face. Summary of the intervening years: she married 幸太郎 after high school; 栄一郎 married 美冬 and visited sometimes; two years ago 栄一郎 died in an accident; 美冬 and the adopted 春花 are now living hand to mouth and 春花 is being bullied (8:88-8:115)
  - she cannot move them to 荒田 because the 掟 forbids it, and she will not ask her mother-in-law, who is 長 and would probably allow it, because a 大魔女 breaking the 掟 would be a disaster (8:119-8:132)
  - hearing metal from 城崎's house she decides what to send instead: 鉈 and メイス, plus 能面 and 赤装束, two sets, worth several hundred thousand yen (8:134-8:147)
  - she goes to the 地下倉庫 under 茅萱's 秘密基地 — the same cave 栄一郎 used — and finds everything in paulownia boxes. She resolves to add a LETTER saying the weapons are to be sold, not used, because 美冬 had asked her 『春花をいじめる子供を殺せないか？』 (8:153-8:170)
  - she tells 幸太郎 the plan; he doubts it will work and agrees to help load the car
  - after dark she performs 危険予知 for him in the third-floor-back three-mat room. What she sees is not 幸太郎 but 茅萱 — 「茅萱が――／殺しに来る……！」 (8:186-8:250)
  - 茅萱 walks in mid-sentence about the 三回忌, seizes her head, and comes at her with a knife screaming 「お母さん……／死ね……／死んで……！」. 幸太郎 holds her; サクラ runs; 茅萱's face is described as agonised rather than hateful (8:251-8:276)
  - エリカ knocks 茅萱 out at a pressure point and orders her hidden in the 地下倉庫, 幸太郎 onto the books, and サクラ to keep acting normal and look after 夏菜 — 「お前の役割は『いつも通りの新村家』を演じること」 (8:277-8:306)
  - 幸太郎 finds 翠眼呪殺 and ドローガ in the books; the cure is ファルシフィカソ, never before injected into a human. They argue about who is the test subject. 幸太郎 asks whether 栄一郎 made ドローガ and whether she touched his blood, and concludes their mother must never be told (8:309-8:337)
  - he says he will get 「ドローガを使ってくれる人」 to test both, disguised as a physical-enhancement experiment with an antidote, and refuses to name them. Her narration: 「私たちはこの時、非常に愚かな選択をしたのだった」 and the experiment failed because 美冬 never used the drug (8:338-8:347)
  - after 四月八日, 茅萱 is failing. サクラ goes to the cave alone and injects ファルシフィカソ into herself, reasoning that if she gives up her own precognition her daughter's madness may stop. The file ends on that sentence (8:348-8:357) -> Q460
- speakers present: 新村サクラ (narrator), 新村幸太郎, 新村茅萱 (10), 新村エリカ, 新村夏菜 (infant, no speech)

## 0000110D  (order 156)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), her first narration of a whole file anywhere (her 00000A18 stretch was an inset ghost story). Orders 156-163 are eight consecutive files in her voice
- time markers: 「10年前の祀耀790年四月一二日――」 (8:28); 「私が目を覚まして5日後の祀耀790年四月一七日――」 (8:72); 「当時10歳の私」 (24:21)

  - FRAME: a Tokyo flat in the story present. She is bored with a game she has not finished, describes her habit of playing boxed games because there were none at 荒田, and sighs (8:0-8:15). The frame is not closed until 24:120 -> Q457
  - MEMORY, unframed from 8:16: at ten she tried to stab her mother, was restrained and locked in the 地下倉庫, and her grandmother sat with her for days; she says she would have died raving without her. The madness stopped by itself after a few days (8:16-8:27)
  - she woke 祀耀790年四月一二日, just after 栄一郎's 三回忌, having missed 美冬 and 春花. Reunion scene with grandmother and mother: she is carried downstairs at nearly eleven, cannot look at her mother, and breaks down when held (8:28-8:70)

  - from the cherry tree 茅萱 sees her mother run from the garden toward the forest, the graveyard, then the 渓流 — faster than she has ever seen her run — and is the only person who sees the direction. Her father and grandmother scatter the whole settlement to search (8:105-8:123)
  - 美冬 and 春花 are packing to leave in the middle of it; 美冬's voice shakes as she says it is nothing; they take the family car and go with a barely-there goodbye (8:124-8:142)
  - left alone with the infant 夏菜, she straps her on and sets out; the settlement is briefly completely empty (8:143-8:172)
  - [12] one-cell block: 「あっちの方にいるよ」. [16]: she looks around, nobody is there. [20]: 「ほら、あっちの方だよ」. [24]: she follows it and somehow knows which way -> Q456
  - she reaches the cliff above the 渓流. Her mother and grandmother are arguing; her mother tries to jump; the grandmother grabs her and holds her wrist; at 24:29 「お前が死んで何になるんだ！　いいから早く上がりなさい！」 — and the grip fails (24:3-24:33)
  - she runs down (three minutes with the baby), hides behind a tree on seeing a figure by the body, and watches her FATHER bring a 鉈 down and take her mother's head off (24:44-24:63)
  - the grandmother comes down. 幸太郎 says 「母さん、俺は見てたよ。／サクラを突き落しただろ？」 and explains that a severed head makes it look like a murder by an outsider so his mother will not be suspected. エリカ answers 「私が殺したも同然だね……」 and tells him to hide the nata (24:64-24:87) -> Q458, Q459
  - alone with the body she sees the entrails, turns away, and tries to comfort the crying 夏菜 — and finds her own voice is not coming out and she is crying harder than the baby (24:96-24:119)
  - FRAME CLOSES at 24:120 with the same 「はあ……」 as 8:8: game over, eighth retry, television weather, early cherry blossom in 東京市. Closing lines: spring is when her mother's namesake flower blooms, when her mother died, when she wanted to kill her mother — 「私は……春が嫌い。」

## 00001124  (order 157)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), continuous with 0000110D, ten years later, in Tokyo
- time markers: 「午前11時」 (8:17); 「19時に学生向けの宴会飲み屋」 (8:30); 「もうすぐ21歳になる」 (8:174); 「この前のお正月に荒田で会った以来」 (8:74)
- events:
  - hungover, she is woken by a call from 美冬, who is in Tokyo on business and wants lunch at a café called プリマベラ near her flat (8:0-8:24)
  - flashback to the previous night: a 30-person tennis-circle mixer, perfect gender balance, her strategy of putting on the sweet act and using the looks she inherited from her mother — and then her 荒田 blood taking over, out-drinking the men until they stop seeing her as a woman. A losing streak in three figures and a 0% win rate; she has woken in a storm drain and once floating in the middle of the 隅田川 (8:28-8:57)
  - the café is the Tokyo branch of the 元木町 プリマベラ. 美冬 says the main shop is in 元木町 and that she used to go there with 茜, 「私が生まれた時からの親友」 who now lives in the next flat; 茅萱 notes the parallel with 春花's friendship (8:80-8:90)

  - she admits her real answer is 「恋がしたい」. 美冬's line: problems and failures are how people grow; and 「成果はさておき、出会いを楽しんでる？」 — if it is not enjoyable it is only bad experience (8:167-8:257)
  - eating restores her mood; her stomach capacity is described (a ramen challenge menu finished in half the time limit, and the habit that followed)
  - 美冬 shows a photograph of 五島絵梨奈, calls her a 天才少女, and says she is coming to 栄一郎's 十三回忌 — which 茅萱 immediately reads as 『頭のいい子が荒田集落に来る』, i.e. the 呪殺事件 might be solved. The file ends on that turn (8:275-8:293)

## 00001154  (order 159)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), the same day, back at her flat
- time markers: 「10年前に、お母さんは亡くなった」 (8:11); 「9年前は確か……城崎さんの奥さんだった」 (8:13); 「祀耀791年から795年にかけての春」 (8:45); 「祀耀796年からの呪殺」 (8:50)
- events:
  - she cancels that night's mixer by phone (ハナちゃん) and lies down (8:0-8:10)
  - THE CONFESSION. Nine years ago she overheard the 城崎 couple arguing in their garden: 城崎百合子 wanted to go to the police because the 大魔女 was settling the killing inside the settlement and the 新村 were shielding whoever killed サクラ; her husband defended 幸太郎 (8:13-8:29) -> Q477
  - at eleven she decided that killing a middle-aged woman was not difficult, crept into the house at night and put a knife through her throat. Nobody suspected an eleven-year-old (8:36-8:39)
  - the suspicion of her father did not stop, so she killed once a year, one person, in April, matching the settlement's existing phenomenon — which is how the name 呪殺事件 arose. Five people, 祀耀791-795, ending when her father's house arrest at the 集会場 ended (8:40-8:46) -> Q461
  - from 祀耀796 the killings continued and she has no idea who is doing them; the settlement has turned into mutual suspicion, and she notes the motto is only said aloud (8:47-8:56)
  - she rejects confessing publicly: it would not stop anything, and her father, her grandmother and 夏菜 would be destroyed. Her self-assessment: 「振り払った先が、たまたま奈落だったというだけ。」
  - 美冬's photographs arrive as a text message in straight double quotes with a kaomoji (8:72) -> Q471. 五島's photo reads as a doll-like, sharp-eyed child; the second photograph stops her — 古郡なつみ looks nothing like her mother and yet, asked who was standing behind her, she would answer サクラ (8:74-8:89)
  - she performs her own 危険察知 in front of a mirror with the window open: she will die at 荒田 on 四月八日, and so will many others. Three versions of her own death — back cut open, body cut in two, or stabbed by a 翠眼 春花 — and no branch in which she survives (8:90-8:148) -> Q478
  - her ability: same seasonal trigger as her mother's but with no dark-narrow-place condition; it woke at ten together with the urge to kill her mother; she has told nobody, because at 荒田 the gift is now called 『魔女の力』 and treated as サクラ's curse (8:109-8:136)
  - her odd-eyes (one blue, one green) are the same as 夏菜's; a friend told her no Japanese person has ever had that pair. Blue from her mother; the green from nowhere (8:100-8:108)
  - she reasons that 荒田 has almost no cherry left and her ability stops working there, so なつみ's will too and she will not be driven to kill her. The file ends on a stated choice: tell 美冬 everything she has done, in exchange for なつみ's secret, or keep it (8:149-8:166)
- speakers present: 新村茅萱 (narrator), 城崎 and 城崎百合子 (in the remembered argument; 百合子 gets a new CAST block), ハナちゃん (one side of a call, quoted only through 茅萱)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 城崎百合子, ドタキャン, 姿見, 汗腺, 怪現象, 魔女の力, 奈落, ハナちゃん
- voice/relationship changes: four new RELATIONS rows — 城崎 -> 城崎百合子 (百合子 bare); 城崎百合子 -> 城崎 (あなた); 城崎 -> 幸太郎 (幸太郎君); 茅萱 -> ハナちゃん (ハナちゃん)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:44 「私が殺したのは、全部で5人――」 is a flat statement that the file never questions and the NEXT file demolishes -> Q461, Q462. 8:140-8:142 is a two-item bulleted list with 「・」 inside first-person narration -> Q202. The three deaths at 8:145-8:146 are alternatives, not a sequence. 8:119 「お母さんの『気』とよく似た人」 — 気 in 『』, never defined. The file's closing choice is presented as a branch point addressed to nobody -> Q097
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q165 (呪殺 as a local word for homicide), Q213, Q233, Q276, Q053

## 0000116C  (order 160)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), the same evening

- events:

  - closing narration: 「何者かに操られ、私たちはその人形に過ぎない。／その傀儡師の気配を、初めて感じ取ったのだ。」

## 0000119C  (order 162)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私)
- time markers: 「祀耀800年四月一日――。」 (8:0); 「十三回忌まで1週間となった」 (8:1); 「昨日で春休みが終わり」 (8:2)
- events:
  - she turns down a welcome mixer (ハナちゃん), dresses up again, and returns to the Ginza 料亭 (8:2-8:22)
  - 五島絵梨奈 is already there, mid-feast, misidentifying every dish she eats while 美冬 corrects her (bream for flounder, pickled turnip for beef sushi). Introduction: 「初めまして！　元木町の天才少女五島絵梨奈、東京に降臨です！」 (8:26-8:36)
  - 茅萱 gives a maximally formal self-introduction and it is talked straight past. Her irritation builds until she slams a fist on the table and calls her 「五島ちゃん」 — the narration flags the slip (8:40-8:79) -> Q464
  - 五島 grins 「ニカッと」 and says the whole act was to loosen her up (8:81-8:83). 茅萱's reaction: 「いやいや、こんなの漱石枕流だ！」 (8:86) -> Q470. She then orders the 39,800-yen set out of spite
  - 五島 asks what 春花 calls her, is told チガ姉, and asks permission to use it. Granted at 8:96. A handshake in which 五島 does not let go and does not blink — 「笑っているのは口元だけで、目の奥から呪い殺しそうなほど鋭い眼光」 (8:91-8:114) -> Q464
  - THE OCTOPUS. 五島 cooks the tako hard on purpose, explains astaxanthin turning into carotenoprotein, and lands it: 「しっかりと火を通すことで初めて目に見えることもあるんですよ」. Then the octopus's two-year lifespan and invertebrate intelligence, and 「もしタコが人間と同じくらいの寿命だったら、人間の天敵になっていたかもしれませんね」 (8:126-8:158) -> Q465
  - THE METHOD (8:163-8:278). Neither the method nor the culprit may be assumed to be within common sense. A bear whose mother was killed by 荒田 could be taking revenge — bears are tenacious, careful, and have primate-level intelligence. Every hypothesis produces a contradiction; a case must have an answer; therefore 「矛盾することが……正解？」 — the impossible element IS the solution, as ドローガ would have been for the 女ケ沢 case. Conclusion: 荒田集落 holds a secret nobody living there knows, and there is 「明確な意思を持った者」 nobody knows exists, possibly something camouflaged. Her evidence is the precognition itself: telepathy plus the granting of power are both required, set out as a two-item bulleted list inside one cell (8:226). The one who warns of danger IS the killer. なつみ hears it as 新村栄一郎's voice, which means something is imitating a dead man, and doing that requires intelligence
  - she refuses the supernatural at 99%, defines 超常現象 as anything not yet explicable, and uses bat and dolphin ultrasound as the analogy — telepathy before the concept of ultrasound existed (8:249-8:278)
  - the food arrives and she stops dead: 「こんな話しながら食べたって、おいしくないですからね！」, then asks about university life and repeats what 美冬 told her about the drinking. The file ends on 茅萱 admitting she had underestimated her (8:279-8:300)
- speakers present: 新村茅萱 (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村美冬, the 銀座の料亭の仲居

## 000011B4  (order 163)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), on a train to 荒田, recalling the rest of the Tokyo day
- time markers: 「私は四月五日――十三回忌の3日前に荒田集落へ行くことにした」 (8:8); 「当初は四月七日に到着予定」 (8:9); 「あと三日――十三回忌が始まるまでに」 (8:247)
- events:
  - frame: the view from the train, landmarks that will not be there in a few centuries, and the decision to arrive two days early
  - FLASHBACK to the end of the meal: 五島 steals fugu karaage off her plate with her fingers — 「作戦成功です！」 — then smiles steadily at her until she looks down and takes the beef sushi the same way. 美冬 watches both thefts like television and takes neither side (8:15-8:50)
  - the 呪殺 conversation never resumed over the meal. 五島 announces she is taking チガ姉 sightseeing; 美冬 leaves for a branch office (8:51-8:58)
  - 東京スカイツリー, by way of 宝町 and the Asakusa Line to 押上. 五島 wanted the long queue because it means more talking time. Her point: people who live somewhere do not go up it, so outsiders see a place from an angle residents cannot — 「もしかすると、荒田集落も同じかもしれません」 — and she admits the tower itself was purely for fun (8:61-8:91)
  - THE SIX QUESTIONS, put to her in the queue with a notebook: what happened at 荒田; who killed and who was killed; how they were killed; when; where; and why. She answers five instantly and cannot answer the sixth. The narration then prints the key: 「すべて5W1H(What/Who/H o w/When/Where⏎/Why)で構成されている」 (8:100-8:139) -> Q467
  - 五島 closes the notebook without writing the last answer: 「チガ姉、これが呪殺事件の真相の『根』なんですよ」. 『なぜ』 is the only one of the six nobody knows, which makes 「なぜ誰にも分からないのか」 the productive question (8:148-8:157) -> Q468
  - her instruction: doubt everything — not the same thing as 「矛盾することが真相」; that one means the cause is outside common sense, this one means asking 『本当にそうだろうか』『なぜそうなのだろうか』 of every fact including her own (8:160-8:173)
  - assignment: go to 荒田 as early as possible and look for what nobody there knows, in people and in the old books; 五島 offers to translate photographs of them (8:181-8:189)
  - the warning, restated: behind the case is an unknown power that MISLEADS precognitives; it lets them hear voices because that is advantageous TO IT; the accuracy of the warnings and the imitation of a dead man's voice both prove intelligence; therefore 「危険予知すら『なぜ』を繰り返し、全てを疑って下さい」 (8:190-8:201)
  - at the 450-metre deck: 「作戦成功です！」 again, Mount Fuji visible, and 五島 behaving younger than her age. She thanks 茅萱 for having been honest, says solving it would make 春花, なつみ, 美冬 and herself happy, and 茅萱 closes on 「それが、五島ちゃんから受け取ったバトンだ。」 as the train enters a tunnel past the last of the cherry blossom
- speakers present: 新村茅萱 (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村美冬
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 東京スカイツリー, 東京タワー, 押上駅, 宝町駅, 浅草線, 富士山, 展望台, 唐揚げ, 5W1H, 尋問, 宝の持ち腐れ, ニコッと, ひょいと
- voice/relationship changes: none new; 五島 -> 茅萱 (チガ姉) and 茅萱 -> 五島 (五島ちゃん) are both already in force from 0000119C
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:139 prints an English acronym in Latin script with a ruby-residue space inside 「H o w」 and a ⏎ before 「/Why」; the reveal is that the six questions WERE an acronym, and an English translation loses it -> Q467, Q010. 8:35 「ニカッと、と言うより、ニコッと」 is a distinction between two of her smiles and must survive. 8:209-8:210 「『何者か』にとって予知能力者が死ぬことがまずいってことかしら？／これはつまり、予知能力者を何らかのタイミングで利用する……？」 is left as two unanswered questions. 8:66 「宝 町 駅」 carries ruby-residue spacing inside a proper noun -> Q476. Source typo at 8:186 -> Q491. The chunk ends with nothing solved and 茅萱 three days from a death she has already foreseen
- resolves from earlier files: none. Advances without resolving: Q087 (the 女神様 who gives 預言), Q166 (a second explicit reasoning framework, 5W1H after 起承転結), Q200, Q456, Q478

Nobody speaks to her again
  - 五島 reports what she decoded from 茅萱's photographs: 翠眼呪殺 — a girl born with a green eye is seized by a strong urge to kill other green-eyed people or precognitives; it starts at menarche, and men are affected too while bleeding; 400+ years ago it began a killing among the residents (8:88-8:100)

## 000011E3  (order 165)
- narrator: 新村春花 (私), continuous with 000011CC, in a car
- time markers: 「祀耀737年三月三〇日の新聞だ」 (8:57); 「祀耀747年四月下旬」 (8:122); 「元木町でも60年以上前に起こった」 (8:85); 「帰りも予定通り、四月九日だ！」 (8:215)
- events:
  - 美冬 collects them by car at 豊岳駅 and the four drive to 荒田. なつみ apologises first (8:0-8:12)
  - 五島 concludes that 『何者か』 exists and controls cherry trees — it grew one to stop the train and made なつみ perceive 元木町's destruction to aim them at 荒田 — and coins a name for it: ネクロ, short for ネクロマンサー (8:16-8:31)
  - 美冬 recalls that 中央公園's 御神木 also appeared overnight, before she was born. 五島 finds the article: 祀耀737年三月三〇日, a 20-metre tree in full flower, found by 金井桂子, who is quoted calling it a god. 春花 works out that 金井桂子 is her own great-grandmother (8:39-8:67)
  - the population of 元木町 began rising from 祀耀737 and the town became a nationally known cherry site; the 成金 arrive from 祀耀790 (8:68-8:70)
  - 五島 cannot find the tree's 品種 anywhere, and finds instead why: in 祀耀747 a five-person official research team came to study the 御神木 and all five died in their lodgings within days, of 脳挫滅 from blows to the head; the research was then stopped by pressure from somewhere, which 五島 reads as the government; the killings were overwritten by the モトキザクラ様 urban legend so that the event would rot into a joke (8:106-8:146)
  - therefore a document identifying the tree existed before 祀耀737, and on the date it would be paper — a book. All three reach 茅萱 in the same breath: she was reading books, she found something, she is gone (8:147-8:157)
  - 美冬 brakes and refuses to go on; 春花 fights her — 「私は元木町よりも、春花の方が大事よ！」 against 「元木町も荒田集落もチガ姉も見捨てる気かよ！」 — and 茜 telephones mid-argument (the wiretap again) (8:158-8:191)
  - 美冬 puts it to the three of them as a decision; all three refuse to turn back; she quotes 茜 back at them — 『あんたはそろそろ子離れして、旅をさせる時期なんじゃないか』 — and drives on hard. 春花's stated reason is not the town and not the settlement: 「純粋に、この2人が好きだから放っておけない」 (8:192-8:226)
- speakers present: 新村春花 (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 古郡なつみ, 新村美冬, 金井桂子 (one sentence, quoted inside a newspaper article — new CAST block), 古郡茜 (one sentence, quoted by 美冬 in 『』)

## 00001214  (order 167)
- narrator: 新村春花 (私), same evening, in the 蔵
- time markers: 「録音が中断されたのは今日の朝」 (8:198); 「録音が開始されたのは、昨日の18時過ぎ」 (8:200)
- events:
  - 美冬 has quietly taken the household keys for them. 五島 reasons from the key alone that 茅萱 did not leave the 蔵 voluntarily and was therefore abducted (8:0-8:23)
  - the ground floor holds junk: rusted nata and maces, ruined 能面, ordinary farm tools. The basement door is an ELECTRONIC LOCK less than ten years old, so 幸太郎 or the grandmother knows what is behind it; they take the second floor instead (8:36-8:65)
  - 五島 works out that ネクロ can only watch through precognitives, that neither of them qualifies, and that leaving なつみ behind may therefore have been right — it may see and hear through her (8:74-8:91)
  - 春花 spots the flaw in their search: 茅萱 could not read the old-language and foreign books without 五島, so whatever she found was in modern Japanese (8:111-8:118)
  - THE NOTE. A new sheet in a bad hand, ~20 cells, with runs of × where the characters are unreadable. Its content: she is being watched; 『彼女』 sees through her five senses but cannot read her thoughts, so she is writing this while looking elsewhere; the name of 『何者か』 is 『死月妖花』; it is a colossal organism rooted under 荒田 for tens of thousands of years, classed with ナラタケ, which spreads by planting spores in other bodies; it is a parasite; what looks like cherry blossom is its fruiting body; precognition, 呪殺, her mother's death and her own green eye are all just its breeding behaviour; it has NO intelligence and yet has acquired some way of misleading people; and she has been recording audio on her phone, which is unlocked (8:122-8:159)
  - 五島 explains ナラタケ: an ordinary edible mushroom whose relatives do two things — grow to absurd size (the largest known organism, an オニナラタケ in Oregon, ~10 km² of mycelium) and kill the plants around them while feeding on them, 植物寄生菌, called ナラタケ病 (8:163-8:184)
  - THE RECORDING. Writing sounds, then the note being hidden under books. Then 茅萱 shouts 「誰！？」, draws a knife, someone climbs the stairs, and a voice says 「茅萱……」. 茅萱 answers 「おかあ……さん……？」, is struck, and falls. Two voices then carry her out: 「さあ、栄一郎、運びましょう」 / 「よし、サクラはそっちを持って」 — 新村サクラ and 新村栄一郎, dead ten and twelve years (8:219-8:254)
  - 春花 sits down on the floor. The file ends on the settlement's own definition of 死神 — the dead come back on the anniversary and take whoever they want — and the flat statement that last night it happened exactly (8:255-8:269)
- speakers present: 新村春花 (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村茅萱 (on the recording), 新村サクラ and 新村栄一郎 (on the recording)

- voice/relationship changes: four new RELATIONS rows — 新村サクラ -> 新村栄一郎 (栄一郎 bare, UNCHANGED from 000010DD, ten years after both deaths); 新村栄一郎 -> 新村サクラ (サクラ bare, UNCHANGED); 新村サクラ -> 新村茅萱 (茅萱 bare, お母さん for herself); 新村茅萱 -> 新村サクラ (お母さん, broken across cells)

## 0000122E  (order 168)
- narrator: 新村春花 (私), same night, still in the 蔵 (block [11])
- time markers: none
- events:
  - they stay in the 蔵 to read rather than rejoin なつみ, because 死月妖花 may be watching through her (11:0-11:3)
  - 五島 has been reading a ~70-year-old ドローガ human-experiment report. What she reports: a religious body calling itself セレジェイラ聖教 came to 荒田 for ドローガ research and took away every cherry tree except the 新村本家's; the 大魔女 of the day negotiated a copy of the findings in exchange. ドローガ was made but never put into use because the side effects were too strong — if the user's blood reaches another person's head mucous membranes they gain precognition or fall into depression, and muscular control is so poor that serious injury and death were common (11:17-11:23)
  - 春花 stops her. Her own state is the point of the block: the father she loved and the woman she thought of as a goddess have taken 茅萱 away together, she knows it is 死月妖花's doing, and it has flattened her anyway. What she is left with is 無力感 (11:7-11:33)
  - 五島 asks whether the settlement has an underground space, because the mummified body of トミ — the last girl to die in the killing 450 years ago — must have been kept somewhere at a constant temperature, away from light, wind and animals; a cave 春花 has never heard of would also be a good place to hide 茅萱 (11:46-11:60)
  - 夏菜 answers from the stairs: there is a cave under her secret base, and she only learned of it today. 五島 checks obliquely whether she has precognition — i.e. whether she has reached menarche — and is told no (11:63-11:84)
  - 五島 sends 春花 with 美冬 instead and keeps 夏菜 with her, on the stated ground that the dangerous thing is being with a precognitive; 春花 refuses to leave her alone in the place 茅萱 was taken from, and that is how it is settled (11:96-11:111)

  - the adults have started talking as though 茅萱 is dead — 「大人たちは『お姉ちゃんは呪殺されたんじゃないか』って言うの」 — and that is what 夏菜 cannot bear (8:26-8:31)

  - 夏菜 asks permission to call her エリ姉 — everyone calls her sister チガ姉, so — and 五島 grants it after an ellipsis cell. FOURTH coining of the form in the project, first one asked for and granted on screen (8:46-8:53)
  - alone, 五島 abandons the plan to hide the investigation from the household, and turns to a Japanese-language scripture 茅萱 had carried up, 『セレジェイラの教え』, ~400 years old, from a faith founded in 女ケ沢市 (8:60-8:74)
  - THE SCRIPTURE, read on screen as bare narration cells: セレ came by a long sea voyage; his family had administered a colony for generations, and the colony, not the home country, was home; there a disaster came — a monstrous tree, a voluptuous flower, and the dead brought back by 『猛き音』; he escaped by ship with as many as it would carry and reached 荒田; he took the name 新村儀之助 and became the settlement's source of knowledge (8:75-8:85)

## 000012F5  (order 176)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私) — SWITCH at the file boundary with no marker, AND A REWIND: this file and the next are set on 四月五日-六日, before everything in orders 164-175, and are narrated by the woman who is missing in all of them
- time markers: 「時刻は22時」 (8:59); 「時刻はいつの間にか午前1時になっていた」 (8:104); 「四月八日までに調査を終えて」 (8:62)
- events:
  - the basement door's PIN is 0723 — a number-pun on 古郡なつみ's name, given to her by her grandmother, and known to almost nobody (8:0-8:3)
  - the basement holds the settlement's whole record, from the emperor's son who took the name 新村 onward, mostly in old Japanese and foreign languages. She works with a Japanese-Portuguese dictionary and an old-language dictionary borrowed from her university library, choosing by title, photographing what she cannot read for 五島 (8:4-8:21)
  - she restates 春花's objection to her from the previous phone call and cannot answer it: why did she work to solve a case she believed she had committed? Her own suggestion is that she may already have known unconsciously that she was not the culprit, and she asks what made her believe it in the first place (8:24-8:33)
  - her working rule, stated flatly: she trusts only people who live in 元木町, not her own family, because the method is a human method and therefore someone in the settlement has sold out to 『何者か』 (8:36-8:44)
  - she sorts what she has into three kinds — 翠眼呪殺 documents, local history, the ドローガ report — and goes to the second floor to work (8:48-8:57)
  - THE GENERATION TABLE, read out of the report as four numbered definitions and four numbered effects: 1st generation take ドローガ directly; 2nd, 3rd are made by fresh blood of the previous generation reaching the head mucous membranes; 4th is presumed to exist and is unknown. Effects: 1st, superhuman strength and visual tracking for a short time; 2nd, precognition under set conditions; 3rd, precognition where there are cherry trees, plus one green eye — and women who have reached menarche, or men bleeding enough, are seized by an unbearable urge to kill 2nd and 3rd generations (8:81-8:90)
  - she places herself and 夏菜 as third generation and her mother as second, works out that they became third generation by contact with their mother's blood at birth, and notes what will happen when 夏菜 reaches menarche (8:91-8:96)
  - THE LAST VOLUME, 『荒田桜の生態について』, quoted in 『』 across ~20 cells: the 荒田桜 does not exist as a cherry; what the settlement calls cherry is a fungal fruiting body; ドローガ is not a drug but a carrier of spores, 3 microns, heat-resistant to 1000 °C for a minute and distributed on the updraught when burned; the spores germinate inside the body, pass into capillaries and the brain, and lodge in the cerebral blood vessels; they activate with cherry pollen and are dormant otherwise; in first-generation subjects they never reach the brain and secrete an ephedrine-like substance instead; in second-generation subjects the sprout emits weak electromagnetic waves, which is what precognition is; in third-generation subjects the same, plus the iris turning green in one eye; the 荒田桜's spores are made in the flowers and the roots; all 荒田桜 are probably one organism, whose mycelium runs 「地平線から地平線まで」; and using ドローガ means having your body taken over, so it has no value as a medicine (8:110-8:175)
  - her own three-line summary: spores remain inside her, 夏菜 and なつみ; the cherry is a mushroom and the body is a fungus covering the district; it uses human beings for something, possibly breeding (8:179-8:182)

## 00001355  (order 180)
- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私), continuous, the same evening in the 蔵
- time markers: 「祀耀340年」 (8:14); 「祀耀482年」 (8:53); 「140年も先」 (8:54); 「祀耀730年代」 (8:118); 「同居一週間後」 (8:155); 「1年後」 (8:169)
- events:
  - 『セレジェイラの教え』 reread: 新村儀之助's account of a disaster in his home country — trumpets, the dead returning, the world ending. She notes that アポカリプティックサウンド is heard worldwide now without anything of the kind happening (8:0-8:10)
  - 五島's translation of 『猛き音と翠眼呪殺』: at 祀耀340 殿下 held a great 花見 whose real purpose was to carry off 荒田's cherries; 儀之助 had earlier given about ten ドローガ to a travelling samurai who was 殿下 himself, and he took the realm with it; with no heir but one small son he meant to pass it on and secure the succession; he died within months of the 花見, and 荒田桜 grows nowhere else. During the same period 翠眼呪殺 killed many residents; after the war with the Westerners and the 呪殺 the population went from about 100 to about 50; and then several more vanished, taken by 『猛き音』, every one of them with an ecstatic face, saying they were happy to become part of the goddess (8:13-8:37)
  - a loose sheet in the book: a memo signed 大魔女　新村桔梗, two 大魔女 back, who translated what follows into the language of her own day for her descendants and says she has not long (8:43-8:52)
  - 桔梗's 祀耀482 account: after the 猛き音, SHE appeared — a girl long dead, returned as a 妖花 and the real goddess; the possessed vanished and became cherries with their clothes wound round the roots; the name 死月妖花; the goddess is angry that her other half was taken by 殿下 and is turning them into new cherries; those who have used ドローガ, and their children, are the ones drawn to it; giant cherries swallowed the mountain, the land died, and white-robed dead carried the living off, exactly as 儀之助 described. They drove it back and sacrificed 椿, a young 大魔女 whose eye had turned green. 桔梗 is explicit that she does not know whether it is dead. Then the instruction to posterity in 『』, five classical lines: the dead come out of 黄泉 and unnatural 妖花 stand in rows; corpses become 妖花 too; only 翠眼 prevails; those who become 翠眼 wither the 妖花 and send the dead back; descendants must wear blood-coloured vestments and resist (8:53-8:96)
  - 『死月妖花の生態』, the セレジェイラ聖教 research report, near-modern Japanese, first person plural: they tried to explain ドローガ scientifically, ruled it unfit for human use because of the side effects, and then found that 荒田桜 itself might be the danger. The open question was the fourth generation; blood from a third generation produced nothing, so another route was hypothesised (8:108-8:137)
  - THE EXPERIMENT, in full: three subjects supplied by the cult's leadership, one said to be a plea bargain with a death-row prisoner; one dosed with ドローガ and the others infected in order, labelled 第一世代（壱）, 第二世代（弐）, 第三世代（参）. Pollen inhalation gave 弐 the precognition and drove 参 insane; 参 was shot. 壱 and 弐 were then housed with the corpse. After a week both showed ecstasy and delusional speech and said they would soon return to the soil and that the corpse was waiting. Autopsy of 参 found very fine buds on the skin with sexual spores at their tips, unable to germinate alone; blood from the two survivors showed their own buds grown from 10 to 100 microns with a different sexual spore, most already joined to the corpse's. That is the fourth generation. A year later both died in spring with cherry trees about three metres high growing out of their left chests, flowering, indistinguishable from ソメイヨシノ; both trees withered in a week because the floor was concrete; the bodies had largely dissolved into a clear liquid. Five characteristics follow as a 「・」 list (8:138-8:181)
  - THE LIFE CYCLE: the roots store spores carrying a muscle-strengthening compound; mammals ingest it; the spores germinate inside them; they lie hidden until the grandchild generation; that generation is made to kill, which releases the sexual spores; the first and second generations absorb them and become fruiting bodies. The cherry mimicry is to draw insects early in spring, which draws small animals and then large ones — a food chain round each fruiting body (8:182-8:190)
  - the mummy warning: a third-generation girl is preserved as a mummy at 荒田; if she is brought out, everyone who has ever used ドローガ will be enthralled and dead as a cherry within a year (8:192-8:193)
  - 『猛き音』 explained as a guess: the body pulsing underground cracks the earth and air passes through like a brass instrument. And the corpse-moving ability — autopsy of the fourth-generation pair found mycelium through the brain with function wholly stopped at least a month before death, so they had walked and talked dead for a month. The old documents' link between the sound and the disappearances is called an error of correlation, though not a total coincidence (8:195-8:210)
  - the report names 『セレジェイラの教え』 as not a scripture but a field record (8:211-8:213)
  - THE SPECULATIVE HALF, flagged as such: the fungus moves, slowly, like an insectivorous plant. Killing off its own third generation would be self-defeating, so the motive for the movement must be elsewhere — the settlement's 土葬 custom. It preserves buried infected bodies deep enough that animals cannot dig them up and revives them when a fruiting body is needed. The proof offered is negative: cherries grow evenly across 荒田地区 and not one grows in the 墓地広場, where the dead are actually buried (8:220-8:246)
  - 『知性』 and the coinage: the second and third generations' precognition is not precognition but illusion and auditory hallucination given to them, which requires the fungus to know their situation. The mechanism is named on screen because no good phrase exists — 『盗感』, the taking of a precognitive's sight and hearing. Since a fungus has no brain, it plants spores or mycelium in a buried brain and uses the dead person's mind; that is where its intelligence comes from and why it needs the large movement (8:247-8:263)
  - the report's last page: the only way to test any of this is to have someone with ドローガ-given precognition read the report inside 荒田 with their safety assured. The fungus will steal the senses and mark the reader as a threat — and the last four cells drop the third person and address the reader directly, predicting that the sound will now sound, a controlled corpse will come, and it will kill them (8:264-8:275)

- narrator: 新村茅萱 (私)

  - エリカ's answer: the cure was given to サクラ, not to 茅萱 — サクラ changed her own constitution and so removed the trigger — and 幸太郎's plan is to dose 夏菜 at menarche and to keep 茅萱 in Tokyo in the interim (8:26-8:60)
  - 五島 takes that apart in ten cells of interior reasoning: the safety of ファルシフィカソ was already demonstrated, the first 呪殺 came a year after サクラ's death so there was a clear year in which 『魔女の力』 fear cannot explain the delay, and 幸太郎 knew about the precognition.   - 茅萱 is found unconscious, uninjured, with a pulse. She eats the sweets 五島 was carrying as emergency rations and gets up. BOTH HER EYES ARE NOW BLUE (8:122-8:164)
  - 茅萱 reads it as good news — one threat gone, the thing can no longer use her five senses — and wants to go to the 廃屋 to pull everyone out. エリカ overrides her and sends her to 糸姫山 instead (8:164-8:179)
  - the transmission's SECOND HALF, printed for the first time: after 「死者黄泉出で……」 comes 「ただ翠眼のみが打ち勝つ。／翠眼となりし人々、妖花を枯らし死者を黄泉に返す。／子孫は必ず面と血色の装束をまとい抗うべし」 — green eyes defeat it, and the descendants must wear the mask and the red robe (8:209-8:214)
  - エリカ leaves alone for the 廃屋 to fetch 夏菜, and 五島 calls her 「エリカちゃん」 for the first time, to her face, unprompted, one file after refusing the offer (8:230-8:237)
  - 茅萱 describes the corpses: white robes, speech and manner identical to the originals, will entirely the thing's, and physically far beyond a human being.   - the counter-argument she makes against the maxim she half-remembers — that animals flee danger first, so fleeing is not shameful — is that animals defend their young, and a bee will go at a hornet for the hive (11:144-11:152)

  - サクラ says 茅萱 was taken before she learned too much, i.e. rescued; that she herself woke only yesterday; that she is unobserved right now only because the thing is busy repairing 栄一郎's body; and that the next time they meet she will probably be an enemy (11:259-11:295)

## 00001459  (order 191)
- narrator: 新村春花 (私), continuous

  - the two-point summary set as a 「・」 bullet list inside her narration: the 元木町組, 茅萱 and 夏菜 are the top targets; the thing is vulnerable while repairing a body (8:41-8:43)
  - she works out that escape is not enough — なつみ's and 茅萱's precognition works anywhere there are cherries, so the pair are only safe where there are none — and then realises she never asked サクラ the one thing that mattered: how 茅萱's killing urge was removed. She weighs going back and decides against it (8:44-8:73)
  - she meets エリカ in the forest. The grandmother has been briefed by 五島 and is going for 夏菜, who is now stated to be the only human able to destroy the thing; 茅萱 is no longer 翠眼 and is scouting the route to the body (8:99-8:126)
  - she names the two survival routes — neutralise the precognition and slip out, or kill the thing — and says エリカ has chosen the second (8:122-8:126)
  - the ファルシフィカソ history restated: it neutralises ドローガ; ten years ago it was given to サクラ and that ended 茅萱's 発狂; 美冬 was being pushed toward a killing in 女ケ沢 with ドローガ as the bait when the real object was to get ファルシフィカソ used; the 古郡 family talked her out of it (8:132-8:138)
  - THE BEHEADING: エリカ says 幸太郎 believes she pushed サクラ off the cliff, and that when she saw the body the head was already off. 春花 objects that holding someone by the wrist cannot look like pushing, and then — because she has just met a dead woman — proposes the answer. エリカ says it: 栄一郎, acting on the thing's will, to spread the curse rumour (8:139-8:183)
  - THE 三畳間 CONVERSATION, retold by エリカ in her own first person with no frame at either end, 春花's questions cut into it as ordinary 「」 dialogue: 美冬 came to be judged, produced the syringes, confessed the breach and tried to take all of it so サクラ would not be blamed; エリカ delivered the law in 丁寧 — 「 掟 を破ることは、処罰の対象です」 — and then pardoned her two cells later.   - her closing regret is the chunk's thesis: they should have pooled what they each knew instead of hiding things, and the fear of being watched cost them more than the watching (8:256-8:261)

## 00001477  (order 192)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私) — SWITCH at the file boundary with no marker, and the file's first 35 cells cover the SAME MINUTES as 000012C5:8:29-8:52 from the other side of one room
- time markers: none; the same night
- events:
  - the 猛き音 again. 五島 comes out of the 蔵, seizes 夏菜 by the shoulders and shouts at her for having told なつみ where 春花 went, then drags なつみ indoors and orders her not to leave the room, not even for the lavatory without a telephone call first — 「絶っっっ対にこの部屋から出ないでください！」 (8:0-8:34)
  - なつみ analyses the outburst rather than resenting it and concludes that her own knowing is the danger, and that it is about her precognition (8:35-8:43)
  - a message from her father: 「なつみ、今はただ、みんなに従いなさい。」 She notes that he has the listening app, so a vague message rather than a call is itself information (8:44-8:49)
  - THE HINT, and it is the file's central device. Her father says 「なつみ、こういうことなんだ」 — a sentence with subject, predicate and modifier removed — hands over to her mother, who says the same thing three ways: we can hear your voices anywhere; BUT we can hear 春花's and 五島's voices too; we cannot see what you see. The 「でも」 is a 逆接 that does not fit, and なつみ names the mismatch as the clue (8:100-8:132)
  - she reconstructs the missing middle by printing the passage with a placeholder — three cells in straight double quotes, the middle one reading 「（ここに何かが入る）。」 — and then fills it: ネクロ cannot hear 春花 and 五島 (8:133-8:158)
  - the deduction in full: her parents hear all three voices but see nothing; ネクロ can take her sight and hearing but not the other two's. Everyone's behaviour now fits. 五島's outburst was an instruction to see and hear nothing, and 茅萱 was presumably made to disappear before she learned everything through a jacked sense (8:159-8:165)
  - the corollary she draws: thought is not transmitted, or the hint could not have been sent — so what she can do is FEED IT FALSE INPUT (8:169-8:172). She also notes she has no guarantee ネクロ did not follow the same reasoning (8:173-8:176)
  - a sharp smell through the open window, a large figure running from the 蔵, and 五島's shout of 「火事！」. The storehouse burns; the settlement puts it out; the three shelter by the 集会場 (8:190-8:213)
  - she withholds the arsonist from 五島 on purpose and tells her an obvious lie instead — 「ネクロが、蔵を燃やしたの……？」 — to watch what 五島 does with it, and records that this is how she will deceive the thing (8:214-8:233)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村夏菜, 古郡良治 (telephone and message), 古郡茜 (telephone)

- voice/relationship changes: two new RELATIONS rows — 古郡良治 -> 古郡なつみ (なつみ bare, ordinary タメ口 used to deliver a sentence with every content word removed); 古郡茜 -> 古郡なつみ (なつみ bare, the same device, and she cuts the call the instant her daughter says the word ヒント)

  - they stop in the 墓地広場. 五島 walks in silence, then abruptly turns back toward the graveyard saying she still has something to do, and runs (8:128-8:176)
  - なつみ stops 夏菜 chasing her, and 夏菜 goes limp and says 「お姉ちゃんは、もうダメかもしれない」 and will not explain (8:178-8:193)
  - 夏菜'S CONFESSION, told as her own first person inside なつみ's narration with no frame: this morning she found 茅萱 in the 廃屋, curled up facing the wall with her ears plugged, muttering — 「死にたくない……死にたくない！　勝てるわけない！／もう降参した方がいいよ……！　みんな桜になればいい！」 and 「みんな私の代わりに死んでよ……！」 — and she was frightened and left her there (8:222-8:247)
  - the second half of the reason, worse than the first: if her sister came back, her father and grandmother might be arrested, because 茅萱 suspects them (8:250-8:260)
  - なつみ reaches the file's thesis and states it out loud: the settlement's mutual suspicion is what has kept the 呪殺 running, hiding things and deceiving each other cannot solve it, and what she is for is holding people together. 夏菜 tells her everyone says she never gives up (8:270-8:299)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 新村夏菜, 五島絵梨奈, 新村茅萱, the masked residents (corpses)

## 000014A5  (order 194)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), continuous
- time markers: none; the same night. 「歩いて15分くらい」 to the 廃屋 (from 0000148E:8:138)
- events:

  - 夏菜 was under a year old when her mother died, has almost no photographs, and knows her only as 「女神様みたいな人」. The cave 春花 went to for the mummy was her mother's childhood 秘密基地 (8:29-8:40)

  - 美冬 is standing behind them with blood on her, explains it as 茅萱's, and will not say where 春花 is (8:52-8:65)
  - なつみ asks outright whether she is being lied to in order to keep the thing from seeing, 夏菜 says the mechanism out loud, and 美冬 confirms the shape of it without giving the content: she knows where 春花 went and that is all she can say (8:85-8:99)
  - the cleared landslide again, and this time three people reason about it: the volume could not have been moved in the time available by a settlement whose adults spent the day searching and firefighting, and the prints are BARE FEET. 美冬 rules ドローガ out on physiology — it releases the brain's limiter rather than adding strength, so this much work would tear the user apart — and says the oddity is why she turned back (8:104-8:135)
  - a marching order: 美冬 in front, なつみ in the middle, 夏菜 behind, stated as a guard formation and not explained (8:138-8:148)
  - the 廃屋 opens on nothing. They sit down; 美冬's 「よっ／こら／せっと！」 is split across three cells; the phone is out of signal (8:152-8:176)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 新村夏菜, 新村美冬
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 吊り橋, 河原, 合掌, 怪物人間, 怪力, 山小屋, 大船に乗った, 埋葬(→000014BC), すうすう, ベチャベチャ
- voice/relationship changes: two new RELATIONS rows — 新村美冬 -> 古郡なつみ (なつみちゃん, the high-energy register absent again for a whole file, and an apology delivered before the thing being apologised for); 新村夏菜 -> 新村美冬 (叔母さん, over-familiar タメ口 and an offer to go searching alone)

## 000014BC  (order 195)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), continuous
- time markers: 「祀耀800度県立元木高等学校新入生」 (8:4) — the entrance ceremony of this same morning
- events:
  - THE ENTRANCE-CEREMONY SPEECH: seven cells of formal ceremonial 敬語 printed as bare narration with no 「」, no 『』 and no frame at either end, and only labelled afterwards — 「五島による入学式の挨拶を聞いたのは今朝のこと」 (8:4-8:11). なつみ's verdict is that it was uncharacteristically ordinary because 五島's mind was on 茅萱
  - four more cells of the morning: her parents' worried send-off, the three of them dividing three portions of lunch equally, 五島 declining hers so blood stays in her brain (8:14-8:22)
  - 夏菜 falls asleep sitting up. なつみ offers to keep watch (8:29-8:38)
  - 美冬 breaks the silence with the file's hypothesis: if 幸太郎 did not cut サクラ's head off, then 栄一郎 did — and she means the ghost of a man dead two years at the time. She calls the idea absurd herself and says that 幸太郎 doing it is exactly as absurd (8:40-8:77)
  - she cites her source: 五島's rule, relayed through 茅萱 and quoted in 『』 — 「あり得ないことが起こるのが呪殺事件だ。／常識では考えられないことも視野に入れて調査するように」 (8:86-8:88)
  - なつみ's reaction is the file's tell: the ghost theory produces no friction at all, and she names the absence as the anomaly — 「『何かが引っ掛かる』の逆で、『何も引っ掛からない』から引っ掛かるのだ」 (8:100-8:109)
  - she proposes the flat version — suppose he simply was not dead — and 美冬 rules it out with the record: death confirmed at hospital, a police 検死, a funeral. And then the fact that matters: 荒田 still practises 土葬, so the body went into the ground intact (8:110-8:117)
  - THE 法要 REASONED OUT: 美冬 gives the custom — the dead are 死神, a 死神 returns on its own anniversary to take a living person, the memorial is a rite to drive it off, and every attendant must wear 能面 and 赤装束 so that nobody can be told apart. なつみ pushes on the last point: if the disguise is only to avoid being recognised outside, it has no function against a 死神 unless the 死神 picks particular people, and if it picks people the ones at risk could simply stay away (8:121-8:152)
  - she solves it from her own position: she came here hiding her ability because 荒田 treats it as 『魔女の力』; and her ability needs her to SEE or HEAR the person at risk; and the thing works through her eyes and ears — therefore the mask and the robe are equipment against a thing that watches through people. She shouts for 能面 and 赤装束 (8:156-8:182)
  - A VISION, unframed: 元木町 urbanised and full of people, an earthquake, a colossal cherry swallowing the town, ruins. She names it a new grade — 「これは『危険予知』ではなく……『滅亡予知』だ」 (8:183-8:202)
  - エリカ and 春花 arrive. Outside, cherries are in flower everywhere and the spring wind is up; her sense comes back and reports the thing is both far above and far below (8:206-8:223)
  - A RELAY: her viewpoint moves to the summit and she watches 茅萱 and 五島 arrive through somebody else's eyes — 「これは……誰の視点？」 — and 新村栄一郎 greets her through it, explaining that spores have thickened enough near the exit to connect them (8:227-8:242)
  - orders go out: エリカ back to the settlement for as many people as possible and 能面 and 赤装束 for all of them. A second connection opens and 栄一郎 invites her up, saying he will hold off spreading more spores (8:262-8:276)
  - she works out that the jacking is periodic rather than constant, and that his phrasing proves エリカ's errand was not seen (8:282-8:285)
  - the sound, and inside it a voice: 「私は、長い間あなたを待ち焦がれていました。／どうぞ、こちらへ来て下さい」 — a girl's voice. The file's last three cells: 死月妖花 is not a fungus, it is a human being (8:287-8:297)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 新村美冬, 五島絵梨奈 (in the recalled speech), 古郡良治 and 古郡茜 (in the recalled morning), 新村夏菜, 新村エリカ, 新村春花, 新村栄一郎 (through the relay), the 死月妖花 voice (unidentified here)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 来賓, 校長先生, 感無量, 自立心, 教養, お弁当, 幽霊, 埋葬, 形骸化, 滅亡予知, 都市化, 妖艶, 新入生(existing 新入生代表 is the title)
- voice/relationship changes: two new RELATIONS rows — 新村美冬 -> 古郡なつみ (なつみちゃん, a second row for the hypothesis scene: level, hesitant, apologising for the idea before and after giving it); 新村栄一郎(corpse) -> 古郡なつみ (なつみちゃん, 僕, 丁寧-warm, through a telepathic relay, exactly the register of 00000E31)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:4-8:10 are a ceremonial address set as bare narration cells with no quotation marks of any kind and no frame until 8:11 — the fifth unmarked document format in the project -> Q586, Q071, Q413. 8:86-8:88 are the THIRD verbatim quotation of 五島's rule and the first set in 『』 -> Q547. 8:107 inverts a stock phrase against itself inside 『』 twice in one sentence -> Q587. 8:183-8:197 are a vision with no frame at either end, set as ordinary narration, and the only marker is a door opening -> Q588, Q355, Q285. 8:220-8:223 are four cells each prefixed 「――」 with no speaker, carrying the sense rather than a voice -> Q589, Q179. 8:227 「これは……誰の視点？」 is the narration asking whose eyes it is using, and 8:236 「五島が……見える」; EN must keep the viewpoint genuinely unplaced -> Q590. 8:289-8:290 are the antagonist's first words and they are 敬語 in a girl's voice, with no name attached until the next file -> Q591
