## 000014D7  (order 196)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), continuous. 462 lines, the longest file in the chunk
- time markers: none absolute; the climb is given as 「10分――／20分――／30分――。」 (8:16-8:18)
- events:
  - the approach printed as a four-cell montage of 「～を抜け――」, then the tunnel, where the mummy is already gone and the slope has been laced with vine-like growth that makes it climbable — 「まるで、私たちが少しでも登りやすいよう、誰かが手を加えたかのようだ」 (8:0-8:10)
  - the summit: wind, a bright moon, cherries, steam, sulphur, boiling water coming out of the ground (8:28-8:33)
  - 五島 is there, swollen-eyed and grey, apologising. 茅萱 lifts her off the ground by the collar; 夏菜 runs at them and 栄一郎 catches her one-handed and throws her about seven metres, and she lands and sprains an ankle (8:34-8:93)
  - 栄一郎 opens on なつみ with the balloon — 「僕は君が飛ばした風船を取ろうとして死んだんだよ？　言うことないの？」 — then taunts 美冬 about her age. 美冬 answers 「あんた誰よ！」 and 「黙りなさい！　偽物！」 (8:46-8:63)
  - 五島 is released to the audience side on the condition that she check the answers (8:103-8:109)
  - 五島's verdict on him: 「身体だけは、本物です。／でも、意識は完全に死月妖花に乗っ取られています」 (8:122-8:123). He admits he has been impersonating his own twin occasionally for years and that 幸太郎 was suspected of the 呪殺 as a result (8:206-8:211)
  - HE ADMITS THE BEHEADING outright — 「もちろん、僕だよ」 — and gives the reason: a curse rumour makes an annual death look natural, and they needed corpses (8:129-8:133)
  - THE FULL MECHANISM, delivered in about sixty untagged 「」 cells alternating between 栄一郎 and サクラ: ドローガ用 hunters became cherries as the price; ヴェルジ worship kept the cycle stable; the 翠眼呪殺 story exists to get 第三世代 children killed at birth, because 第三世代 produce the spores that control 第一・第二世代 but also carry an enzyme in the blood that destroys the thing's cells; brides from outside supply uninfected wombs and are given high status (8:134-8:150)
  - the cycle was broken by 新村桔梗, the 大魔女 two generations back and the only one who did not die in April: she worked out the takeover from three 「なぜ」 questions, sealed ヴェルジ, dosed the residents with ファルシフィカソ, and had セレジェイラ聖教 carry the cherries away. 120 years ago her future husband 新村 晃 took ドローガ to a man of power in 東京市, which is how she came to marry in; the thing killed her family to break her and it did not work (8:151-8:171)
  - the thing could not fight a group backed by the state, lost most of its cherries, and decided humans were now an obstacle: hence decades of staged suicides of the old to make the settlement uninhabitable, and, when that failed, the 呪殺 as a fear campaign (8:172-8:195)
  - サクラ's suicide: 栄一郎 says it was ultimately her own will and that it would not have happened if 美冬 had not confessed, then says 「ははは、冗談だよ」 (8:196-8:201)
  - サクラ turns on 春花: she kept her in the settlement, she calls her simple, and 「私は何も嘘は言っていないわ」 — except that the repair-window claim was a lie (8:214-8:229)
  - THE ASK: なつみ is 第二世代の生者, and with 栄一郎 (第一世代の死者), サクラ (第二世代の死者) and 茅萱 (第一世代の生者) she completes the four 神使 of the transmission; the four become the last 苗床, giving the thing full immunity to 第三世代 blood and permanent safety (8:239-8:252)
  - 五島's objection — サクラ had used ファルシフィカソ days before dying, so she is not 第二世代 — and the answer that breaks two files of earlier reading: サクラ never injected herself. The thing gave her the sight and sound of doing it, in a hole where nobody could witness it, and her own honesty is what made it work. The same device showed 茅萱 visions of murdering residents (8:253-8:270)
  - 茅萱's cured killing urge is explained as spore suppression, the same suppression that switched なつみ's precognition off on arrival (8:271-8:276)
  - THE THREAT: the cherries can be enlarged to release spores that kill outright, and petals dissolve the bodies for nutrient. なつみ is given a choice — join, or everyone here dies (8:287-8:299)
  - 栄一郎 produces the ヴェルジ mummy out of the petals. 五島 covers なつみ's face; he says breathing is not the only route. 茅萱 takes the mummy from him, runs, and jumps into the hot-spring stream with it; the mummy floats away downstream (8:308-8:341)
  - THE REVERSAL, and it is a wet sheet of paper: 幸太郎's note, printed as five bare cells with the signature alone on the last — he had already undone the ドローガ with ファルシフィカソ, and instructed her to feign surrender and destroy the mummy by fire or water. He had hidden underground, covering it with door-to-door apologies for the fire (8:346-8:359)
  - 茅萱 cuts 夏菜's arm and swings the bloodied knife at the two corpses, who drop screaming: fresh 第三世代 blood is the weapon. 五島 fits it to the transmission's second half and to the four-神使 requirement (8:364-8:379)
  - the ground shakes; the 女神様's voice orders the two corpses back; huge brown masses burst out of both bodies; cherries tens to hundreds of metres high erupt across the whole district and bury the summit in petals (8:382-8:407)
  - the aftermath is written as beauty: petals like pink spinel, a faint reflected moonlight, a landscape compared to a painting and then named — 「私たちがいるのは――／死の世界。」 五島 says these trees are only parts and the body is elsewhere, and that the district's soil has been drained to grow them (8:411-8:444)
  - the last seven cells: footsteps through the petals, a girl's voice, and 「古郡なつみさん、初めまして。／私は……／糸姫と申します」 (8:445-8:461)
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花, 新村美冬, 新村夏菜, 新村茅萱, 新村栄一郎 (corpse), 新村サクラ (corpse), 新村幸太郎 (written note only), 死月妖花／糸姫
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: ツタ, 湯気, 熱湯, 母体, 進化, 宗教団体, 聡明, 権力者, 潤沢, 資金, 自殺の横行, 安息, 永劫, オオカミ少年, 放散, 即死, 花びら, ピンクスピネル, 観客, 偽物, 嫌味, 修行, 新村晃, ぐぐぐ, おっほほ, ぷかぷか, さわさわ, もこもこ, ぎぎぎ, グネグネ, パアッと, うっすら, ドロドロ, ぽっかり, キッと
- voice/relationship changes: six new RELATIONS rows — 新村栄一郎(corpse) -> 古郡なつみ (なつみちゃん, 僕, the 丁寧-warm register used to demand an apology for his own death); 新村栄一郎(corpse) -> 新村美冬 (美冬ちゃん, 僕, warm surface with an insult about her age inside it); 新村美冬 -> 新村栄一郎(corpse) (あんた / 偽物, タメ口, the ONLY time she drops 栄一郎さん and です・ます for him anywhere); 新村栄一郎(corpse) -> 新村夏菜 (夏菜ちゃん / 栄一郎叔父さん, stretched-vowel baby-talk while throwing her); 新村サクラ(corpse) -> 新村春花 (春花 bare, unchanged warmth, contents reversed); 死月妖花／糸姫 -> 古郡なつみ (古郡なつみさん, 敬語, ～ます, a girl's voice)

## 000014EE  (order 197)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), continuous out of 000014D7 with no marker
- time markers: 「12年前の今日、四月八日」 (8:19); 「800年以上待ち続けた」 (16:12); 「あと15年ほど待とうと思いました」 (16:14); 「初めてここと元木町がつながったのは、60年ほど前」 (16:99); 「800年前、事故で死に直面しました」 (16:251)
- events:
  - the antagonist introduced: a girl of 14-15 in a crimson kimono, black hair, a soft frail smile, and the narration reaches for 大和撫子 and then for the gap between her appearance and what she is (8:2-8:8)
  - THE BALLOON. She points up; a balloon is caught in a cherry and moving in no wind; two cells of twelve-year-old dialogue cut in with no frame (「おい、栄一郎、無理するな！」 / 「僕はこれでも、荒田集落の山育ちなんだ！」 8:17-8:18); the narrator names the date, the balloon is gone from the tree and is in the girl's hand, and she hands it back — 「どうぞ。これはあなたのものですよね？」 (8:9-8:28)
  - SHE CLAIMS THE KILLING OF 新村栄一郎 AND OF 新村サクラ, in apologies rather than boasts: she needed the balloon to take him, he alone met her 神使 conditions, and she took サクラ too (8:30-8:65). 新村美冬 slaps her and the slap lands on a solid cheek
  - 「いいえ、私は生きた人間です」 (8:58) — she is alive, and has lived several hundred years by borrowing the thing's power (8:60)
  - HER OBJECTIVE, and the file's hinge: asked what happens if she settles in 元木町, the answer is one bare cell in its own row-block — 「元木町すべての人間の命をもらいます。」 (12:0) — with no 「」 round it
  - the negotiation, ~120 cells: the town will not become ruins but will prosper in another form (16:5-16:8); all mammals, not only humans (16:10); she would have waited fifteen more years for the population to grow and cannot now (16:12-16:16); 夏菜 offers her own blood and states she knows her own lethal volume (16:23-16:25); 五島 states the 第三世代 antibody mechanism and the girl confirms it, then says one girl's blood is not enough and that this is why 栄一郎 dosed 茅萱 with ファルシフィカソ (16:27-16:39)
  - her terms: 古郡なつみ and one more person as 第一世代の生者, everyone else returned alive; she offers the place to 春花 with 「そしたら、ずっとずっとなつみさんと一緒ですよ？」 (16:41-16:64). A living 神使 must CHOOSE it, because the ヴェルジ mummy is gone (16:57-16:59)
  - the link is complete: 死月妖花 has run mycelium from 荒田 to 元木町 over 800 years, first connected about sixty years ago, grew a 分身 there and reworked the soil; it will now move through the ground and finish with the four 神使 (16:89-16:105). The giant cherries exist to store nutrient for the move and have drained 荒田 dry (16:106-16:112)
  - THE ATTACK THAT FAILS: she produces the syringe, runs at 茅萱, and is slow — 「運動の苦手な年相応の少女そのもの」 (16:129). She is dodged, slapped down, kicked in the jaw, has her hand stamped on by two people at once, and ends face down begging (16:117-16:194)
  - the beating, and the narrator's refusal of it: 春花, 美冬, 茅萱 and 夏菜 circle her and itemise what they will do; なつみ's word for what she sees is 憐れ, three cells, and she asks to be allowed to talk to her (16:195-16:230). 五島 backs her by calling the group 魔女狩り and 時代錯誤の野蛮人 and citing the right to counsel (16:233-16:237)
  - THE INTERVIEW: she admits everything without hedging (「はい、私がやりました」 16:249), gives the bargain — the thing saved her dying and she gave it human intelligence (16:251-16:253) — and her whole want, in one cell: 「大切な人のそばにいたいのです」 (16:264). The person is buried under 元木町's 御神木 (16:267-16:268)
  - the killings explained as a quota she could not refuse: she chose the old and near death first, cut it to one a year when that failed, and if she had refused to supply corpses the thing would have dropped her and she would have died at once (16:276-16:288)
  - なつみ's offer — come to 元木町 with us now, while you are detached — and the argument that follows: 春花 and 茅萱 and 夏菜 refuse, 五島 says she can pity her precisely because it is not her family, and 美冬 breaks it by saying she once told 古郡茜 the same thing in 女ケ沢 and has no standing to condemn (16:292-16:332)
  - THE THING SHE IS NOT TOLD UNTIL IT IS USELESS: 春花 works out that a skeleton cannot be revived, that 死月妖花 must have known for centuries, and therefore never intended to revive him; 五島 finishes it — the thing kept her because human intelligence was all it wanted, and to stop her telling anyone it exists (16:404-16:418)
  - 「死月妖花が動き始めました」 (20:0) as a one-cell block; she refuses the escape, thanks なつみ, says 「さようなら」, and a typhoon wind and the sound take her. Where she stood: one unused syringe of pink liquid (24:0-24:28)
  - the two corpses come back not themselves — different voice and register — and voices come off the trees in five untagged 「――」 cells; the ground cracks and the file ends on 「これが――／死月妖花。」 (24:29-24:64)

## 00001505  (order 198)

- events (first narrator, 8:0-8:68):
  - the girl is inside the tree: limbs bent, vines through her neck, belly and wrists, the face still hers (8:0-8:5)
  - THE BROKEN SENTENCE. From 8:6 the only thing the thing says is 「わたしは死月妖花と呼ばれる者だ」, printed about eight times in this file with full-width spaces scattered at DIFFERENT positions inside the words each time -> Q603
  - mycelium comes up like whips; 夏菜's blood on a knife drives it back into the ground; it takes 春花 and reaches for the syringe and 夏菜 cuts it off her (8:8-8:32)
  - 夏菜 opens cuts on her own arm, leg and face, and 茅萱 states the limit — her blood works only while it is still flowing (8:35-8:40)
  - the surrounding corpses lose their reason and repeat one phrase per cell (「夏菜から殺せ夏菜から殺せ夏菜から殺せ」 8:41-8:42) -> Q622
  - なつみ is lifted ten metres into the air by the limbs and pulled in front of the girl's face; she calls her name, the sentence breaks apart mid-word for the first time, and at 8:66 the girl's own voice comes through it — 「なつみ……さん……！」. At 8:68 the sentence starts again as 「わ　た　　しの　　望　み　　は」 and the file hands over
- events (second narrator, 8:69-8:521):
  - 800 years ago at the newly cleared 荒田. A retainer calls the leader 皇子; he refuses the title, says he has taken the name 新村, and asks the servant child what she would like to call him. She asks for 「ニイ様」 and he mishears it as 兄様 before she spells it out (8:74-8:92) -> Q606
  - she is eleven; he works the fields himself, the settlement prospers, and she grows. He treats her sometimes as a retainer and sometimes as a woman (8:93-8:99)
  - at fifteen he tells her, going red, that she should carry herself as a woman; she tries, is noticed doing it by 湊綱宗, and is told by him to take it slowly (8:100-8:139)
  - SHE OVERHEARS THE PARTING. From outside a hut she hears him tell 綱宗 he leaves tomorrow: the land is rich enough, other lands are not, and he wants to lay a foundation before 聖守's age ends. 綱宗 forces the other question — what about her — and gets 「もし……／こんな境遇でなければ……／私だって糸姫を……」 (8:147-8:206). She keeps both hands over her MOUTH, not her ears, so as not to be heard (8:182-8:186)
  - she follows him before dawn with a bag packed, cannot catch him, and he stops her from behind. 綱宗 had staged the overheard conversation on purpose (8:211-8:267)
  - he refuses to take her — he is an executable fugitive — and she answers with the one proud thing she has, that her family served the Emperor, and then 「でも私は、その家系である以前に1人の女です！」 (8:280-8:284)
  - THE PROMISE: 聖守's age will end within ten years, and then 「私はまたここへ……／糸を迎えに来る」 — he drops the 姫 (8:300-8:314) -> Q607. He puts a hairpin he carved himself into her hair and leaves without a word (8:323-8:333)
  - she stands there until sunrise and calls him 卑怯者 four ways, and says she will wait ten years or a hundred or a thousand (8:341-8:355)
  - ON THE WAY BACK she is surrounded by seven filthy men in a bamboo thicket, handled, and chased — they keep her pace on purpose. Rather than lead them into the settlement she runs to the cliff by the 広場, refuses to give in, and goes over it (8:363-8:418)
  - she lands alive and broken. The men come down, appraise her body aloud as worthless, take nothing but a snapped hairpin, and leave (8:432-8:439)
  - THE BARGAIN, ~67 cells of one side of a conversation with something that makes no sound: she asks who it is, agrees to give it what it wants, learns it wants corpses to grow from, is told it has put spores on him so it can find him, is told he is dead — killed at 元木 by the remnants of a defeated clan — asks it to reach 元木 and revive him, accepts that this will take centuries, is told she must kill, refuses, is threatened with being dropped, and consents (8:455-8:521). The other side is never printed -> Q609
- speakers present: 古郡なつみ, 糸姫 (narrator from 8:69), 新村春花, 新村夏菜, 新村茅萱, 五島絵梨奈, the corpse chorus, 皇子 (ニイ様), 湊綱宗, an unnamed retainer, the seven 山賊

## 0000151C  (order 199)

- time markers: 「今日の太陽が昇る頃には」 (8:233); 「祀耀800年四月八日――／今日は、新村栄一郎さんの命日」 (8:427-8:428)
- events:
  - the broken sentence continues and then breaks into single kana: 「わ　　たし　を／こ／ろ／し／て」, then 「ほ――／ろ――／ぼ――／し――／て――／滅ぼして」 (8:15-8:29). The girl asks to be destroyed and says she is beyond saving (8:32-8:34)

  - THE PLAN: she takes 夏菜's knife and stabs her own arm. Anyone who touches her blood becomes 第三世代; five people's blood instead of one (8:52-8:76). The corpses immediately name the flaw — 翠眼呪殺, the killing frenzy — and 茅萱 confirms it cannot be resisted (8:77-8:86)
  - the settlement arrives: dozens of people in 能面 and 赤装束, led by 新村エリカ and 新村幸太郎, who had reached the same idea and spent the time breaking the underground passage wide enough to walk. 幸太郎 states the solution — the precognition needs sight or hearing of the person at risk, so if nobody speaks and nobody is recognisable the 呪殺 cannot start — and quotes the ancestral instruction, five cells inside one 『』 (8:105-8:134)
  - everyone has cut themselves before arriving; the mycelium cannot touch them; 五島 confirms no killing has started (8:138-8:149)
  - なつみ is told to shut her eyes so she cannot see them, and does; her viewpoint moves into the girl's and stays there for ~130 cells (8:156-8:294)
  - THE TELEPATHIC CONVERSATION, typeset with the narrator's own transmitted thoughts prefixed 「――」 and the girl's answers in ordinary 「」: an apology for 800 years, the pain of the burning shared through the link, the request — bury the broken hairpin at 元木町's 御神木 — and the loss list, printed one item per cell (予知能力, 翠眼, 翠眼呪殺, ドローガ, ファルシフィカソ) (8:172-8:239) -> Q618, Q628
  - the girl's verdict on the narrator: 「死月妖花最大の失敗は、あなたを感染させてしまったことです」 (8:243), and パンドラの箱 named as the image for it (8:263-8:268). なつみ declines the victory framing — 「ただ、みんなと元木町に帰りたかっただけ」 (8:272)
  - 「――またね、糸姫。」 (8:294). The tree splits, the fragments rise, turn to particles and fall over 荒田, and new flowers come up out of ground that had been drained — 「今年2度目の春」 (8:295-8:302)
  - 夏菜's eyes are both blue now. Everything 死月妖花 caused is gone (8:303-8:312)
  - THE LAST MEETING. The two corpses are still there, skin sloughing, and they are themselves for one scene: 栄一郎 says he is sorry, 美冬 tells him she was glad to be his wife, 春花 gets to say her father's name to his face, and 夏菜 meets her mother for the first time — her mother's hand comes off in hers (8:334-8:411). Both go to bone
  - the narrator's summary: the dead do not come back, that is the order of things, and the exception bought three farewells (8:412-8:425). 「10年前から――／いや、800年も続いていた悪夢が、ようやく覚めるという奇跡が起きた日」 (8:431-8:432)
  - the descent: the 十三回忌 will be held anyway; 五島 carried on 茅萱's back; the girl's bones and the broken hairpin wrapped in a red robe against なつみ's chest; cherries grew only where bodies were buried, so the houses were untouched; 五島 will not rule out the thing regrowing in a few thousand years (8:436-8:481)

## 00001533  (order 200)
- narrator: 古郡なつみ (私), continuous. Two row-blocks, [8] and [27]
- time markers: 「まだ6時半よ？」 (8:21); 「まだ6時50分」 (8:115); 「この時期なのに25度を越える」 (8:42); 「先週の四月八日より前の記憶がない」 (27:47)
- events:
  - an ordinary morning in 元木町: her mother and father see her off, she rings the neighbours' bell at 6:30, 新村美冬's bandage is off, everyone still has the cut on their arm, and 新村エリカ's herbal salve is working faster than expected (8:0-8:12)
  - 春花 is a 受験生 now and her mother has turned into a 教育ママ, using 栄一郎 as leverage (8:13-8:19). 古郡茜 and 新村美冬 bicker across a landing; なつみ dates the friendship at over forty years (8:20-8:32)
  - the cherry avenue, the petal storm, and the narrator's own statement of what cherries are to her — 「嬉しいことも、辛いことも、大変なことも、この桜を通して学んできた」 (8:40-8:46). She can no longer hear the cherries and reads that as proof 荒田 happened (8:48-8:49)
  - an invitation to 荒田 in the summer as tourists (8:50-8:66); 新村エリカ's heart turned out to be in a bad state and was caught before an attack, which なつみ frames as the thing having done one good turn (8:59-8:64)
  - THE BURIAL: at the 中央公園 the 御神木 withered, broke apart and has already been removed, and the town is calling it inexplicable. The three of them meet at dawn to avoid people, dig a small hole with a stick, put the broken hairpin in, and put their hands together (8:85-8:100)
  - a girl in an 元木高校 uniform is talking to 五島 as they arrive and leaves by another exit; she had asked whether the cherry here was gone; 五島 half-recognises her and cannot place her (8:74-8:82)
  - the last piece of exposition in the branch: why four 神使 were needed — spores matured inside all four types to give the organism immunity to 第三世代 blood, after which 不老不死 (8:101-8:111)
  - SCHOOL. 向井 is her form teacher again in 2年2組; her seat is at the back and the one beside it is empty; a transfer student is announced a week later than she should have been (8:133-8:157)
  - THE TRANSFER STUDENT: long straight hair, striking looks, and a face the narrator recognises as the dead girl's. She gives her name as 後白河糸織, says she was born and raised in 大阪, and explains the delay with a joke — she came 500 km by rabbit-hop — into a silent room (8:157-8:184)
  - なつみ stands up and supplies the missing 「なんでやねん！」; the girl lights up, asks for the empty seat, and the two shake hands. The handshake hurts the knife wound and the girl strokes the bandage and says it will heal (8:195-8:232)
  - her closing decision: whether or not this is the dead girl returned, she will bring her in (8:255-8:260)
  - ROOFTOP [27]: the girl asks what なつみ was about to ask at assembly, guesses she resembles someone, is told the person is dead, and says she believes in fortune-telling and may be here because なつみ thought of her. She offers to BE the dead girl's replacement (27:0-27:42)
  - and the reason: she has no memory at all from before 四月八日 of the previous week, does not know how she came to 元木町 or how she lived, remembers only her name, is living in a 元木町 institution while the police investigate, and talked her way into the school rather than sit in the dark (27:44-27:55)
  - a PA call takes her away. なつみ's closing thought: she will not decide the question, she will give the girl good memories instead — 「糸姫という過去ばかりに思いを馳せるのではなく。／糸織という未来へ夢を馳せる」 (27:59-27:77)

- events (新村茅萱, 8:0-8:138):
  - the 十三回忌 was held as planned, with people dozing through it and nobody minding. She thinks about whether the 能面 and 赤装束 custom ends now and decides the form should be kept even if it is hollow (8:0-8:5)
  - her sister asleep on her back; she puts her to bed and strokes her face. 元木町組 are staying the night as originally planned (8:6-8:16)
  - what she has worked out, stated flatly: 「呪殺事件は、まだ真の解決には至っていない」 (8:24)
  - 五島 comes in with a sharp look in a sleepy face, praises 夏菜, and 茅萱 hears it as an accusation about the performance she put the girl through; 五島 refuses the reading, jokes about being stood a Ginza dinner, and 夏菜 half-wakes to say 「お姉ちゃんが、2人いる……」 (8:26-8:60)
  - THE ARSON: 五島 lays it out — only the 蔵's upper floor burned, no electrical fault, only the books on the table burned; the books were needed to lure them to the summit so they cannot have been burned by the thing's side; and it was too late for the fire to have been protective. Therefore somebody did not want those books read, and that somebody is a resident (8:77-8:91)
  - 茅萱 takes her to the iron-barred door under the 秘密基地, reasoning from the absence of old cobwebs that someone uses it often. The lock she herself locked that morning is open (8:95-8:107)
  - behind it: her father, holding 沈丁花, laying them at the mouth of the passage and praying. She asks the three things she cannot account for — why he was treated as the culprit, why he occasionally has her mother's precognition, how he knew she had been taken down here, and why he was hiding here instead of going door to door (8:110-8:127). He says nothing four times
  - his answer when it comes is about himself: the settlement trusts him and there is nothing behind it — 「いまだにサクラが死んだことを受け入れられず、女々しくサクラの幻影に操られていた」 (8:130-8:132). 五島 finishes it for him: he has been meeting his dead wife down here (8:133-8:136)
- events (新村幸太郎, 8:139-8:228):
  - ten years ago he read the storehouse out to cure his daughter's 翠眼呪殺, so he has known about 死月妖花 and セレジェイラ聖教 for ten years (8:139-8:140)
  - days after the death he laid her favourite flowers at the river bank; the 猛き音 sounded and she spoke. She explains she is revived but not alive, can meet only certain people in certain places, and names the innermost part of the 秘密基地 — because there is a road there to 女神様 (8:141-8:165)
  - two years later, 祀耀792, after the second 呪殺: he says the settlement thinks he is taking revenge for her; she offers to prove him innocent by arranging that he be watched while it happens — and so tells him she is the killer (8:168-8:182)
  - HER STATED REASON, which is the thing's: 死月妖花 fears people; the staged suicides of the old did not empty the settlement; so one non-新村 resident a year, and he is asked to persuade everyone to leave. He refuses on two grounds — people will not give up土地, and if he leaves he cannot see her (8:183-8:202)
  - and the standing agreement he never questioned: 夏菜's 翠眼 may be cured, 茅萱's must be left. He asks for a reason and is refused (8:204-8:209)
  - his own verdict, the chunk's last eight cells: he was weak; he knew the killings would happen and who was doing them and said nothing; he knew leaving 茅萱's eyes was dangerous; he could not throw the books away without arousing suspicion so he fitted an electronic lock eight years ago under cover of protecting her; and only after setting the fire did he understand that the wife he had been meeting was never her will but the thing's — 「俺は、ずっと死月妖花に騙され続けていた」 (8:210-8:228)
- speakers present: 新村茅萱 (narrator), 五島絵梨奈, 新村夏菜, 新村幸太郎 (speaker and second narrator), 新村サクラ (in the inset)

  - [8] 春花 wakes on a futon in 五島's flat and is questioned. She is shown a photograph of the woman in white and says it is her mother, who died years ago (8:0-8:100)
  - [8] the mismatch: she believes the year is 802; it is 815; she looks about 20 and is 33 (8:145-8:175). 五島's hypothesis: she was parasitised by the 荒田桜 in 802, lost 13 years without ageing, and has been moved underground from 荒田 to 元木市 — the robes are 菌糸 of オニナラタケ type, the same DNA as the 御神木, and the transfer is either a 100 km mycelium run or a copy-and-rebuild of her particle information (8:186-8:275)
  - [14] 五島's 747 exposition: the モトキザクラ様 urban legend was INVENTED by an occult magazine to bury a real murder — a state research group sent to study the 御神木 was beaten to death in its lodgings. She calls it ナナシナ事件 / 747年事件, says her own 国際研究所 is the second attempt at the same research, and that the present disaster is different: not prevention but extermination, the corpses dissolved to feed exhausted soil. The killer must be a human being already in 元木市 (14:0-14:97)
  - [14] the entryphone: 春花 is standing in the entrance in white, 20 years old; 五島's hand shakes on the release; なつみ begs and is refused; 春花 collapses on camera and なつみ runs down anyway (14:167-14:213)

  - [52] lunch; 五島 asks her, apologetically, to find a corpse and sprinkle petals on it and film it. She does, in ザッハ, on a young woman in a sleeveless dress: about three minutes, a fizzing sound, clear fluid, then bone. She lays the woman's coat over her and puts her hands together (52:0-52:194)

She lays out her four research fields (the 御神木, fungi, brain chemistry, religion), says all four were really a search for 春花, and names the tree: not a cherry, a fungus, whose fruiting body is all anyone has ever seen (64:0-64:210)

## 00001A8C  (order 253)
- narrator: none — a documentary/reference text with an anthropologist's voiceover in 「」
- time markers: 「来年公開予定」 for the film (8:4)
- events:
  - opening clip: a woman with one gun against many zombies, children fleeing — a scene from 『アンデッド・リベンジ2』 (8:0-8:4)
  - zombie films exist in quantity; virus- and experiment-derived ones are sometimes classed as 『サイエンス・アポカリプス』 (8:5-8:7)
  - the etymology: ゾンビ derives from ンザンビ, a god worshipped in the コンゴ region of Africa; anything with mysterious power is ンザンビ, including people, animals and objects; the priesthood attached to it includes a concept of 『死体を操る』, which is what survived into the modern zombie, and such a priest is 呪術者 in Japanese and ネクロマンサー in English; the corpse-controlling idea is found East and West and is therefore probably universal (8:8-8:15)
  - アフリカ文化人類学者 マイケル・ノーマン博士: corpses moving is seen in nature. A fungus that parasitises ants takes over the body and moves it onto a leaf where spores spread best; ロイコクロリディウム works a snail's nervous system. 「『ゾンビ』に似た現象は自然界ではごく当たり前に存在しているのです」 (8:16-8:20)
  - so a human being controlled is not impossible, and an African witness of such a thing may be where the idea came from (8:21-8:23)
  - the ギニアワーム example: it enters through drinking water, grows a year in the stomach, moves to the leg, causes fever and severe pain, and when the host enters water to cool it breaks the skin and lays eggs there. Organisms that work a human being to reproduce exist, and in a pre-scientific age would look like a curse (8:24-8:28)
  - the close: religious texts everywhere record people going mad, corpses moving and demons spreading; some of it is natural phenomena that can now be re-examined; concluding 未知の力 is easy and lazy; and 「すべての事象には必ず、原因と理由があるのです」 (8:29-8:37)
- speakers present: マイケル・ノーマン (NEW, アフリカ文化人類学者), the documentary voice
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: マイケル・ノーマン, ンザンビ, コンゴ, 呪術者, 司祭職, アンデッド・リベンジ2, サイエンス・アポカリプス, 死体を操る, 未知の力
- voice/relationship changes: none
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: this file states the project's whole mechanism — a fungus that moves a dead host to spread spores — as a piece of ordinary popular science, 253 files in, with no link to the story ever made. Keep it as sceptical and as flat as it is -> Q741
- resolves from earlier files: Q493 advances — ネクロマンサー, which a schoolgirl coins as a nickname at 000011E3, is here given a real etymology

## 00001BB4  (order 275)
- narrator: none. 55 lines, the 秘密基地 at New Year, at night
- time markers: 「新年早々」; this is the quarrel 夏菜 reports at 00001B70:11:102
- events: 茅萱 takes her sister somewhere adults will not find them and says the culprit is their father. 夏菜 accuses her of wanting her to kill him, says she has decided to 成敗 whoever it is with her own hand, and pulls a knife: 「お姉ちゃんがそうやって私にパパを殺させようとするなら、今お姉ちゃんを殺す」 and 「お姉ちゃんがそうやってみんなを 唆 して呪殺を起こしたんじゃないの？」. 茅萱 gives the file's definition — 「呪殺って言うのは、そうやって疑心暗鬼になって互いを殺すことなの」 — and 夏菜 answers 「ギシンアンキ？」. Told that killing her would make her the one causing 呪殺, 夏菜 answers 「これは呪殺じゃない。だって、呪殺が起きるのは四月だもん」. 茅萱 then says 「分かった。私を殺しなさい」, disarms her in one cell, and lectures her on wavering. The file ends 「わ、私はパパが犯人だなんて信じない！　お姉ちゃんのうそつき！」
- speakers present: 新村茅萱, 新村夏菜
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 疑心暗鬼(already present — not re-added), ギシンアンキ, 成敗, ナイフ捌き
- voice/relationship changes: 新村茅萱 -> 新村夏菜 (夏菜 bare, the 「ん……」 tic on every line including the disarming one, ～なさい imperatives); 新村夏菜 -> 新村茅萱 (お姉ちゃん, タメ口, and a death threat with the address form intact)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:32 「 唆 」 carries ruby-residue spacing -> Q788, Q010. 「ギシンアンキ」 in katakana is a child repeating a word she does not know, and it recurs at 00001BCE:8:53 — EN needs one device for both -> Q776. The third in-world definition of 呪殺, and it contradicts neither of the earlier two -> Q775, Q165, Q213

## 00001BCE  (order 278)

## 00001C23  (order 288)
- narrator: none. 53 lines, before the marriage
- time markers: 美冬 has just reported the engagement to 茜
- events: 栄一郎 tells 美冬 what his mother told him on the telephone an hour earlier — that 荒田集落's residents all kill themselves in April at 75. He tries twice to call the marriage off. 美冬 refuses on the ground that people die sooner or later, that she is done with a cautious frightened life, and that the frightening thing is growing old without him. She adds that a known finish line makes a life easier to live fully and that being the same age they can end together. He weeps. Her last question is the practical one nobody answers: does the rule apply to people BORN in 荒田 or people LIVING in 荒田? He says he will ask his mother

- resolves from earlier files: 新村エリカ's fifty-year policy of never stopping a suicide (00000B0F:11:109-11:137) is shown at the point where it is passed to an outsider as a fact about the place

## 00001C5D  (order 294)
- narrator: 五島絵梨奈, 私, plain past. The night before the 法要, on the 縁側 at 新村本家
- time markers: the funeral is tomorrow; the 新村本家 cherry is now low because the tree itself has dropped into the ground
- events:
  - she reasons about the 荒田桜 alone: opium from poppies, marijuana from hemp, and a cherry as the source of ephedrine and methamphetamine — then corrects herself, 「桜にエフェドリンが含まれているというのは俗説に過ぎない」 — and asks why the 俗説 exists at all. 「灯台の下に真相があっただけ」 (11:6-11:21)
  - 茅萱 comes out looking for matches. 五島 stares at her and then accuses her outright: the point of the 呪殺 was to turn suspicion away from 幸太郎; whether he was guilty was irrelevant; what was unbearable was losing him. A knife goes to her throat and then a second one (11:38-11:116)
  - 五島 reads the second knife as proof of no intent — one knife and one second would do it — and concludes 茅萱 wants her silent, not dead, because killing her would destroy the family and leave 夏菜 alone. She names the standoff 「ただの茶番」 (11:117-11:126)
  - 茅萱 answers questions: a knife was enough, there were no accomplices, and after she left for Tokyo the residents killed each other anyway. 五島 says that is too convenient
  - THE COLLAPSE: pushed to say what she is hiding, 茅萱 goes down on hands and knees, sobs in a voice 五島 calls 「下品で無邪気」, and says 「私は……生まれた時から……呪われた身体なの」, showing her eyes. 「この目が、人を殺す――／呪殺の証」. Then 祀耀790, her mother's death at her tenth year, and — if she was killed — 「お母さんを殺そうとしたのは1人だけじゃない」 (11:147-11:169)
  - [15] is a one-cell block: 「私もお母さんを殺したかった」
  - [19] 春花 shouts for the matches; 茅萱 leaves without waiting for a reply and 五島 stays rigid until they are gone, then beats the tatami and swears (「くそ！」 split one word per cell across five cells, then 「ちくしょう！」 six times in one cell)
  - THE RETRACTION OF HER OWN CASE, 19:19-19:67: she has been comprehensively misled; a deliberate 巧妙なミスリード was laid along every route she took; the case is deeper and darker than she can order. Not 幸太郎, not 茅萱, but 「まったく別の意思」, 「この荒田集落に巣食う悪魔のような存在」. She rejects the supernatural as a label rather than a thing (「私が見たいのはラベルではない。／中身だ」), insists on causality, and then stops herself: 夏菜 has only 茅萱 left, so reassuring 夏菜 comes before the truth
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈, 新村茅萱, 新村春花 (four lines)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 俗説, ミスリード(already present — not re-added), 因果律, 超常現象(already present — not re-added), 灯台下暗し
- voice/relationship changes: 新村茅萱 -> 五島絵梨奈 keeps 五島ちゃん and the 「ん……」 tic through the entire knife scene; it drops only inside the collapse (11:150-11:169), which is the second place in the project her tic is absent — the first was to her father at 00000B9F:11:108-11:110. One new RELATIONS row
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: [15] is one cell alone, no speaker tag, no narration — the twelfth-plus use of the one-cell reveal block -> Q806, Q179. 「呪われた身体」 and 「この目が、人を殺す」 are 茅萱's own reading of 翠眼 and are not corrected in this file. 11:105 has a source typo — 「自殺だったしても」 for 自殺だったとしても -> Q818

## 00001EFF  (order 317)
- narrator: 新村茅萱, 私, plain past — her first narration of a resolution, and the only file in which she narrates her own family's ending
- time markers: after the organism's death; the 沈丁花 are on the grave
- events:
  - 幸太郎 says he was deceived by 死月妖花 throughout; 茅萱 refuses the framing — 「お父さん！　なに被害者ぶってるの！？」 — and names the dead
  - 五島 defends him structurally: 死月妖花 absorbed many people and gained their intelligence with them, so manipulating one man was easy and anybody else would have served
  - 茅萱's own 白昼夢, 8:21-8:42, with no frame at either end: her mother appears and says she may meet her, alone and unseen, on one condition — 「毎年、1人ずつ茅萱が人を殺さないといけないの」 — because if her father is removed from the settlement the meetings stop, and 「必ず、ナイフでやるの」
  - 8:43-8:68 she works out that it was not a daydream but a memory: the dream she had a year after her mother died, just before the first 呪殺, on the day she heard 城崎's wife planning to hand her father over. She killed the woman IN THE DREAM, did not know it was a dream, and carried the guilt for nine years without ever having killed anyone. 「実際に、私が誰かを殺すことはなかった」 — and she indicts herself anyway, for having been willing
  - 五島's reading: 死月妖花 needed a standing scapegoat who believed herself guilty; 茅萱 says 「私はスケープゴートにされていたのね」
  - 五島 then names the flaw that broke it: 茅萱's believed method was stabbing and the actual corpses were beaten, and she suggests the error may have been a hint from サクラ and 栄一郎, in whom some self was left — while saying it may equally have been the thing's own design
  - 茅萱 takes the 沈丁花 off the grave, tells her father this is not her mother's grave and that he must stop clinging, makes him say the 花言葉 (不死、不滅、永遠), and holds him while he sobs for the first time she has ever seen. Her conclusion: what kept the case unsolved for ten years was one simple thing — he did not want to lose the person he loved
  - 五島 will not let the crime go in principle and says so, then says she does not know how she would explain any of it to the police, so she will tell nobody — and asks for payment: 「だから、この荒田集落をもっといい場所にして下さいね」. 茅萱 promises to make it somewhere 五島 will want to come back to, and they book an eating contest at the Ginza restaurant
  - the last thirteen cells are a dream of 糸姫山's summit with her whole family under an ordinary cherry, and a farewell: 「もう私も、お母さんの幻影から卒業しないとね。／さよなら、お母さん」
- speakers present: 新村茅萱, 五島絵梨奈, 新村幸太郎, 新村サクラ (inside the daydream)
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: スケープゴート, 白昼夢, 幻視, 被害者ぶる
- voice/relationship changes: the 「ん……」 tic is on every spoken line and absent from narration, as always; 茅萱 -> 幸太郎 is お父さん throughout including the accusation
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:21-8:42 has no frame at either end — the reader meets it as a present-tense scene and is told what it was afterwards. Do not add a marker -> Q805, Q355, Q546. 8:85-8:90 leaves the hint question open in both directions and 五島 says so twice
- resolves from earlier files: 新村茅萱's five confessed murders (Q461) and the stabbing/beating mismatch (Q462) get their mechanism from inside her own head for the first time — an induced dream, not an implanted hallucination as 000014D7:8:270 has it. The two explanations are compatible but are not the same words. ACTION: revisit y

## 00002057  (order 331)
- narrator: none. 61 lines, the material store, the night the 古郡 couple are taken
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 城崎健吾, the 古郡 couple (one line, 8:2-8:3), a resident (「――」)
- events: the couple are shut in. 幸太郎 says the 呪殺 ends with the 魔女 captured. 城崎 refuses it: how did he reach the conclusion that ten years of 呪殺 were done by an ordinary 元木町 couple? 幸太郎 says 考察. 城崎: 「ふざけないでくれ。俺は騙されない」 — and then names his own reason for striking the couple, which is not grief: 「ここで逆らう選択肢なんてない。／俺がここで武器を振らなければ、俺は村八分になる」. He grants that the circumstances look bad and that the settlement's fear is understandable, and then puts the inversion: what if the schoolgirls came to help and the couple were hiding in the store to support them from outside? 幸太郎 falls back on 「だって彼女は魔女の力を……！」 and 城崎 rejects it — 「サクラちゃんと同じ力があるから魔女！？　／ふざけるな！」 — and raises the house-arrest years, when 幸太郎 knew there would be victims. Then 幸太郎 slips: 「でも、俺は聞いたんですよ！　あの夫婦が犯人だって！」 / 「誰からだ？」 / 「え？」 / 「俺はそれが聞きたかった。／幸太郎君とあろう者が、ついにボロを出したな。／幸太郎君を 唆 すやつがいるんだろ？」 / 「黒幕は誰なんだ？」. A shout interrupts — the 魔女 are coming — and 幸太郎 turns it round: 城崎 cannot withdraw now, 「村八分が怖いんでしたっけ？」, and hands him ドローガ. The last cell is 「これがドローガか……。／くそ……！」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 村八分, 黒幕, 仕上げ
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:46 「 唆 」 ruby-residue spacing -> Q788, Q010. 「黒幕は誰なんだ？」 is never answered and the chunk ends there
- resolves from earlier files: 村八分 is the first stated mechanism for why ordinary residents take part in the killings, and it is given by a participant about himself -> Q800. 城崎's 「君は誰だ？」 at 00001C1D:8:34 and 「俺は騙されない」 here are the same suspicion, two files apart

- events: he introduces himself as the sitting mayor seeking a sixth term after 20 years, claims the population has risen about eightfold and the elderly ratio is 13%, the lowest in Japan, and then turns to 「2か月前、この元木町で痛ましい事件」 which broke the town's 安心・安全神話. He takes the blame for weak security, and gives three pledges: subsidies to make 元木町 the highest-income municipality in Japan; tourism built on the cherry and the basin geography, with the subsidy money coming from it; and 1,000 surveillance cameras plus a committee to repair 町のほころび so that ブロークンウィンドウ理論 does not take hold. He closes on the 中央公園の御神木 as a figure for growth
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 町長選挙, 公約, ブロークンウィンドウ理論, 高齢率, 地域活性化, 補助金, ブランディング
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the whole file is a SIXTH unmarked text format — public speech as bare narration cells, no 「」, no narrator, no frame at either end -> Q833, Q413, Q071. Which incident 「2か月前」 is, is never named
- resolves from earlier files: the 監視カメラ that 00000B27 and later files take for granted are installed by this pledge, and the 元木町 growth 五島 cites at 0000156A:14:154-14:157 is his

## 00002102  (order 359)

## 0000210E  (order 361)

## 00002143  (order 369)

- events: she spends days looking for 荒田 in a geography book and cannot find it. Her father comes in unusually soft and says 「桔梗、お前の結婚相手が決まったぞ」 — she is 16, the marriage is next month, and she will meet him on the day. Her narration explains the custom without complaint. Then a commotion below: the masked man again. She follows at a distance because a bride-to-be cannot be seen talking to a stranger, loses him in a cul-de-sac, and is addressed from behind — he doubled back because she was following and wanted somewhere unobserved. She then spends the afternoon on a new kimono, her hair and make-up she does not know how to do; her father takes it for bridal preparation and is relieved. Her narration: 「結婚が決まった身である以上、背徳感がないとは言わない」 and then 「何を考えているの、私」

## 00002158  (order 371)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: he asks whether 東京 has many women interested in the West; she says women are only asked to be good wives. He answers 「愚かな男もいれば、聡明な女もいる。／意欲と情熱があれば、性別なんて関係ないと思いますが……」. She asks what women are like at 荒田 and gets the 大魔女 explained: a woman leads, and 「大魔女こそが、集落の知恵と知識の結晶なんです」. He predicts Westernisation will open the same door here; she says only a few women ever get through it and she is a merchant's daughter — and then, 「それに私……／来月結婚するんです」. He goes quiet and looks at the river. Her narration turns the river into the argument — a current cannot be resisted, and neither can custom — and ends 「なぜ今、慣習に逆らうことを考えたのだろうか」

## 0000215E  (order 372)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: he answers the river with the file's central speech: a river cannot be resisted but it reaches the sea and unknown land, so nature is free; people are powerless before it and are also fed by it, therefore 「人間も、もっと自由であるべき」; and 「自然とは、人間の師です。……その自由が奪われるということは、自然に逆らうことと同じではないでしょうか」. He says her passion should not be crushed by custom. He asks about the husband and learns she has never met him and will not until the day; he raises his voice for the only time — 「でも、そんなのおかしいと思いませんか！？」 — and then apologises. He asks 「桔梗殿は、どのように生きたいのですか？」 and she asks whether wanting has any meaning; he says 「あります」. She corrects him: dreaming is easy, 「もっと大事なことは……／夢をかなえるために行動することです」, and without action it is 夢物語 — and she cannot act alone. She calls him 無責任 and cites 「これがこの時代、この場所の 掟」. He stands up: 「だったら、荒田集落に来て下さい」
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:72 「 掟 」 carries ruby-residue spacing -> Q010, Q624
- resolves from earlier files: 「夢物語」 and the action-over-dreaming argument are hers, and they are the reasoning she applies to ドローガ eleven files later

## 00002164  (order 373)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: the invitation is repeated and she refuses it: going means abandoning her house and shaming her father. He accepts that she has something she values more than the dream. Her narration corrects him privately — what stops her is the custom, not the love. He says 「望まぬ相手と一緒にならないといけない。／その気持ち、俺にはよく分かります」 and insists 「俺には分かるんですよ！」; she rounds on him, then breaks off with a formal goodbye and leaves. She runs home in the dark, glad it is night. Rain starts. She trips, ruins the kimono and the make-up, and thinks 「しょせん、私にはこの方がお似合い」. She realises what the feeling is — 後悔 — and works through it: she did not act, therefore it stayed a 夢物語; 「私がその選択肢を蹴ったのだから、私のせい」; and 「夢は見ても、もう後悔だけはしないでおこう」
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: his 「俺には分かるんですよ！」 is literally true and neither she nor the reader knows it yet; the EN must not tip it -> Q861

## 0000217A  (order 376)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私. The file opens 「――糸姫山を下り、1人で帰路に着く」, one year later, and the middle is a retrospective explanation
- time markers: one year has passed; the arrangement dates from 晃's first visit
- events: she has finished the year in the mountain that every woman marrying into 荒田 must do. The explanation: at the audience 晃 asked the 帝 for help, because 荒田 takes almost no brides from outside and needs women; the specification was 「深い教養があり、思慮深い者」 with 女らしさ explicitly second, since that can be taught. The 帝 said he would consider it, and a suitable woman was found — her, named for being a known 才女 of marriageable age. The order went to her father. 晃 was recalled and objected that the parties should choose; he had no choice because the order came from the 帝. Her father was told everything about the groom and forbidden to tell her, in case she ran, which would shame the 帝 — and, her narration adds, 「父上は父上で、本当に私に相応しい相手を選んでくれていた」. Nobody knew the two had already met. She comes home with 「ただいま、晃さん」 and runs the joke a fourth time about the mountain
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 貢物, 山籠(already present — not re-added)
- voice/relationship changes: her address form changes on screen from 晃様 to 晃さん at 8:49 and stays there for the rest of the run. One new RELATIONS row
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the 山籠 is presented as compulsory for every incoming bride, against 000020B4:8:41 where it is 「形骸化した儀礼」 122 years later -> Q854
- resolves from earlier files: 糸姫山 (0000107B) is where 荒田 brides are sent, and 新村美冬's and 新村サクラ's 山籠 are the same institution 500 years on

## 00002181  (order 377)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: asked what she wants as a reward for the 山籠 she asks for books, and is given the key to the 新村家 storehouse: centuries of volumes, some written by the Westerners who came, in languages nobody in the settlement can now read. Deciphering them is the job that comes with the gift. Then: 「晃さん、ドローガって知ってますか？」 / 「人間の力を高める薬さ」. He has never used it — 「使い方が難しいらしくて、20歳以上にならないと使わせてもらえない」 — but it is used for hunting, and it was what he tried to present to the 帝. The 帝 refused it as suspicious and offered him something instead, and 「だから俺は思い切って、荒田に住んでもいい女はいないかって聞いてみたんだ」. His mother the 大魔女 sent him: 「この列強と交わる時代、そろそろドローガの効果についても研究した方がいいんじゃないかってね」. 桔梗 finishes the reasoning herself and accepts the research
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 蔵書, 因果律(see 00002187)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the whole marriage exists because a tribute was refused, and neither of them remarks on it
- resolves from earlier files: 000021A5:8:31-8:33 will produce the letter he carried; the 20-year age rule on ドローガ is stated here for the first time

## 00002187  (order 378)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私. 32 lines, almost entirely her notes; no dialogue
- events: her working summary of ドローガ — refined from the root of the cherry that grows wild at 荒田, the crystal burned and the smoke inhaled, producing strength like a 鬼神, which is why 荒田 never lacks food. Then the objection that is her whole character: 「あらゆるものには因果律が存在する。……そこには必ず理屈があり、原因があり、結果がある」. It was invented about 400 years ago and nobody knows the details, which she refuses to believe. She notes the storehouse is full of Western concepts — 死神, 魔女 — and that 大魔女 plus several 魔女 run the settlement; that ドローガ means 『薬』 in a Western language; that a 死神 elsewhere escorts the dead but 「この集落では、死んだ者を死神と呼ぶ」. The 法要: everyone in 能面 and 赤装束, the 大魔女 destroys the dead person's garment, and that is all — no incense, no offering — 「どちらかと言えば、死神を退治するかのような儀式」. And the settlement worships a mummy, a girl called ヴェルジ, revered for about 300 years for saving the place
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 因果律
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: her 「300年ほど前」 for ヴェルジ against 祀耀352 (00002193:8:43) gives 祀耀678-352 = 326 — consistent, unlike most of the project's arithmetic -> Q112
- resolves from earlier files: the 法要 as the destruction of a garment, and 死神 as the settlement's word for its own dead, are given a first-hand description by the outsider who had to work them out -> Q052, Q213, Q866

## 0000218D  (order 379)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- time markers: five years since she came to 荒田; she and 晃 have a child
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: she advises him to stop using ドローガ: 「私にはどうも、あの薬は何かの罠である気がして……」. Her ground is 400 years of odd events at 荒田, and her reading that a 戒め set up to survive a crisis decays into legend once the crisis passes. The thing that worries her most is 『翠眼呪殺』, in the storehouse books: children are occasionally born with green eyes, and the instruction is 『緑の目の男児はそのまま育てよ。緑の目の女児は即刻殺すべし』. The only child born since she arrived is her own, so she cannot check, and she is reluctant to ask her husband whether they kill baby girls. She asks anyway — 「翠眼呪殺ってご存知ですか？」 — and his body stops
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 戒め
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:19 is the RULE in classical imperative, shorter and older than the version at 000014D7, and it is sex-split where the modern files are not -> Q840, Q297
- resolves from earlier files: the green-eye infanticide the elders invoke at 00002072 is a written 荒田 rule 122 years earlier, and this file is where a 大魔女 first questions it

## 00002193  (order 380)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 新村晃
- events: he confirms it: green-eyed newborns are killed, it happened once in his lifetime, and he does not know why — 「 掟 だから」. Her narration defends the 掟 in principle (「 掟 とは人を縛るためのものではない。／人を守るために 掟 があるのだ」) and then gives the history she has reconstructed. 祀耀340年三月, about 340 years earlier: an internal war at 荒田, several people turning green-eyed and killing residents, the population halved, the killing continuing until only one green-eyed person was left — a girl too young to speak, named トミ. The residents feared her and did nothing for twelve years. 祀耀352年 she went mad, tore out her own eyes with her hands and killed herself, and was enshrined as a goddess: 「それがあの、ヴェルジのミイラである」. 130 years later, 祀耀482年: records of a 『女神』 and a 『猛き音』; residents vanished; 「尋常ではない巨大な桜」 covered the mountains; the goddess was driven off somehow and the settlement survived, at the cost of the young 大魔女's life. ドローガ was banned as a result — and the people who would not accept the ban took all the remaining supply and left, going south toward 女ケ沢. The ban itself has since worn away. 晃 has heard none of it, but he does know about a disappearance: 「それが起きたのはほんの10年ほど前のことだ」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 内紛(already present — not re-added), 祀耀340年(not added — see note), 翠眼呪殺(already present — not re-added)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:23, 8:25, 8:28, 8:29 「 掟 」 all carry ruby-residue spacing -> Q010, Q624
- resolves from earlier files: this is the single largest block of back-story in the project and it sources four separate things at once — ヴェルジ/トミ (Q387), the 猛き音 (Q124, Q492), the 女神 above ヴェルジ (Q386), and the origin of セレジェイラ聖教 near 女ケ沢 (Q451, Q867). ACTION: revisit y

## 00002199  (order 381)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗; her mother-in-law's document quoted in 『』; 新村晃
- events: she borrows the previous 大魔女's written account of the disappearance ten years earlier and deposits it in the storehouse against 記憶の風化. The document, four passages in 『』: the spring after the mass disappearance, several dozen cherry trees appeared around 荒田 where none had been, blossoming as though they had always done so; about 30 of them, 「奇しくも、失踪した住人の数とほぼ同じである」; one was dug up and replanted and 「根に絡まるように衣服と骸骨が現れた」, so 「この桜の木は、住人を苗床にして突然育ったのだ。／この木は桜の木なんかではない。／桜にそっくりな別の何か、だ」; and the name — 『古来、この突然現れた桜の木らしきものを、『死月妖花』と呼んでいたそうだ。／怪しげな花が、死の月に咲くのだ。／荒田集落の者は、事故やけがでない限り、ほぼ間違いなく四月に死亡する。／だから、死月だ』. The last passage sets the policy: stop explaining it with curses and 妖怪, send a representative to 東京 with ドローガ, get money and equipment, and 「例え100年かかるとしても、世代を越えて解き明かすべきだろう」. 桔梗's own conclusion is that the tree uses ドローガ to breed through people. But something does not fit: if it is suspect, why has her mother-in-law not simply stopped it? 晃 cannot answer. Her last cells: 「おそらく、そうせざるを得ない理由があるのだ」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 神話主義, 骸骨
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the document is set as bare cells inside 『』 with no speaker and no signature -> Q071, Q504, Q531
- resolves from earlier files: the project's title term 『死月妖花』 is DEFINED on screen, etymology and all, and the definition is that 荒田 people die in April -> Q495, Q427. The 0000133D:8:189-8:192 plan to send a representative to 東京 is this document -> Q532

## 000021A5  (order 383)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- time markers: 祀耀729年三月; she is 65
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 篠崎ハジメ
- events: a man arrives by motor car, salutes, and gives his name — 「私は政府より派遣されました、篠崎ハジメと申します！」. She lets him in because a lone traveller from 東京 cannot be turned away and because the neighbours are watching. He produces an old letter opening 「私は辺境の地、荒田から参りました」 and signed 『荒田集落代表　新村晃』, and she has to stop and look at it. His errand: 「今こそ、この薬が国の役に立つのではないか」. She catches him out at once — he says he has never been to 飯沢県 and his accent is 飯沢県's, which she can hear because she was born in 東京. She lies back: the drug is no longer used. He wants the cherry trees, as many as possible, and will build a railway to move them; felling and transport are all his. She grants it on two conditions, printed as a two-item 「・」 list: the 新村本家 cherry stays, and the research results are given to the settlement in writing

## 000021B7  (order 386)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, 篠崎ハジメ, residents (three objecting cells)
- events: seeing him, her memory comes back and with it her purpose. He apologises for the delay and puts down a thick sheaf: 「率直に申し上げて……／あの薬は、人間が手を出すべきものではないという結論に達しました」. The contents, summarised in one cell: the spores in ドローガ, the nature of the ヴェルジ mummy, and 「女神と呼ばれる邪悪な存在」. He then confesses the lie; she says she guessed and thanks him anyway. Reading the report she finds their purpose too: they are the descendants and fellows of the people who left 荒田, now a sect called セレジェイラ聖教, who worshipped ドローガ as a 神器 until their leader began asking the same question the previous 大魔女 asked. They had government members and a budget. Now that they know, 「教団は崩壊しつつある」. She bans ドローガ and gives no reason, because reasons wear off and bans have been issued and forgotten before. Her other measure: 死月妖花 is 菌類, 「寄生性の強いナラタケの仲間」, so removing the fruiting bodies is useless — instead she rewrites the 法要 so that ファルシフィカソ, the by-product of refining ドローガ, becomes a ritual implement and is therefore made forever. 「ファルシフィカソは、ドローガに感染した者への特効薬になる」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 神器, 禁止令
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: she deliberately withholds the reason for the ban, which is why 122 years later nobody at 荒田 knows what ファルシフィカソ is for -> Q865
- resolves from earlier files: セレジェイラ聖教's origin, funding and collapse (Q451, Q450), the fungal identity of 死月妖花 (Q665, Q741), and the whole existence of ファルシフィカソ (00001C29, 000020C0, 000020D2) are answered in one file -> Q864, Q865, Q867. ACTION: revisit y

## 000021BD  (order 387)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私. TWO row-blocks, [8] and [21], which print the SAME covering note with DIFFERENT dates
- events, block [8]: she rewrites the old storehouse documents into contemporary Japanese, with a preface in 『』 — 「ここから先、重要なことが書かれています。／少しでも子孫たちが読みやすいよう、今の言葉に翻訳しています。／どうか、これを役立ててください。／私はもう、長くはありません。／祀耀735年　大魔女　新村桔梗」. The 祀耀482 account says 新村椿, a young 大魔女, drove off 死月妖花 at the cost of her life; 桔梗 notes it is still here. Her two-item plan, a 「・」 list: dose the residents with ファルシフィカソ, seal the ヴェルジ mummy. She doses everyone that afternoon. Next day she goes to the underground store and seals the mummy behind a 封石, having decided against burning it or giving it to 篠崎 — because トミ is 第三世代, the mummy is what makes infected people into cherry trees, and if it were destroyed 「死月妖花はまた新しいミイラを作る」. She has the passage barred with iron under a cover story of a cave-in, worked by a handful of people, secret from the rest: 「新村家の者が許容しない限り、この先へ立ち入ることはできない」
- events, block [21]: the identical preface signed 「1942年　大魔女　新村桔梗」, then the 祀耀482 text itself — after the 猛き音 a girl long dead returned as a 妖花; the possessed vanished and became cherry trees with their clothes wound round the roots; the thing is enraged that 「失った彼女の分身を太閤殿下に持ち去られ」; whoever used ドローガ, or their children, is drawn to it and becomes part of it; giant cherries swallowed the mountains, the land died, and 「白き装束をまとった者たちが、生者を連れ去ろうとする」. They defeated it by sacrificing the surviving 翠眼, returned the dead and revived the land — and then トミ, the last 翠眼 girl, killed herself, so 「死月妖花はまだ生きている」. It closes with the classical five-line instruction and repeats the same two-item plan
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 封石, 太閤殿下, 新村椿, 1942年
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: THE SAME SIGNATURE BLOCK IS DATED 祀耀735年 IN [8] AND 1942年 IN [21]. Every other date in the project is 祀耀. Either the era maps to the real calendar at 祀耀735 = 1942 (making the story present 祀耀800 = 2007) or one of the two is a slip, and the file gives no way to tell -> Q827 (owner-blocking)
- ambiguity, continued: the five-line instruction is printed here for the SIXTH time and this version reads 「子孫は必ず血色の装束をまとい抗うべし」 — without 面, and without the ruby-residue spacing every other printing carries -> Q841, Q536, Q619, Q777
- resolves from earlier files: the sealed iron gate 新村茅萱 finds behind an electronic lock (0000130D:8:136-8:171), the 封石 新村サクラ starts to move (000020C0:8:24-8:28), and the document 新村エリカ recites two lines of without knowing whose words they are (000013FD) all originate in this one file -> Q536, Q558, Q631. ## 000021C3  (order 388)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私
- time markers: February
- speakers present: 新村桔梗; a voice at the end
- events: she goes from the underground store to the 蔵 to write up what she has done. Passing the last cherry she says 「晃さん……。／これで、いいんですよね？」 and sets out what she has worked out: nobody has disappeared since she arrived, because the thing was wary of her; 「死月妖花には知性がある」; and it could not move while somebody suspected it. Her own research stopped when her husband and mother-in-law died — 「そう、晃さんたちは死月妖花に殺された――／私はそう確信している」. Now she has given the trees away, the ban is in place and the antidote is built into the rites, so it has nothing left to lose and no reason not to kill her. She lists three regrets: not finishing the translation sooner, walking this path alone, and 「その気配に気づいてしまったこと」. Cherry petals blow past in February; a familiar voice says 「桔梗」; and a young man stands there, unaged: 「そう、晃さんが迎えに来たのだ」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 狂い咲き(already present — not re-added)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the last cell asserts it is her husband in her own narration, in a file that has just explained that the dead walk -> Q545, Q861
- resolves from earlier files: the 「詰んだ」 reasoning here is the mirror of 000021C9's answer, and the two files must be read as one argument

## 000021C9  (order 389)
- narrator: 新村桔梗, 私. Three row-blocks: [8], [12] (ONE cell), [16]
- speakers present: 新村桔梗, the 女神 wearing 新村晃's body
- events: she greets him and then names it — 「晃さんの 躯 をかぶった女神様。／もう、あなたは終わりです」 — and says the settlement is free of it. It answers 「甘いな」 and 「この程度で勝ったと思うなんて」, and offers to tell her the plan before she dies. The plan is block [12], one cell alone: この集落の全ての人間を殺す. She objects that it could then not breed; it calls that self-centred and asks how long it has been here — 「私は何千年も何万年も前からここにいたんだ。／しかし人間が来たのはほんの700年ほど前。／それまで私はどうやって繁殖してきた？」. Then 「桔梗、さようなら」. Her consciousness goes and she understands on the way out: any mammal will do — 熊, 鹿, 兎, 狐, 猪, 狸 — and 「死月妖花は長い年月をかけて、人間から知性を奪った。／だからもう、人間に用はない」. Twice she writes 「私の考えは――／甘かった」. Her last passage is an address to descendants: the clues are in the storehouse, she never wrote the 仕上げ, and 「どうか死月妖花を滅ぼしてくれ。／それが私の――／晃さんの――／荒田の人間たちの願いだから――」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 躯, 万物の長, ふっふっふ
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: [12] is a whole row-block of one unquoted cell with no speaker tag and no terminal stop, the one-cell reveal device again -> Q838, Q179, Q158. 8:6 「 躯 」 and 16:22 「 兎 」「 狐 」「 猪 」「 狸 」 carry ruby-residue spacing -> Q851, Q010
- resolves from earlier files: the 女神 states its own age, its breeding range and its motive in its own voice for the only time in the project, and the claim that it took human intelligence is never tested anywhere -> Q868, Q386, Q863. The 「仕上げ」 she could not write is why every later 大魔女 has half a transmission -> Q567, Q777. ACTION: revisit y

## 000021CF  (order 390)
- narrator: 篠崎ハジメ, later renamed 金崎勉, 私. His FIRST narration anywhere; the chunk-27 run of 新村桔梗 ends at the file boundary with no marker and this man takes over -> Q919, Q828, Q030, Q078
- time markers: the day he learns of 新村桔梗's death (winter, deep snow, so after 祀耀735); 「教団が消滅してから15年が経過していた」 (8:320); then an unnumbered later night
- speakers present: 篠崎ハジメ／金崎勉; the 教団本部長 (later using the alias 土田); 荒田 residents (three shouted cells); his wife; an office colleague; a young woman on the street; his grandson チャー坊; and at the end a voice on a telephone that is the 本部長 speaking to somebody the reader never hears
- events: (1) He walks down a snowbound mountain after going to 荒田 on hearing 桔梗's death and being met with shouting — 「何しに来た！」 「この泥棒め！」 「桔梗さんに何をした！」. He reasons that 桔梗 never passed the warning to the residents, that his report sits unread in the 蔵書, and that only he and the sect leadership know what 荒田桜 is. He sets himself one duty: get the warning to the settlement. (2) The sect collapses: subjects fled the ドローガ experiments and blew the whistle; ドローガ as a 神具 is exposed as the fungus's trap. (3) The 本部長 orders him to change his 戸籍; his new name is 『金崎 勉』 and he is placed in the 飯沢県 civil service as the officer responsible for 荒田地区. He asks for the posting himself and asks that 荒田地区 be made 国有地 under state watch. (4) He considers plastic surgery because his face is known at 荒田, and drops it when his wife objects. (5) He sends subordinates in on land-survey pretexts to watch for a newly married woman doing the 山籠, so he can hand the report to somebody not yet loyal to the settlement. The visits breed a rumour that he is buying the place up. (6) The 本部長, now using the alias 土田, summons him to a private 料亭, warns him about the 地上げ rumour, and proposes a plan: gather the whole settlement in the 集会場 for a fake utilities briefing while a lockpicker slips the supplementary report into the 蔵. He accepts on condition that a copy is kept to be handed over later. The plant succeeds; the settlement becomes more closed than before and 『金崎勉』 inherits the same bad name 篠崎ハジメ had. (7) Fifteen years on he lives as a conspicuously good man — volunteering, giving money to the homeless — and thinks about taking orders after retirement. Leaving work early for his grandson's birthday he gives 2,000 yen to a young woman who says she has lost her purse; she runs after him, admits she made it up, and he tells her to pass it to the next person who really needs it. (8) At home 土田 telephones again and calls him out; in a dark alley a man he does not know stabs him twice. Dying, he realises who arranged it. (9) The last 28 cells are ONE SIDE of a telephone call: 土田 reports the death, confirms a plea bargain bought the killer, agrees that 荒田 will continue to be denied 戸籍 so no local police can enter, blames the 元木町 research institute killings on 「操られた死体」, recommends rebuilding an institute at 元木町 「60年ほど先」, says ドローガ becoming public would end world order, and signs off 「ええ、自分のことは自分でやります。／今まで、お世話になりました」 -> Q879
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 金崎勉, 土田, 本部長, 凍傷, 内部告発, 失職, 県庁職員, 整形手術, 物心, 説明会, ライフライン, インフラ, ピッキング, 地上げ(already present), 身辺調査, 事実無根, 善行, 定年退職, 出家, 煩悩, 仏, ボランティア, ホームレス, チャー坊, 1000円札, 尾ひれ背ひれ, 埒があかない, 社会福祉, 世界の秩序, 操られた死体, 研究所の後輩, 国有地(already present)
- voice/relationship changes: 篠崎ハジメ's block gets his narration voice, his second identity and his death; new RELATIONS rows for 本部長 -> 篠崎, 篠崎 -> 本部長, 篠崎 -> wife, 篠崎 -> grandson, 篠崎 -> the young woman
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 8:461-8:488 has no speaker tag, no narration and only one side of the call; the reader infers 土田 from 「もしもし、土田です」 alone, and the person he is reporting TO is never identified, never described and never named -> Q879. 8:69 prints 『金崎 勉』 with ruby-residue spacing inside the name -> Q877, Q010
- resolves from earlier files: why the 元木町 research institute exists at all and why it was rebuilt (Q647, Q648); why 荒田 has no 戸籍 in every modern file (Q170-area, Q242); why the supplementary report is in the 蔵書 without anybody at 荒田 knowing it arrived; and who the 六十年後 institute was ordered by -> Q880, Q881. ## 000021E2  (order 392)
- narrator: none; the file is navigator cells and dialogue. 389 lines across THIRTY-THREE row-blocks ([53] [64] [70] [77] [117] [154] [199] [205] [211] [256] [262] [268] [335] [375] [381] [425] [431] [437] [474] [511] [517] [521] [576] [616] [622] [628] [675] [720] [734] [772] [835] [901] [1025]), which are branch-exclusive: several are alternative outcomes of the same conversation and cannot all be true -> Q884, Q700
- speakers present: the navigator (新村春花 as 立木三日, わたくし); a SECOND 新村春花 who arrives from another dimension (私, タメ口); 古郡なつみ; 五島絵梨奈
- events: [53] something enters a world in which only the navigator and the player can exist; it is another 新村春花, who takes the whole thing for a dream, says she has to be up early because 「今日はなつみと五島で、かんざしを埋めに行くんだ」, and is identified by the navigator as the 春花 of the dimension that reached the truth and destroyed 死月妖花. She says she came because she heard a cry for help, proposes to rescue the navigator by merging with her — 「お前と私は同じ人間。／だから、1つになればいいだろ？」 — and the navigator asks the player what to do. [64] a closing address: this is the world's terminus and its hidden truth; every case came of wanting to protect somebody and falling into 外道 to do it; 「私がなぜなつみを手に掛けたのかを知ることができた」; and the なつみ of her own world is not coming back. [117]-[268] the merge happens: she reports memories she did not have, says she is now two dimensions' 新村春花 in one, admits a further guest, and なつみ and 五島 walk in alive; she says goodbye in her own unmasked voice (「ありがとな、／／！／お前に会えて、本当に良かった！」) and leaves. [335]-[381] a different occasion: the player has read every 書簡, レポート and 外伝 reference, the background is solved, and the world begins to change. [437]-[628] the player argues her into going home; she refuses violently (「もう私はあの世界を捨てたんだよ！」), is told the tragedies all had another option, lists six of them in six cells, breaks down, and then chooses to return — 「私は……自分のしたことと向き合う」 — and says a long goodbye that ends 「さよなら、／」. [675]-[734] the alternative: she rejects the player as a 傍観者, says she has learned 死月妖花 can raise the dead, and walks out to do it; the other 春花 shouts for the player to chase her. [835] the harshest version of the refusal. [901] なつみ appears and talks her out of leaving over ~157 cells of pure two-voice dialogue: she asks not what 春花 should do but what she wants, 春花 answers 「強くなりたい」, なつみ shows her that in this world 「人の心が反映される」 and promises 「私の心は、ずっと春花のそばだよ」, then vanishes; 春花 laughs, swears at her and cries. [1025] she apologises to the player and says she is awake
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 別次元, 終着点, 外道, 傍観者, 他人事
- voice/relationship changes: the navigator's block and 新村春花's block both get the two-register scene; new RELATIONS rows for 新村春花(navigator) -> 新村春花(別次元) and back, and 古郡なつみ -> 新村春花 in the dream
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the two 春花 speak in the same scene in completely different registers — わたくし／ございます／様 against 私／タメ口／はは — and the text never marks which cell belongs to which; attribution rests on register alone for the whole file -> Q885, Q047. In [901] the same is true of なつみ and 春花. The player's side is never printed anywhere, so every question is answered into a silence -> Q230
- resolves from earlier files: [64] states in the navigator's own voice why the whole framing device exists and confirms the 00001CA0 reveal from the other side -> Q763, Q812, Q684. ACTION: revisit y

## 00002225  (order 394)
- narrator: 新村春花, 私
- time markers: the day she wakes; then 「それから何年かが経ち――」 and a cherry season
- speakers present: 新村春花, 五島絵梨奈, and 古郡なつみ's voice in the last two cells
- events: she wakes in a hospital room with 五島 beside her and says at once 「私が殺した。これは紛れもない事実」, refusing 五島's offer to prove an external cause. She gives one errand instead: a girl has lived alone on 糸姫山 for 800 years being used by something, and 五島 is to get her out. 五島 accepts as 天才少女五島絵梨奈 and then falls apart. Narration: 死月妖花 was exposed through 五島's work, 糸姫 was cut away from it and is held somewhere at state-secret level because of what 不老不死 would attract; years pass; 春花 is never tried. She watches clouds in cherry season, says she does not regret coming back, and talks with 五島 about why anything is 不思議 — 「誰かと一緒に居ないと、不思議って思わないもんな」. 五島 says she would have accepted 春花 never waking if 春花 were happy, then admits she wanted her back. 春花 says her mother's strength is really her own doing. 五島 reports 糸姫 is about to be released into modern society; 春花 says the two of them are alike, both criminals allowed to live, and wants her to be happy. 五島 notices 春花's manner has become 女性らしい; 春花 blames her hair and admits she used to act 男っぽく 「ちょっとでも強くありたかったからかな」, and says the person in the dream taught her what strength is. They go to ザッハ to choose 夏菜's 進級祝い. The last four cells: 「なつみ、私は生きているよ、この世界で」, then 「うん、春花はもう大丈夫だよ」 in なつみ's voice and 「ああ、なつみがそばにいてくれるから」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 永劫回帰, ミラノポリス, ウルトラデラックスピザ, 進学祝い
- voice/relationship changes: 新村春花's block gets a permanent softening of register with an on-screen cause; 五島絵梨奈's block gets her one direct statement that she would have let her friend stay asleep
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:103-11:105 glosses 永劫回帰 as 「一瞬一瞬を大切に生きる」「過去を後悔するより未来へ希望を馳せる」, which is NOT what the philosophical term means anywhere else; the EN must carry the in-world gloss, not the standard one -> Q889. 11:170 is なつみ's voice with no frame at all — dead, remembered, or present is left open
- resolves from earlier files: this is the terminal state of the 永劫回帰 route and the 00001CA0 frame: the navigator's refusal is undone and 春花 wakes -> Q763, Q812, Q222. ACTION: revisit y

## 00002268  (order 395)
- narrator: the AUTHOR, in propria persona. 67 lines, one row-block. This is an afterword, not story text -> Q873 (owner-blocking)
- time markers: 「2016年2月」 (the prototype); 「三年半」 of work; signed 「2024年　四月　八日」
- speakers present: さつき of the 創作サークル New++
- events: thanks for finishing the game; the project began on a whim in PowerPoint, before the author knew what a game engine or a free game was; a prototype called 『四月八日の魔女』 went out in 2016 and the system and flow were kept; the first line that came to him was 『私は桜が嫌い』, which no longer survives in the text; he meant to spend three months and spent three and a half years. He intended to finish at the fifth 編, 『最後の声編』 — 新村エリカ's death and 春花's decision about living at 荒田 — and rejected it because ending on hearing a dead person's voice contradicted a story that had denied the supernatural throughout, so he added 真・呪殺編, 真・明徴編, エデンの桜編 and 永劫回帰編, the ドローガ infection rules, 死月妖花 as the thing behind everything, and the 女ケ沢市事件 backstage, turning a vague strange story into an SF one. He states that 『死月妖花』 was born as a 誤変換 of 『四月八日』 and that he then decided to make it a cherry cultivar. He says he finds reading painful, made a novel game because it looked easy to make, and built the chopped-up navigator text, the character counter and the clickable references so he would not be bored by his own game. He then flags ONE unresolved item in the plot: the 女ケ沢市事件 was caused by 茅萱's 翠眼呪殺, the search for a cure reaching ファルシフィカソ, and sending 美冬 both ドローガ and ファルシフィカソ to test the toxicity — but 詫言編『死神の掟』 shows no ファルシフィカソ ever reached 美冬. He says the explanation exists in his head, involves 「立ち絵もセリフもなく、名前だけが登場したあの人物」, breaks off at 「あの人物は祀耀800年時ではきっと――」, and says he shelved making it. Closes with thanks to testers and asset providers and points at a video
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: さつき, New++, 創作サークル, 四月八日の魔女, 最後の声編, エデンの桜編, 永劫回帰編, 試作版, フリーゲーム, ノベルゲーム, 誤変換, あとがき, 2024年
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 「『死月妖花』という単語は『四月八日』の誤変換から生まれました」 is an IME accident between two readings of the same kana string; English has no equivalent and the title itself is at stake -> Q874 (owner-blocking). The author's hint at 8:52-8:54 withholds the name and the EN must withhold it identically -> Q876
- resolves from earlier files: the 詫言編 gap the author names is the same gap the notes have carried since chunk 22 — why 美冬 had ドローガ and no antidote -> Q876. 「2024年」 is the second real-calendar year in the project and it sits in the author's own voice, which weakens 000021BD:21:5's 1942年 as evidence about the 祀耀 era -> Q875, Q827
