## 00002427  (order 410)
- narrator: 新村美冬, 私. 417 lines, the longest file in the chunk, narrated end to end by the killer
- time markers: the day of the 元木町事件, from late afternoon to the fire
- speakers present: 新村美冬, 古郡茜, 古郡なつみ, 新村春花, 五島絵梨奈, a police officer
- events: she is tracking 春花 by the phone she bugged. Her plan: 茜 and なつみ dead, 春花 unhurt, 五島 irrelevant. She lays 鉈, 能面 and 赤装束 outside her own flat, then makes 茜 see her far from the building by flagging down the unmarked police car; なつみ starts to say too much and 茜 pinches her leg. She injects the drug, covers a five-minute walk in under thirty seconds, and finds 茜 sending the police escort away rather than let officers stay — which 美冬 reads as 茜 protecting herself over her daughter and notes it 「なかなかうまく事が運んでいる」. She knocks 茜 out with a body blow, takes her key, and cuts the door chain with the 鉈 rather than tear it by hand, reasoning that superhuman damage would link the case to 女ケ沢. なつみ is hiding under the sink; 美冬 tells her the killer is out cold and gets hugged instead of a clear shot. 茜 revives and strikes her on the head with the flat of the 鉈; 美冬 stabs 茜 twice with knives from inside her coat; 茜 dies telling なつみ to run. 美冬 beheads なつみ with the 鉈 — narrated through her own hunting analogy — and records 「何の感慨もない」. The drug wears off, the pain arrives, and she lies down and plays dead. 春花 arrives, vomits, then 五島; 美冬 watches through half-closed eyes as 春花 cradles なつみ's head, and an emotion she has not felt in over ten years arrives: 罪悪感. Her interior question for the rest of the scene is what could have broken 春花 and なつみ apart when the same thing broke her and 茜. 春花 pulls a knife out of 茜's body, tells 五島 she loves her too so 五島 will die today, makes her say she does not want to die, and then cuts her own throat to end it. 美吏 gets up, knocks 五島 out, and holds her dying daughter. Afterwards she works: she makes 紙人形 of herself and 春花, dips them in 春花's vomit, puts them in 五島's pocket, carries 五島 to the entrance, props her against the wall and covers her with a blanket wetted in the bathroom, so 五島 will survive and go on believing in the 呪い. Then she empties the kerosene tank from なつみ's 反射式ストーブ over the living room, cuts the kitchen gas hose, and lights it, because the drug is undetectable after high heat. Burning, she lists what she destroyed — 親友, 娘, 娘の妹, 親友の夫 — decides that because 春花 needed なつみ no matter what, 春花 would forgive her, and ends 「私は春花の母親になれてよかった。／春花、私のところに来てくれてありがとう。／そして……／ごめんね、春花……」
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: みね打ち(already present as 峰打ち — not re-added), チェーン, 外廊下, 流し台, 大動脈, 薬莢(0000242E), 灯油タンク, ガスホース, 不完全燃焼, 瞳孔
- voice/relationship changes: 新村美冬's block gets her second narration, her ZERO-exclamation operational register, and the on-screen arrival of 罪悪感
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:22 「 懐 」 and 11:226 「 囁 」 carry ruby-residue spacing -> Q908, Q010. 11:334 prints a doubled closing quote, 「こうすれば、もう誰も殺さずに済む」」 -> Q922 (typo). The narration never says what 春花 was going to do to 五島 before she turned the knife on herself
- resolves from earlier files: the whole 元木町事件 from inside — why the chain was cut rather than torn, why 五島 woke at the entrance under a wet blanket with 紙人形 in her pocket, why the flat burned, and why no drug was ever found -> Q910, Q158, Q214. ACTION: revisit y

## 0000242E  (order 411)
- narrator: 五島桃子, 私. Her second narration anywhere after 00000E7B
- time markers: the night of the 女ケ沢-style attack on the 五島 house; 桜吹雪 and 春の嵐
- speakers present: 五島桃子, a plainclothes officer, other officers, 五島絵梨奈, the masked figure (two whispered lines)
- events: she notices her sister has let two girls in on a weekday and that they were hiding from view, and counts four cars with occupants parked within a hundred metres. Wind rises. She sees a figure moving furtively, then vanishing — 「消えたと錯覚するほどに速く動いた」 — and runs to a car shouting that the 女ケ沢市事件 culprit is heading for the 五島 house; the officer believes her and radios everyone in. Gunfire from inside. One of the two girls walks out towards 中央公園 and an officer follows her, reporting 「マルタイ」 to a 警部補 by radio. 桃子 punches the officer in the face, takes his handgun and goes in. Upstairs, in her sister's room, she finds the masked figure and presses the muzzle against its chest at point-blank range, thinking 死ね! — and the trigger will not move, because of a safety she has heard of and cannot find. Instead of cutting her down the figure embraces her and whispers 「お願いだから、道をあけて……」. An officer knocks it away; 絵梨奈's voice from the dark flips her from 青 to 赤, 冷 to 熱; the safety has come off in the scuffle and four rounds go into the figure on the floor. Silence. The figure stands up unhurt, whispers 「どうか娘たちを……／お願い……」, and 桃子 lowers the gun because 「何かが食い違っている」; it jumps out of the window and the police chase it. Left with a 鉈, a メイス, spent casings and blood on the floor, she is shouted at by her sister for recklessness and cannot hear it, because the whisper is repeating in her head. Her closing thought: the figure came alone knowing the police were there, only to protect its daughters — 「まるで私と同じだ」 — and the file ends on 『私は何を間違えたのだろうか』, the idea that driving the figure off was itself the 悲劇
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 安全装置, 引き金, 銃口, 過剰防衛(already present), 薬莢, 電柱, 火薬, 無線, 春の嵐(already present)
- voice/relationship changes: 五島桃子's block gets her second first-person file, her only act of violence against a police officer, and the only scene in which the あんた register is absent because the addressee is a stranger in a mask
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: the masked figure is never named; the reader identifies 新村美冬 only from 「娘たち」 and from the bullets doing nothing -> Q912. 11:169 and 11:177 run a colour-and-temperature figure and its exact inversion across eight cells and the EN must keep both halves identical -> Q913. 11:62 prints 「私の家自宅にっている」 -> Q923 (typo)
- resolves from earlier files: the 女ケ沢 route's failure condition, and the only account anywhere of 新村美冬 being shot four times at close range and walking away -> Q813, Q545. ACTION: revisit y

## 00002433  (order 412)
- narrator: 新村茅萱, 私, with her 「ん……」 opener intact on every line she speaks
- time markers: 新村栄一郎's 十三回忌, so 祀耀800; 新村エリカ says 「私は71歳だ。私に残された時間はあと4年」
- speakers present: 新村茅萱, 新村エリカ, 新村サクラ, 新村夏菜, 新村春花 (telephone)
- events: 美冬 will not come to the 法要 and has said only 「仕事」; エリカ excuses it by money and by 春花. 夏菜 wants 春花 on the phone to try new material on her. 茅萱 calls; 春花 sounds normal but 「心なしか声が震えていた」. The 法要 runs to procedure: because everyone is masked an absent resident is invisible, but the 魔女 role stands out front, so with 美冬 absent 茅萱 stands in and carries the implements. Afterwards she asks her grandmother to talk alone. She says she likes エリカ's rational disregard for the 掟 and worries what the residents would think; エリカ answers that she has four years left and wants to change the settlement. Her argument: the old temper survives because 荒田 cut itself off, but electricity, cars, phones and the internet are now needed. She gives an example — a married resident living outside may not bring a child back until it is 16 — and explains it by what happened to 茅萱 ten years ago, which 茅萱 says she still dreams about; a child born in the settlement would simply be killed at birth if its eyes were green. Until ten years ago almost nobody knew that rule, and the 16-year rule is itself a corruption: 「正しくは『緑の目を持つ16歳の子供』だそうだ」. She reveals she offered 美冬 ten years ago that she and 春花 could live at 荒田, and that if the residents had objected she would have left the settlement herself, because 「美冬さんも春花も私の家族なんだよ。栄一郎が残した大切な家族」. She quotes the founder from 800 years before — 『ここにいるみんなが、そして子孫たちが未来永劫、穏やかに過ごせる場所を築き上げるのだ』 — and says what the place needs is a peaceful life, not a 大魔女. 茅萱 accepts and promises to carry the intent. The file ends on both of them uneasy about 美冬 — 「だって夫の十三回忌よ？」 — and エリカ wishing 美冬 would rely on her
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 生活基盤, 統率, 権威, 杞憂, 代理
- voice/relationship changes: 新村エリカ's block gets her reformer argument and her own countdown to the 75歳自殺; 新村茅萱's block gets her deputising as 魔女
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:84 「もしここで生まれた子供なら、翠眼と分かった時点ですぐに殺せるけどね」 is delivered flatly, by a grandmother, about her own granddaughters, and the EN must not soften the aside -> Q915, Q840. 11:80 「10年前、お前に何があったかを」 is never spelled out in this file
- resolves from earlier files: the 16歳 掟 that keeps 春花 out of 荒田 is explained AND shown to be a misremembering of a green-eye rule (Q840); the 75歳自殺 rule gets a named countdown for a living character (Q802, Q914); and the founder's line from 0000107B is quoted verbatim 800 years later (Q916, Q418, Q420). ACTION: revisit y
## 00002439  (order 413)
- narrator: 新村茅萱, 私, with her 「ん……」 opener intact on every line she speaks. 234 lines, ONE row-block [11]
- time markers: the night of 新村栄一郎's 十三回忌 at 荒田集落, while the 継承の儀 is being held at the 墓地広場
- events: she has SKIPPED the 継承の儀 and sent a substitute in her place, wearing only a 鉈 instead of the full 鉈・メイス・能面・赤装束; the swap was agreed in advance and it is 「その人――おばさんの頼みだ」, i.e. 新村美冬, who is never named in the file. She is up a cherry tree watching the settlement. She reports that the 古郡 couple are hiding in the 資材倉庫 by 荒田駅 with a 盗聴アプリ on the girls' phones, notes it is two hours' walk from the settlement and therefore useless, and understands them anyway. Her own inference: なつみ has 危険予知能力, which is why the daughters came in the parents' place, and おばさん did not say so because 荒田 treats that power as the 魔女's and 茅萱 is 荒田's. 夏菜 runs out of the house alone toward the mountain path; 茅萱 follows without calling out, for two stated reasons — residents must not see the two of them talking, and her father must not learn her movements. She is caught in a vine animal-snare; 夏菜 had predicted the pursuit and chosen the route. 夏菜: 「パパが言ってたよ。資材倉庫に呪殺の真犯人がいるってさ」. 茅萱 tries to say the culprit is their father; 夏菜 refuses it with the watched-years argument (he was under observation and people still died), and converts it in two cells into 「パパが見張られてる時に人を殺したの、お姉ちゃんなんだね」. She stabs 茅萱 in the left arm, laughing 「はは、私、お姉ちゃんを刺しちゃった」, then in the side, then drives the knife through her palm, crying and grinding her teeth while she does it and shouting 「誰が犯人なら納得するの！？」. 茅萱, bleeding internally, false-confesses to save the others (「犯人は私。……もう、誰も傷つけないで……」) and is slapped for it as 投げやり. 夏菜 turns her back and offers herself. 茅萱 answers one question — the people in the store are なつみ's parents — and 夏菜 accepts they are innocent and announces she will go back and 成敗 everyone suspicious, her father included. 茅萱 swings the 鉈 and opens a long wound across her sister's back. 夏菜 stands up, says 「お姉ちゃん、裏切ったんだね」, and walks off toward the settlement. The file ends with 茅萱 still snared, dying, and unable to follow
- speakers present: 新村茅萱, 新村夏菜
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: none — 継承の儀, 資材倉庫, 盗聴アプリ, 墓地広場, ツル and 成敗 are all already in GLOSSARY.tsv

## 0000243F  (order 414)
- narrator: 城崎健吾, 俺. His FIRST narration anywhere in the project. 165 lines, ONE row-block [11]
- time markers: the same night, immediately before the attack on 新村本家
- events: the residents have massed at his house because it is nearest 新村本家; everyone but the 新村本家 people is there. His own 鉈 and メイス are stacked with 能面 and 赤装束 — 臨戦態勢. Somebody informed them a 魔女 is present. He objects twice out loud and is answered by bare 「――」 lines: 「――裏切り者は魔女の手先」, 「――すべてはみんなを守るためだ」, 「――城崎、お前も――」. His narration calls this the settlement's true nature and the motto's selfish reading, and states his own position plainly — defy them and he becomes rust on his own product. He gives in. He then explains the costume and the weapons: not efficiency (guns would be easier) but a show of resolve, because the girl was invited by 新村本家, so killing her defies 新村本家, which is the settlement's will, so a rising by everyone else is a クーデター. Scouts report the 新村 sisters are out, which is the one thing they fear. He addresses his dead wife inside his own narration: 「なあ百合子、俺は間違っているよな？」. THE FOUR 荒田 FAMILY LINES are set out here for the first time: 新村 (head family, martial arts and hunting), 城崎 (weapons and tools), 新島 (farming and nature), and — after a bare cell reading 「そして」 — 瀬 (water and irrigation management), the fourth name arriving inside the following narration. He also states that all four have branched repeatedly, so the same surname often means no close kinship, 新村 most of all. 瀬正照 is a year younger than him and lost a much younger sister in the second 呪殺; 城崎 says his aim has stopped being hatred and become the killing itself, and calls him the 反面教師 that keeps him level. Outside, everyone is crouched behind the hedge watching the mountain path: 夏菜 is staggering toward 新村本家, blue-faced, sweating, with a large wound down her back, and 茅萱 follows with a 鉈, also covered in blood. 城崎 calls for them to be helped; 瀬 answers that the two most dangerous people are dying and should be finished together. 城崎 grabs his collar. 新島香織 — nearly 60, a high childish voice, stretched vowels — sides with 城崎: 「チーちゃんどころかカナカナまで殺すことないよ！」; asked, she says her eldest and second sons were both 呪殺ed; 瀬, whom she calls マーくん, cuts her down with one vertical 鉈 swing and says 「ふん、呪われた女め。荒田のために死ね！」. The crowd marches on 新村本家. 城崎 takes her 能面 off, finds the collarbone completely broken but no vital point hit and little bleeding, and she tells him to go and save the 元木町 girls, because her 呪殺ed sons would be angry with her otherwise
- speakers present: 城崎健吾, the 荒田 residents as a 「――」 collective, 瀬正照, 新島香織
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 新島, 瀬, 瀬正照, 新島香織, 灌漑, 分家, 家系, 鎖骨, 反面教師, 過激派 (appears in 00002444), 穏健派 (00002444)
- voice/relationship changes: new RELATIONS rows for 城崎健吾 <-> the resident collective, 城崎健吾 <-> 瀬正照, 新島香織 <-> 城崎健吾, 新島香織 -> 瀬正照, 新島香織 -> 新村茅萱 (チーちゃん) and -> 新村夏菜 (カナカナ)

## 00002444  (order 415)
- narrator: TWO, alternating at every row-block boundary with no marker anywhere — 五島絵梨奈 (私) in [14] and [26], 新村春花 (私) in [20] and [32]. 1943 lines, the longest file in the chunk, FOUR row-blocks
- time markers: 「祀耀800年四月八日深夜1時」 (14:290); the rescue is 四月一三日 (32:298); the closing block jumps fifteen years to 祀耀815 (32:322)
- events, [14] 五島絵梨奈: hiding in a cave twenty minutes after the attack. Her recap of it: the four of them were discussing the 呪殺事件 with 幸太郎 when a dying 夏菜 and チガ姉 came in, followed by a masked crowd who went straight for 古郡先輩 and チガ姉; 五島 was frozen and 新村先輩 shoved her out of the room. She decides the cave is indefensible, goes out, and is taken from behind by a hand in a dark red glove. The man is 城崎健吾. He carries her back in, takes off the mask and hood, puts his knife on the floor and turns his back offering his own throat. She refuses to trust him and reasons through an entrapment hypothesis before interrogating him instead. He explains: サクラ had 危険予知; the residents believed both a curse and a human killer; 古郡先輩 has the same power, so they killed her. 五島 catches the first contradiction — only part of 新村本家 knew about 古郡先輩's ability, so a 新村 informed 瀬 — and then the second: 城崎 says サクラ's precognition needed a dark, narrow place in the cherry season, where 幸太郎 had told them サクラ waited on a clifftop for 四月病 to take her. Her conclusion: 幸太郎 lied, 幸太郎 is the informer, and he lied because he knew the attack was coming. She gives her name (「五島絵梨奈です。五島って呼んでください」) and is given the 赤装束 and 能面 as a disguise. Walking down he tells her 城崎百合子 was his wife and had meant to bring the police in the day before she died. He leaves her hidden with a ten-minute deadline and comes back at a run: every resident is dead. They pass the bodies — necks turned wrong, torsos twisted, all in 能面 and 赤装束 — and 五島 reads the wounds as hand weapons rather than firearms. He fetches a 猟銃 and a バギー. On the mountain road he brakes for two figures who turn out to be 古郡良治 and 古郡茜, come up from the 資材倉庫 on the listening app. 良治 splits the party: 茜 takes 五島 to 荒田駅, 良治 goes back with 城崎. 五島 vouches for 城崎. 茜's parting 「春花ちゃんのこと、お願いね？」 tells 五島 that 新村先輩 is alive
- events, [20] 新村春花: she comes round at the foot of a slope with NO MEMORY OF ABOUT HALF A MONTH; her last memory is her mother telling her the 古郡 couple will miss the 十三回忌 and that なつみ and 五島 will come instead because of なつみ's 危険予知. Her phone says 祀耀800年四月八日 0:30 and holds messages and video she does not remember taking. She climbs to a 獣道. A girl appears: a red kimono, long hair, slightly younger, ONE GREEN EYE. She gives her name as 糸, speaks です・ます, knows 春花's name and her ordinary register, makes fire by rubbing two sticks, says she once lived in the mountains for months, that she cannot normally move freely, that this is the only time they will meet, and that it is better 春花 does not remember. 春花 reads her as a family's hidden confined child. 糸 says 美冬 and 五島 are safe and that なつみ is worse than dead, then confesses to being the 呪殺 culprit. 春花 does not get angry — she remembers making 紙人形 as a child at 女ケ沢 to kill a classmate, and her mother commissioning a killing behind her back, and concludes 糸 is a shut-in who believes she is guilty. 糸 gives her one instruction: never trust 古郡なつみ, run from her. なつみ walks into the firelight; 糸 drags 春花 away. Running, the memory comes back: the masked crowd, 春花 pushing 五島 out, her mother drawing them off and jumping from the window barefoot, the 獣道 「茅萱ちゃんたちはいつもこのルートを通ってるの」, phone-location tracking to meet the 古郡 couple, the ground vanishing and 春花 going down the cliff, her mother's voice leading them away. She also remembers that なつみ died. 糸 then explains: 神使 kill one person a year on her instruction; the residents' rampage killed なつみ, 茅萱 and 夏菜 and she can no longer control it; she has been here since 祀耀元年, 800 years; 栄一郎 and サクラ are also hunting them; the 親玉 is 「一応は人間」. They meet 良治 and 城崎. 城崎 names 糸姫山 and quotes a settlement 書簡: 『齢15ほどの赤い着物を着た少女。それが邪悪なる女神である』. 糸 admits everything to his face, offers to stay behind, and tells him she is 「ただの人間」 and can be killed. He fires the 猟銃; the outcome is withheld for three cells; she is untouched and his terms are that she now owes the survivors her protection and he will watch her. 良治 gets a signal: 五島 has already called it in; a small unit in three hours, a larger one at dawn, stay put. 糸 works out that なつみ went after 五島 and 茜 instead because they would reach the foot of the mountain first; 春花 runs
- events, [26] 五島絵梨奈: she phoned the police; she and おばさん are on the バギー. She lays out the reconstruction in order. On 幸太郎: the timing puts the tip-off during the 怪談トーク or the fireworks, which is far too early for silencing, so the lie was told BECAUSE they were likely to survive — to leave 五島 with the wrong precognition condition. On the massacre: too many dead, blunt and bladed killing takes force and repetition, the attackers were never seen, so a very small number with extraordinary combat ability; therefore a 真犯人 hidden all along who was forced into the open by something it did not expect. なつみ appears, unhurt, calm, in white. おばさん embraces her. 五島's narration answers each of her three lines with one cell reading 「嘘だ――」 and then she shouts it, and gives the physical objection: nobody passed them on the road, so 先輩 cannot have come down alone. She declares 「あなたは古郡先輩の姿をした別人だ！」. おばさん slaps her, says 「なつみは私の娘。邪魔しないで」, and the two ride away. 春花 arrives sweating and gasping, which 五島 takes as proof she is real. Then 良治, 城崎 and 糸. 糸 explains the 神使 economy: 死月妖花 wants four — living and dead 第一世代 and 第二世代; the dead two are 栄一郎 and サクラ; 茜 will be made the living 第一世代 with her own ドローガ; 第一世代 = one who used ドローガ, 第二世代 = one bathed in 第一世代's blood. She also says the way to undo なつみ is to petition the 核 of 死月妖花; she herself was the first core and gave the fungus human intelligence, but the current core was absorbed about twenty years ago and is called アバドン in a Western language, and she has not been told who it is. 五島 supplies the missing slot (the living 第二世代 is what なつみ was taken alive for) and reconstructs the ten-year-old crime: 栄一郎 beheaded サクラ because he alone could act unseen, staged an incomprehensible killing to spread 不信 through the settlement, switched from staged elderly suicides to murders to empty it faster, and used 幸太郎 as サクラ's puppet. She then prints ~48 CELLS OF DIALOGUE THAT NEVER HAPPENED, set in 「」 and 「――」 exactly like a real scene and framed only by 「きっとこんなやり取りがあったはずだ」 before and 「予想ではあるが、おそらくこんなやり取りがあったはず」 after. Finally she catches 糸 out: 糸's sensory link to なつみ was cut at the moment the residents attacked, so she never confirmed the death — なつみ was saved at the last possible moment
- events, [32] 新村春花: she wakes underground at the top of 糸姫山 — warm, humid, no moon, walls and ceiling of pulsing root-like fibres, and her exhaustion gone. Her father's voice, identified because 幸太郎 says 春花ちゃん and this voice says 春花. He says the 女神様 is resting, because the residents' rampage forced the 神使 into service and treating なつみ cost her; that letting 糸姫 slip was a small matter; that the others are held safely elsewhere; and that the 女神様 wants to speak to 春花 alone. In the corner is a black mass that turns out to be hair, and under it a naked adult woman about 春花's age who behaves like an infant: sucks her fingers, hugs her knees, cannot say her own name or her parents' names, and wants ママ. Her turns are printed as cells containing only full-width spaces inside 「」. 春花 negotiates, reaching for feeling rather than argument, and remembers 夏菜 at four or five asking why they have no mother, the three answers she was given and the one 春花 gave (「死んじゃったからだよ」), and 夏菜's own 死生観 out of a picture book. The deal: return なつみ, and 春花 will help find the mother. サクラ's voice announces it; a swelling grows on the wall, splits, and なつみ comes out in clear fluid, breathing but unresponsive; 春花 takes off her own clothes to cover her. The core stands, thanks her for the promise alone, says 「ママを……取り返せるから」 — and then withdraws the request: 「もういい。しなくていい。／私からあなたへのお願いは1つだけ……／できるだけ長生きしてね？」. 春花 sees her face for the first time and thinks it resembles someone, with eyes she saw once as a child. 栄一郎 and サクラ set the terms of release: everyone goes unhurt, but in about fifteen years the 女神様 moves to 元木町 and 元木町 becomes uninhabitable, so leave before then, and say nothing to anyone or all of them die. 春花 escapes with なつみ; FIVE DAYS have passed; they are found on 四月一三日; everyone survived; and everyone except 春花 has lost the memory of that night, including her grandmother and 幸太郎. The only surviving resident is 新島香織, found hiding indoors with a badly injured shoulder, unable to speak coherently, who wastes away and dies in hospital three months later — which is what convinces 春花 it was real. Then a news broadcast about an earthquake in 元木市 the previous week, poison gas, survivors presumed none, giant plant-like structures and heavy fog, and a special unit five days overdue. 春花 had found pretexts to get なつみ and 五島 out of 元木町 and they were spared; she alone knew, kept the promise, and nearly 200,000 people died. Her verdict is that her father's 「完全に君の勝ちだ」 was wrong and that the 女神様's whole purpose was to make her live long and suffer. The file's last cell: 「あの時からずっと、あの人が見つかっていないのだ」
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈, 新村春花, 城崎健吾, 糸 (= 糸姫), 古郡良治, 古郡茜, 古郡なつみ (converted), 新村美冬 (inside the recovered memory), 新村栄一郎 (voice only), 新村サクラ (voice only), 新村幸太郎 (inside the invented reconstruction), the 核／女神様, the 「――」 resident voices (inside the invented reconstruction), 新島香織 (inside the invented reconstruction)

## 00002450  (order 416)
- narrator: TWO row-blocks and they do not share one. [12] is narrated by 五島絵梨奈 in 私; [18] has NO narrator at all — 440 lines
- time markers: 「今日でゴールデンウィークは終わり、明日からまた学校」; then, printed as a caption, 「――時刻　2020年五月五日　23:05」 followed by 「古郡なつみがドローガを発見するまで、／あと60分。」; 新村栄一郎's death is dated 「もう12年前」
- events, [12] 五島絵梨奈: at home at night with a stack of books borrowed from 元木大学. Hours earlier her sister raised 新村栄一郎's death unprompted: there were many witnesses but few saw the moment, and 絵梨奈, then three, told her at the time 「誰かに押されて落ちた」. Pressed for anything else, her sister recalls the child's own words — a 「ぶおおおおおって！　ラッパみたいだった」 sound, a sudden wind, and a hand like long black hair coming out of a hole. 絵梨奈 refuses the supernatural reading on her own credo and reaches instead for a forced halt to the police investigation. She asks her sister for a favour and gets it: a 文化人類学 professor among the shop's regulars, whom her sister had just turned down. The books are by 篠崎ハジメ and cover 荒田集落, 死月妖花 as a fungus, ドローガ, 荒田桜 and walking corpses; they were apparently meant as a gift to 荒田 and these are copies, kept at the back of a university store where almost nobody has read them. 荒田集落 is state land and closed without permission, and the internet has nothing. Her sister brings her the leftover 賄い sandwiches, they eat facing each other for the first time in years, 絵梨奈 notes that her sister used her given name several times that day and is told 「覚えてない」, and asked why she is being kind her sister says 「どうしてだろ、自分でもよく分かんない」. Her sister then supplies the deduction 絵梨奈 has missed: 死月妖花 has intelligence and mimics cherry, so it could flower out of season; if spores are still in 元木町 and 古郡先輩 learns about ドローガ and 荒田桜, the 盗感 will give her away to the 邪悪なる女神. Neither 先輩 answers the telephone. Her sister sits her back down, tells her to find someone who can help, and 絵梨奈 says there is exactly one
- events, [18] 伊勢大二郎 and an unnamed young subordinate at 元木警察署, all dialogue, no narration: he is bored. 元木町's population is forecast at 150,000 by 2035, about four times the present, more than half the town are incomers, and the crime rate per head has not moved. His 妄想: someone is holding the town artificially peaceful, for instance with an airborne drug that produces constant happiness. He then produces two exhibits. A 注射器 of pink liquid with the needle still on it, found by him in 新村美冬's car. And a copy of an addendum to 新村栄一郎's 死亡診断書: drug-like substances and biological fragments were found in the body, the 警察庁 forcibly stopped that investigation, and the substance was similar to エフェドリン. Then a printout from 『オカルト雑誌M』: a body was once set up in 元木町 to study the 御神木, a 宿舎 was built for it alone, and every researcher in it was beaten to death; the case is real, the killer was never caught, it was hushed up, and the research stopped at once. Plus the (acknowledged) falsehood that cherry pollen contains エフェドリン. Their joint hypothesis: the 御神木's pollen is a non-addictive narcotic; residents build tolerance by the time they have a life there; the low crime rate is real and is also the reason small offences get police attention, which 割れ窓理論 then compounds. He observes that beating several people to death cleanly is not easily done by a human. He says he will inject himself to settle it, is talked at for six cells, and then laughs and says it was a joke. The file's last cell is 「ん？　誰だこんな時間に」
- speakers present: 五島絵梨奈, 五島桃子, 伊勢大二郎, an unnamed young officer at 元木警察署
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 宿舎, 死亡診断書, 研究書, 深夜徘徊, 空き巣, オカルト雑誌M, にゅー, ぶおおおおお
- voice/relationship changes: new RELATIONS rows 五島桃子 -> 五島絵梨奈 (絵梨奈 used and then disclaimed in one scene), 五島絵梨奈 -> 五島桃子 (お姉ちゃん, asking a favour), 伊勢大二郎 <-> his unnamed 部下

## 00002457  (order 417)
- narrator: 新村幸太郎, 俺. 45 lines, ONE row-block [11]. His second sustained narration after 0000154E:8:139-8:228
- time markers: the night before 新村栄一郎's 十三回忌
- events: he overhears a commotion downstairs and learns that 城崎 has brought a flowering cherry branch, meaning it to be given to なつみ to carry at the 法要 tomorrow. He reacts with 「まったく、なんてことを……！　どうしてこうもみんな想像力に乏しいのか」, because the residents will read it as the 魔女. HE THEN STATES THE 魔女の力 MECHANISM IN FULL: it is the seasonal 危険予知能力, and it fires when a person who has become a ドローガ 第二世代 is in a place with cherry pollen AND the conditions of having been bathed in 第一世代's blood are reproduced. He says he does not know why it came to be called the 魔女の力 — a resident started it at some point, probably off the rumour of dead サクラ's curse — and notes the settlement relied on that power freely while she was alive. His problem: なつみ must not die, because she is a valuable living 第二世代. His original plan was to abduct her after the 十三回忌; she has built too good a relationship with 茅萱 and 夏菜 for that; inciting only part of the settlement risks him being suspected. So he inverts it: make EVERY resident hostile to her and have them all take her, which also lets him steer them into believing she is the 呪殺 culprit. While the house sleeps he writes a 回覧板 reading 『桜の枝を持った者が魔女だ。全員で生け捕りにするように』, puts it at 城崎's house first as the nearest neighbour, and expects it to be believed because refusing to join would make a resident's own position unsafe. The plan after capture: take her underground, have サクラ talk her into becoming a 神使, with a 元木町 hostage if needed, and then use some convenient resident as the living 第一世代. The file's last cell is 「これで、サクラとは永遠に……」
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎 only; no dialogue in the file
- new terms added to GLOSSARY: 回覧板, 生け捕り
- voice/relationship changes: new RELATIONS rows 新村幸太郎 -> 古郡なつみ (なつみちゃん intact while planning her abduction) and 新村幸太郎 -> 新村サクラ (サクラ bare, and the last cell is addressed to her)
- ambiguity that the translation MUST keep open: 11:9 is the only full statement of the 魔女の力's trigger anywhere and it is one long sentence with three conditions -> Q950, Q243. 11:34 prints the 回覧板's text inside narration in 『』 -> Q951. 11:44 breaks off unfinished -> Q952
- resolves from earlier files: 00002444:26:44-26:62 is 五島's reconstruction of exactly this, and this file both CONFIRMS and CORRECTS it — he did incite the residents and he did lie, but his object was capture alive rather than death, the escalation to a whole-settlement hunt was his own idea rather than サクラ's order, and his stated motive is his own continued access to サクラ, not the settlement -> Q381, Q461, Q200. It also answers 0000243F:11:9 「誰かが誰かに垂れこんだのだ」 from the other side -> Q173, Q800. ACTION: revisit y

## 0000245F  (order 418)
- narrator: 新村幸太郎, 俺, plain sequential past. His first file of a four-file run (orders 418-421) that is the 呪殺編 climax told from the antagonist's inside -> Q964
- time markers: the morning of 新村栄一郎's 十三回忌 (祀耀800年四月八日 by the chunk's arithmetic); one inset flashback to the spring before his marriage, about twelve years earlier
- events: he wakes at 新村本家; 夏菜 slept with the 元木町組 and the four girls are already out walking. 茅萱 is alone in the living room, 新村エリカ and 新村美冬 in the kitchen. 美冬 and 茅萱 will fetch the 祭具 from the 地下倉庫 and 茅萱 will be shown the way; 茅萱's one-syllable hesitation at the word is glossed by her father as the place she was confined in ten years ago. He says he is going for his usual walk and the three of them go part of the way together. Interior monologue: only he knows why the 呪殺 happen; サクラ promised not to touch 新村本家; this year all the 神使 will be complete and he will lose her either way; he could become a living 第一世代 and stay with her forever, and is afraid his self would be buried and he would become 「死月妖花の器官」. FLASHBACK: before the marriage, wedding set for May because 荒田 people die in April; she asks how many children he wants; she says she likes 沈丁花 because it is the opposite of the cherry that carries her own name, gives the 花言葉 as 不死、不滅、永遠, and asks him to offer it if she dies. Back in the present he picks the flowers, notes that the ones he lays at the 渓流 are camouflage, and hides when he senses people: 春花, 夏菜, なつみ and 五島 near the underground. They cannot reach the far chamber without his key; the 鉄格子 door was fitted by the 大魔女 two generations back under a cave-in cover story, and behind it is the ヴェルジ mummy, which he believes サクラ does not know about because a 神使 cannot perceive where cherry pollen does not reach. He goes down, calls her name, and the file ends on a voice behind him — 「本来なら聞こえるはずのない声」
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 新村茅萱, 新村美冬, 新村エリカ, 新村サクラ (in flashback and in the last two cells)

## 00002464  (order 419)
- narrator: 新村幸太郎, 俺, continuous out of 0000245F with no marker; the file opens by reprinting that file's last two cells verbatim -> Q965
- time markers: the same morning, minutes later; one inset flashback dated 「7年前」 (祀耀793)
- events: the meeting only works with the cave lights out, and he has never learned where she comes from or goes. He tells her that after the 十三回忌 he will bring 古郡なつみ down, using the residents as a feint — a 回覧板 telling them to take her alive. She refuses the plan: the residents may kill her, there is no guarantee they will obey, and ten years would be wasted. The narration marks two firsts — he has never seen her glare, and has never heard her disparage anyone. She says the corpses cannot act directly because a witness would be a disaster, and states why he was used at all: 「だからこうやって生きた人間である幸太郎に頼んできたんでしょ？」. She sends him away before she vanishes. He walks out repeating the sentence to himself and works out that she met him because he was alive, not because he was her husband. FLASHBACK to seven years earlier: after that year's killing his legs give way, she runs to him and holds him — 「大丈夫、私はずっとずっと幸太郎の味方だから」 — and he weeps against a cold chest with no heartbeat. Back outside, he asks himself whether to stop, sets out what stopping would require (telling everyone to run, and explaining how he knows), answers 「選択肢なんてあるはずがない」 twice, and closes on 「もう……後には退けない」
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 新村サクラ

- voice/relationship changes: 新村サクラ -> 新村幸太郎 gets a change row (the soft feminine タメ口 carrying contempt, the only time anywhere); her CAST block gets the register break

EN must not cool the voice -> Q967. 11:68 「今のは、本当にサクラだったのだろうか」 is left unanswered

## 0000246E  (order 420)
- narrator: 新村幸太郎, 俺, continuous; the file opens 「――俺は予定通り、十三回忌に出席した。」
- time markers: the afternoon of the 十三回忌; references to 9 years earlier (城崎百合子's death) and 10 years earlier (the beheading)
- events: after the memorial everyone leaves at once for the 荒田山道, because his 回覧板 said to lie in wait there; he chose the road so that 城崎, who had handed 古郡なつみ a cherry branch, would warn her and she would try to leave by car. 美冬's car drives out. At home 新村エリカ tells him the residents are attacking and says she is relieved he took no part; he runs out. He meets 城崎 in the road, in neither mask nor vestments, and is interrogated for ~180 cells: the 回覧板's routing places the author at 新村本家; the years of house arrest mean he proved his innocence with residents' lives; and 城崎 claims they spoke the night before, which 幸太郎 knows did not happen. Asked to repeat that conversation so that 城崎 can check 「昨夜の君が、本当に君だったのかどうか」, he realises 栄一郎 impersonated him and that 城崎 suspects it. 城崎 says he will call the police, that the land being state land makes it necessary, that the 大魔女 is also hiding something, that he will sit at home because someone must survive to tell what happened, and that the 元木町 girls are now more trustworthy than his neighbours. He invites his own murder and cites 城崎百合子's timing; 幸太郎 declines and is told 「達者で」. 幸太郎 rules out killing him on practical grounds and goes underground. サクラ reveals she intervened — a felled tree and a small release of spores to give なつみ a premonition and turn her back — refuses to kill 城崎, wants なつみ lured down instead, counts the 神使 (herself, 栄一郎, なつみ, plus one living 第一世代), and says the settlement will be destroyed. Outside, 新村エリカ is waiting: there is a hidden passage toward 糸姫山 in the depths, to be used to evacuate. He then asks her about the beheading; she answers 「知らないね」 twice, then quotes what the man said that night — that he pushed サクラ and cut her head to stage an inexplicable murder — and he says he is hearing it for the first time. Both land on 栄一郎. She slaps him twice, says she has responsibility too, takes a 鉈 off the rock wall, and sends him off with the settlement motto as 美冬's car comes back through the dust
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 城崎健吾, 新村エリカ, 新村サクラ

## 00002473  (order 421)
- narrator: 新村幸太郎, 俺, continuous; the file is the same thirty minutes as 00000E19 and 00000E49 from the other side -> Q973
- time markers: the evening of the 十三回忌, continuous; two inset memory scenes at 茅萱's birth and 夏菜's birth; three cells of 栄一郎's death and サクラ's death, twelve and ten years earlier
- events: he leads なつみ, 春花, 五島 and 夏菜 into the depths under the pretext of hiding them. Long interior reasoning: betraying the thing changes nothing because the settlement is already ruined; the one hope is 城崎's police call, because the organism fears exposure and because the residents now have ドローガ in them; the state will bury it as it buried 栄一郎's death; so the thing will most likely let the drugged residents run rather than kill everyone. 春花 finds a dead end; he cannot show the route past the mummy because サクラ is watching. He announces in narration that he must deceive everyone present in order to deceive her, and then performs the villain: the 00000E19 lines word for word, a self-injection of ドローガ, his own daughter knocked out with the deer-stunning method so as not to hurt her, a nata swung into the ground, the adoption thrown at 春花 as proof of intent, and a plan to break his own arm so that he cannot attack again. He reads 五島 palming the key. Then the thing's voice reaches him, which should be impossible for a 第一世代; the 封石 has been moved, the mummy's spores are in him, and he is becoming a 第四世代 with several days of reason left. The voice threatens to kill everyone in the room if he speaks. なつみ steps in front of 春花 and takes the blade; something hard in her clothing stops it. 五島 opens the door and locks it behind them. The 新村本家 cherry comes down on him; 栄一郎 and サクラ appear; the mycelium pins him. They tell him the human-spy plan has failed, offer to spare everyone if he becomes a 神使, are refused, and then give the file's three revelations as asides — 春花 was splashed with なつみ's blood and is now 第三世代 and will kill her at menarche or on bleeding at 荒田; the 女神様's other wish is to erase 春花 out of jealousy; and the new 女神様 is 「荒田と元木の血を引いた」 and is resting, which is why the people above ground will be left alive. 糸姫 is demoted — 「800年経っても、糸姫はただの下賤の娘」 — and will be bound so she cannot leak anything. They leave; their voices keep arriving in his head, and then his own happiest memories do. He is pulled out from under the tree by the people above, screaming, and is taken away swearing revenge before he rots
- speakers present: 新村幸太郎, 新村春花, 新村夏菜, 五島絵梨奈, 古郡なつみ (one line), 新村栄一郎, 新村サクラ

## 00002478  (order 422)
- narrator: 新村茅萱, 私, taken at the file boundary with no marker; the 「ん……」 tic is on every spoken line and absent from narration. This is the LAST file of the project in reading order -> Q983
- time markers: an unstated number of weeks after the 十三回忌, then 「何日も、何か月も」 later, then 祀耀801年四月八日
- events: she visits her father at a 拘置所, behind an acrylic panel, with a duty officer present and one condition from his lawyer — do not discuss the case. He sits with his head down, eyes unfocused, swaying, and his lawyer has reported him getting worse by the day. She reasons: he used ドローガ, so a stimulant reaction was expected, but the test found nothing, the mass arrests at 荒田 have not been reported, and therefore it is being buried. She tells him his mother has died of a heart attack and gets almost no reaction; she tells him 古郡なつみ is dead, by 春花, and he comes out of his chair and is restrained. She says 春花 has been unconscious with shock. Told there are five minutes left, she asks whether he knows anything; he answers 「ファルシフィカソを……使え……」 and the visit is cut short early. He is carried out shouting contradictory orders — kill the goddess, praise her, kill everyone — and she is dragged out on the other side and told by an officer that today is not to be spoken of, by order of the 警察庁. Months pass: 荒田集落 is closed, 城崎 has moved in with a friend in 飯沢市, 夏菜 is placed with her aunt, and she lives in Tokyo on a government scholarship that appeared out of nowhere. She states that she has been watched since the visit, that she can tell because she was raised at 荒田, and that behaving normally is itself the unfreedom; she cannot use ファルシフィカソ, cannot read the 荒田 蔵書, and will not contact 五島. The file, and the project, ends on 春花 waking on 祀耀801年四月八日, 「また新しく、そして大きく事態が動き出した。／のだが――／それはまた――別の世界での話。」
